^[Sien]# Thank you, Kei. I enjoyed your company.
|[Kei]# Hey, wait!
|[Kei]# Damn it, I can't believe I let her go just like that!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 나도 참 바보 같네.. 물어볼 게 많았는데....

entries.en: |[Kei]# I had so many questions... I got to go after her!
{The Lost Girl} Quest complete!
}New Quest! {Somewhere in Town}
|[Kei]# Do I really have to do this?! What am I, her errand boy?!
^[Reah]# I can still hear you, you know.
|[Kei]# Ugh! I can't believe this! What a total witch!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 헉, 헉... 믿을 수가 없어... 무섭다, 정말..

entries.en: |[Kei]# OK… I've got to prove that I am up to the task!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 어쨌든... 이정도는 해야 노력한 걸로 인정해 주신다는 건가..

entries.en: |[Kei]# She's right, though. Maybe I really haven't been trying hard enough so far… Ugh!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 노력 안 한 게 맞는 것 같기도 하네... 끙.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Let's take a look at the easy ones first... OK, bring back 5 Black Henges. I can do that!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 만만한 거.. 만만한 거.. 옳지, 블랙헨지 5마리. 이것부터 해보자.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Proof of Effort 1}#
&[Guard]# Falling rocks are the least of your problems in Neo Soltia.
entries.ko: &[경비병]# 가끔 솔티아에서 떨어지는 건 돌뿐만이 아니야.

entries.en: &[Guard]# Wild beasts are roaming about out there. If you see one, you'd better run!
entries.ko: &[경비병]# 돌과 함께 그 끔찍한 비스트들도 함께 떨어지지. 만나면 무조건 도망쳐야 한다.

entries.en: &[Guard]# That path leads to the battlefield, Kei. You don't want to go there yet!
entries.ko: &[경비병]# 그쪽은 전장이란다, 케이. 너에겐 아직 위험해.

entries.en: &[Guard]# Make sure you've brought enough healing items with you before leaving town!
entries.ko: &[경비병]# 마을 밖을 나갈 땐 항상 회복 아이템들을 체크해 두도록 해.

entries.en: &[Guard]# Look for a Blacksmith at a Forge for help with healing items; all you need are some ingredients to get started!
entries.ko: &[경비병]# 대장간에서는 약간의 재료만으로도 회복제들을 조합해 준단다.

entries.en: &[Noa]# Blacksmiths from different towns are capable of crafting unique items. I only wish I could visit all of them!
entries.ko: &[노아]# 마을마다 대장장이가 조합할 수 있는 아이템이 다르대요. 다른 마을도 가 보고 싶다.

entries.en: &[Noa]# Kei!! I need your help, please!!
|[Kei]# My help? What for?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 이건 또 웬... 네가 날 형님이라고도 부르고..

entries.en: &[Noa]# I… I accidentally broke one of my father's favourite bottles of liquor…
entries.ko: &[노아]# 아버지께서 아끼시던.. 고급 술을 깨뜨렸어요... 흐엉!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Huh… That doesn't sound like something I can help with…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 내가.. 도와줄 수 있는 게 아닌 것 같은데..

entries.en: &[Noa]# Yes you can! Ralph the Blacksmith can make a replacement!
entries.ko: &[노아]# 아니에요! 대장장이 랄프 아저씨가 그걸 조합할 수 있다구요!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Right... Shouldn't you be talking to Ralph instead of me, then?
&[Noa]# But I can't possibly ask him for liquor now, can I?
entries.ko: &[노아]# 제가 어떻게 아저씨한테 술을 달라고 그래요...

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Alright, point taken. What do you need me to do?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아, 그건 그렇다. 그럼 어떻게 해주면 될까?

entries.en: &[Noa]# Go see Ralph at the Blacksmith, then choose {Blacksmith Recipes#. You'll see a list of available items. From that list, select {Royal Winter Hearts#. I have the required ingredients right here.
entries.ko: &[노아]# 랄프 아저씨한테 가서 {일반 조합#을 선택하시면 여러 가지 물품이 나와요. 그중에서 {로얄 윈터하츠#를 만들어 주시면 돼요. 재료는 제가 드릴게요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# {Royal Winter Hearts# eh? What's in it for me?
&[Noa]# Er, if it's money you want, I don't really have any…
|[Kei]# Well now, I think it's about time for you to learn about something called "give and take", isn't it?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 너나 나나 세상을 배울 때 아니겠니.

entries.en: &[Noa]# OK, OK! I promise I'll get you something in return if you help me!
entries.ko: &[노아]# 후우.. 물건만 구해주시면.. 뭐든 준비해 볼께요..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Haha! Alright then, I'm looking forward to it.
{A Bottle of Wine, 5 Blue Potions} Obtained!
}New Quest! {Royal Winter Hearts}
&[Noa]# Ah, you're back!
|[Kei]# (Heh, cute kid. I wonder what he's got for me?)
|[Kei]# So how about that reward?
&[Noa]# Here you go, Kei! As promised!
&[Noa]# I found this at home... It was the most valuable thing I could find!
entries.ko: &[노아]# 이거... 집에서 좀 괜찮아 보이는 걸로 갖고 왔어요.

entries.en: You've got {the Seal of Gorem}!
|[Kei]# … Wow, this DOES look really valuable. Are you sure about this?
&[Noa]# Of course! Anything beats getting a scolding from my father.
|[Kei]# (I didn't think she'd be giving me anything of real value... She might end up in more trouble by giving me this!)
entries.ko: (이거 정말 귀한 것 같은데..이 녀석 이걸 나한테 줘서 더 크게 혼나는 거 아냐? )

entries.en: {Royal Winter Hearts} Quest Complete!
&[Eric]# A word of warning before you join the battle: Beware the Askran's {Fire Arms#.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 너도 이제 전장에 설 때구나.. 부디 아스크라놈들의 {총기#를 조심해라.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Those are weapons of terrible power. I didn't even know what hit me, at first…
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 그건 정말로 흉악한 무기야. 난 처음에 뭘 맞는 건지도 몰랐단다.

entries.en: |[Kei]# !!! Your leg…
&[Eric]# Yes... No more fighting for me.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 그래. 이제 난 싸울 수 없는 몸이 되었지만.

entries.en: &[Eric]# I'm counting on you to make sure those damned Askrans never get to lay a finger on us ever again!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 그 흉악한 아스크라놈들이 다시는 우리를 건드리지 못 하도록!

entries.en: &[Eric]# I may not be able to fight anymore, but I don't want to just sit here and do nothing.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 싸울 수는 없어도, 뭔가 솔티아에 힘이 되고 싶은데...

entries.en: &[Eric]# Kei, you do know that the light from the Holy Core is what fuels the Power of Nature, right?
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 케이, 우리가 홀리 코어를 통해 빛의 자연력을 사용한다는 건 알고 있지?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Of course I do. And Dark Magic harnesses the negative energy of the Holy Core.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 당연하죠. 어둠의 공격마법도 결국 빛의 자연력을 마이너스시켜서 사용하는 거잖아요.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Right! We understand each other then. Do you know about the {Holy Dust# that can be found at the Shrine of Light?
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 그렇다면 얘기가 빠르겠구나. 빛의 신당에서 나오는 {홀리 파우더#라는 걸 알고 있니?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Holy Dust? No, what is it?
&[Eric]# It's a type of magical dust that emits light. Listen, I have a theory: We may be able to enhance the Power of Nature through the use of this dust.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 빛이 나는 가루야. 그걸 사용하면 더 강한 자연력을 끌어낼 수 있지 않을까?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Really? Is that even possible?
&[Eric]# Maybe. It's just a theory right now. I want to study the dust so that I can be sure. If I can prove my theory, imagine just how useful it would be!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 한번 연구해 보고 싶다. 전장에 서지는 못하지만, 그게 가능하다면 나도 솔티아에 힘이 될 수 있을 거야.

entries.en: &[Eric]# I will need 10 {Holy Dust# from {the Shrine of Light#. Could you get them for me?
|[Kei]# Sounds like a piece of cake. Sure, I'll help!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 뭐 그 정도야. 제가 도울 수 있는 일은 도와 드려야죠.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Holy Dust}
&[Eric]# Remember, I need 10 {Holy Dust#, Kei!
&[Eric]# Ah, I knew you wouldn't let me down. You have my thanks!
|[Kei]# No problem. I'm glad to see you're up and about.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아니예요. 아저씨가 의욕에 넘치시니 저도 좋네요.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Here, you may have my old armor as a reward. It should serve you well in battle.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 그래. 보답으로 내가 입던 갑옷을 주마. 전장에서 널 지켜줄 거야.

entries.en: You've got the {Brigandine}!
&[Eric]# I promise your efforts will not go to waste!
{Holy Dust} Quest Complete!
&[Eric]# The Power of Nature comes from the light of the Holy Core.  It must be made stronger!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 우리가 사용하는 건 홀리 코어의 빛의 자연력. 이걸 더 강화시켜야 해.

entries.en: &[Mime]# Make sure you are well-prepared before leaving town.
entries.ko: &[마임]# 마을 밖을 나설 땐 준비를 철저히 해서 가야 해.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# Kei! It's time for you to learn about refining and compounds.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 케이 너도 이제 제련과 조합에 눈뜰 때구나.

entries.en: &[Paiz]# How am I supposed to make a living when all the men are at war?!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 남자들은 전부 전쟁터로 가서 생활이 힘들구나..

entries.en: |[Kei]# (Uh-oh, it's Mrs. Paiz! Hope she doesn't notice me… )
entries.ko: |[케이]# (어라, 페이즈 아줌마잖아... 제발 날 그냥 보내주시길...)

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Hey, Kei! You can hunt, right? Help me out here!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 오, 케이. 너도 이제 사냥을 다닐 수 있겠구나? 부탁 하나만 해도 되겠니?

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Uh, I wouldn't really call myself a real hunter just yet…
&[Paiz]# What's that supposed to mean?! How are you supposed to defend us from the Askrans if you keep goofing off like this?! When do you intend to grow up and take responsibility?!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 무슨 소릴 하는 거야. 아직도 그러고 있어서야 아스크라군과 싸울 수 있겠니? 언제 한 사람 몫을 해낼 거니, 도대체.

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Get out there and bring me 5 {Pine Twigs#! NOW! That's an order!
|[Kei]# Ye-yes ma'am! Right away!
}New Quest! {Mrs. Paiz's Order}#
&[Paiz]# How long is it going to take you to bring back 5 measly {Pine twigs#?! 10 years?! Get going!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# {잔 나뭇가지 5개#에 10년을 들일 셈이냐! 남자답게 늠름하게 좀 해내 봐!

entries.en: &[Paiz]# About time! You should feel like a man now!
|[Kei]# … Right. I'll take that as a compliment… I think.
&[Paiz]# Now you got to help me fix my roof. It leaks whenever it rains!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 그럼 집수리도 도와다오. 비가 새서 말이야...

entries.en: &[Paiz]# … You don't want to, do you?
&[Paiz]# Never mind. I'll get someone else to help me with that.
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 좋아. 무슨 일이 생기면 또 부르마.

entries.en: |[Kei]# (Phew... I was on the verge of screaming...)
&[Paiz]# Here, take these. They'll help you get stronger!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 자, 수련에 보태렴. 어서 강해져야 한다.

entries.en: {5 Potions} Obtained!
|[Kei]# (For some reason, I don't think I'll be getting stronger any time soon…)
{Mrs. Paiz's Order} Quest Complete!
&[Paiz]# How's your training coming along, Kei?
|[Kei]# It's going just fine, thanks!
} You do not have enough money (300 Gold) to pay for lodging.
|[Kei]# Sien must have done everything within her power.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그래, 정말 최선을 다한 건 내가 아니라 시엔이야.

entries.en: |[Kei]# This is no time for me to be moping around. She must be feeling even worse than I did!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 내가 풀죽어 있으면 안 되지. 시엔은 훨씬 힘들텐데...

entries.en: |[Kei]# I've got to go see her!
}New Quest! {Visit Sien}
|[Kei]# Something's wrong. The town... It's in chaos!
|[Kei]# Him?! What is he doing here in Neo Soltia?! What's going on?!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저.. 저 남자까지 네오 솔티아에!? 어떻게 된거지?

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Kei, go after him, quickly! He just assassinated the Elder!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 케이, 어서 저놈을 잡아! 장로님이 암살 당했다!

entries.en: |[Kei]# What?! The Elder's dead?!
^[Sien]# … Tener!
^[Qu]# What are you waiting for?! Get moving! The Askrans must not learn of the Elder's death!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 뭐하나, 케이!! 놈을 이대로 놓치면 아스크라에 장로님의 죽음이 알려져버려!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Damn it!
|[Kei]# The signal from the pendant - It's coming from the garrison to the southeast!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 신호는 남동쪽.. 군 주둔지? 역시 전장으로 간 거야!

entries.en: Without the Elder, and in the absence of Rhea, it fell upon Commander Qu to lead the combined armies of Neo Soltia.
entries.ko: 장로님도, 레아님도 없는 네오 솔티아를 지휘한 건 큐대장 님이었다.

entries.en: With the Askran forces driven back for the time being, the Neo Soltian forces took advantage of the brief respite.
entries.ko: 네오 솔티아의 전군은 아스크라군이 물러선 틈을 타 솔티아를 향했다.

entries.en: They marched towards Soltia, with the intent of retaking their homeland.
Sien made the ultimate sacrifice, and in doing so, saved countless lives…
However, the gears of war continued to turn…
entries.ko: 작은 전투를 멈췄을 뿐, 전쟁을 끝내진 못했던 거다..

entries.en: |[Kei]# … What do I do now, Sien?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 난 뭘 해야 하지? 모르겠어 시엔...

entries.en: |[Kei]# … I still visit the Shrine of Light from time to time, hoping you'll be there…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 지금도 빛의 신당에 가면.. 널 만날 수 있을 것 같은데..

entries.en: &[Noa]# That healing light… It saved all of us. What was that?
entries.ko: &[노아]# 지난번의 대전에서 모두를 치유해준 그 빛은 무엇이었을까요?

entries.en: &[Eric]# The battle - I should have been there, fighting with all the others!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 나도 갔어야 하는데, 우리의 고향을 지키기 위한 싸움에..

entries.en: &[Eric]# Oh, it's you, Kei. You've sure gotten a lot stronger lately! Hold on, I have something for you.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 오오, 케이. 너 정말로 강해졌구나. 잠시만 기다리렴.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Here you go, Kei. This suit of armor has been upgraded to provide much better resistance against Fire Arms.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 자, 이거란다 케이. 총기에 대한 방어력과 저항력을 크게 강화시킨 방어구지.

entries.en: {Dark Coat} Obtained!
&[Eric]# The Askrans should give you a lot less trouble while you are wearing this. I hope Commander Qu returns soon…
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 이걸로 아스크라와의 전쟁이 한결 수월해질 거야. 어서 큐 대장님이 돌아왔으면 좋겠구나!

entries.en: {Research on the Holy Core} Quest Complete!
&[Eric]# My research on the Holy Core has yielded an amazing discovery!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 나는 홀리 파우더를 연구하다가, 홀리 코어의 놀라운 효과를 찾았어.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Apparently, the Dark Magic generated from the negative energy of the Holy Core is extremely resistant against Fire Arms!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 홀리 코어의 마이너스 에너지, 즉 다크 마법이 총기에 대한 강한 저항력을 만들어 낸다는 거다!

entries.en: &[Eric]# Hey Kei, are you listening to me at all?
|[Kei]# Huh? Yeah, yeah, I'm listening.
&[Eric]# Pay attention! Now I apologize for this, but could you help me out again?
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 왜이리 넋이 나갔어. 미안한데 날 한번만 더 도와다오.

entries.en: &[Eric]# I'm going to need some strong material.. {Scorched Leathers# from Flame Coopers in the Nemesis Forest should do just fine.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 네메시스 숲에서 강한.. 그래, 플레임 쿠퍼들의 그을린 가죽이 좋겠구나.

entries.en: &[Eric]# Bring me 20 of those, and I should be able to create a powerful new suit of armor for you.
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 20개만 구해다 준다면 강력한 효과의 방어구를 만들수 있어. 네것도 만들어주마.

entries.en: |[Kei]# 20 {Scorched Leathers#? OK, I can do that!
}New Quest! {Research on the Holy Core}
&[Eric]# Remember, Kei - {20 Scorched Leathers# from Flame Coopers!
&[Paiz]# Even after bearing witness to the Holy Guardian's blessing, people still refuse to stop fighting...
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 홀리가디언의 가호를 보았음에도 사람들은 전쟁을 멈추지 않는구나..

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Well done, Kei. Are you feeling any better?
|[Kei]# A little... I guess hunting helps to take things off my mind.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아무 생각없이 사냥을 하니 마음이 조금 나아졌어요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Do you need help with anything else?
&[Paiz]# No, that'll be all for now. Looks like you're almost back to your old self again!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 아니다. 조금은 제 정신을 차린 것 같아 다행이구나.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Thanks, Mrs. Paiz.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 고마워요, 페이즈 아줌마. 저도 뭔가 생산적인 생각을 해야죠.

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Here, for your hard work. Stay sharp!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 자, 이건 내가 주는 심부름 값이다. 명심하렴, 이런 시기에는 멍하니 있어선 안 돼!

entries.en: {15,000 Gold} Obtained!
{Winter Clothing} Quest Complete!
&[Paiz]# You look really upset, Kei. Weren't you supposed to be heading for the battlefield?
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 왠지 힘이 없어 보이는 구나, 케이. 전장으로는 가지 않니?

entries.en: |[Kei]# … No, I guess not. Not right now, anyway.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 예, 지금은 아무것도 하고 싶지 않네요...

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Hey now, what's wrong with you?
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 아니 얘가, 젊은 녀석이 어째 그모양이야?

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Look, if you're not going to fight, maybe you could contribute in some other way.
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 전쟁에 나가는 게 꼭 옳은 일이라는 건 아니지만, 힘들 때는 뭐라도 해야되지 않겠느냐?

entries.en: |[Kei]# (Uh-oh, here we go again...)
&[Paiz]# Maybe you can help me provide winter clothing for people returning from the frontlines!
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 하다못해 나처럼 전쟁을 끝내고 돌아올 사람들을 위해 겨울옷이라도 만들던가!

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Alright. What do you need me to do?
&[Paiz]# Now that's more like it! I'm going to need more materials for winter clothing.
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 그래, 그런 생각이라도 해야지. 겨울 옷 재료를 구해오는 거면 어떻겠니?

entries.en: &[Paiz]# Bring me 20 {Pink Hairs#. You can get them from {Crazy Henges#, which should be pretty easy to find.
}New Quest! {Winter Clothing}
&[Paiz]# You need to get me 20 {Pink Hairs# from {Crazy Henges#. I'm sure you can handle that, right?
&[Noa]# Sometimes, I get the feeling that people are always looking for a excuse to get at each other's throats…
entries.ko: &[노아]# 가끔 이런 생각이 들어요. 사실은 다들 그냥 싸우고 싶은 것 뿐인게 아닌가..

entries.en: &[Eric]# The Askrans will pay for my lost leg!
entries.ko: &[에릭]# 아스크라에게 잃은 내 다리를.. 기필코 보상받을거야..

entries.en: &[Mime]# Potion sales have gone up lately. Looks like the monsters are getting stronger!
entries.ko: &[마임]# 이거 원, 몬스터들이 강해져서 물약 소비가 엄청 늘었어.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# We're going to need stronger weapons from now on!
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 이제 더 강한 무기로 무장하지 않으면 안 돼!

entries.en: You've delivered {50 Soul Stones}!
&[Ralph]# All right, this will do!
&[Ralph]# Hold on a minute!
&[Ralph]# Haha! My memory serves me well!
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 후후, 역시 내 기억은 틀리지 않았군.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# With the aid of magic, you can increase your defence as well as your accuracy.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 마법력을 통해 방어력 뿐만 아니라 명중률까지 증가시킬 수 있어.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# You should be able to find a lot of high-quality equipment in the Ruins of Soltia.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 이런 장비는 솔티아의 유적에 가면 쌔고 쌨을텐데...

entries.en: &[Ralph]# Whoever holds the Ruins of Soltia will obtain great power.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 정말로 솔티아의 유적을 지배하는 자가, 진정한 힘을 얻게 될거야.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# My job is to provide quality equipment, so this is for you!
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 이건 너에게 주지. 내 일은 장비를 만드는 데 까지니까...

entries.en: You've got an {Ancient Helm}!
{Ancient Magical Equipment} Quest Complete!
&[Ralph]# Magic is an important element in the creation of high-quality equipment.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 더 강한 장비의 개발을 위해선 마법력의 역할이 중요해.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# Soltia had many such powerful artifacts back in the day.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 과거 솔티아에는 그런 조화를 이룬 무기들이 수도 없이 많았지.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# From time to time, an incredibly powerful piece of equipment would be recovered from the Ruins. Unfortunately, it seems like all attempts to reproduce these items have met with utter failure.
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 가끔씩, 유적을 통해 발굴되던 마법 장비들은 그 위력이 타의 추종을 불허했다.

entries.en: &[Ralph]# I'd like to try and create such an item myself, for it would be a great challenge! Would you be willing to assist me?
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 내가 그런 무기에 도전한다면, 도와줄 의향이 있느냐?

entries.en: Yes
&[Ralph]# OK then, I'm going to need {50 Soul Stones#. You'll have to get them for me!
&[Ralph]# The process of forging ancient magical artifacts remains fresh in my mind!
entries.ko: &[랄프]# 나는 분명히, 고대의 마법장비를 만들 수 있는 조합을 기억하고 있으니까!

entries.en: }New Quest! {Ancient Magical Equipment}
No
&[Ralph]# Oh, what a shame…
&[Paiz]# Something doesn't feel right lately. Leaving town for even just a little while makes me feel uneasy.
entries.ko: &[페이즈]# 영 뒤숭숭해서.. 이제 마을밖도 함부로 못 나가겠어..

entries.en: Red Alert! The Elder has been assassinated!
|[Kei]# Him?! What is he doing in Neo Soltia?! What's going on?!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저.. 저 남자까지 네오 솔티아에!? 어떻게 된거지?

entries.en: |[Rits]# It's pretty peaceful here… They're not expecting any attacks here, are they?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# ... 조용하군.. 침입자가 있을 거란 예상은 안하는 건가.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Well… as long as the Canyon and the Plateau are completely blocked, I guess there's nothing to really worry about.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 하긴.. 네메시스 협곡과 고원쪽만 철통같이 막으면 되니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# No… I can't believe it…
^[Sien]# … Rest in peace, Tener.
^[Qu]# I never expected the Askrans to go this far…
|[Kei]# What do we do now? Reah's not here, either…
^[Qu]# You still don't get it, do you, Kei?!
^[Qu]# This is an act of war, Kei! Our only option is all-out war at this point!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 남은 건 전면전 뿐이야, 놈들은 선전 포고를 해온거다!!

entries.en: |[Kei]# This whole situation… It's even worse than I thought. Damn it, Reah, where are you?
^[Qu]# There is only one thing left to do!
^[Qu]# We must return to Soltia - where the ancient ruins of the Guardians still stand!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 솔티아.. 그곳에는 아직 가디언의 유적이 있어.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# With the power of the Guardian's relics on our side, the Askrans will be no match for us!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 고대 가디언의 유물들을 손에 넣는다면, 아스크라와 대등한.. 아니 더 막강한 힘을 가질 수 있을거야!

entries.en: |[Kei]# … The Guardian's relics?!
^[Sien]# Wait, you cannot just-
^[Qu]# It is time to show them what we Soltians are capable of!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 애초에 우리가 이룩한 역사고, 우리가 만든 힘이다!

entries.en: ^[Qu]# We march for the ruins!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 솔티아의 유적은 반드시 우리가 점령해야 해!

entries.en: |[Kei]# It looks like he's dead-set on carrying out his plan.
^[Sien]# No, I cannot allow this to happen!
^[Sien]# Using the power of the Guardians will endanger countless lives!
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 가디언의 힘 때문에.. 생명이 꺼져가는 걸...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Don't get any bright ideas, Sien!
^[Sien]# If what Gilberg said was true, then this is the end for me…
|[Kei]# The end?! Hold on, I'm not sure I like where this is going!
^[Sien]# Do not come after me, Kei.
^[Sien]# I am going to put an end to all of this!
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 전쟁을 멈출거야. 내 모든 힘을 다 써서라도..!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Not again! What's she up to this time?!
}New Quest! {Battle at the Plateau}
^[Qu]# I'm glad to see that you've returned safely, Kei. The raid on the factory didn't turn out as well as I'd hoped, though.
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 너도 무사히 귀환했구나. 그때의 공장 습격은 아쉬웠지?

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'm just happy to make it back here in one piece. I suppose it could have been worse…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 큐 대장님도 무사하셨군요.. 하지만 아쉽진 않아요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# In hindsight, it probably wasn't a very good idea.
^[Qu]# That was just a small part of the plan... But please excuse me, Kei. I need to speak with the Elder now. We'll talk more later.
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 그건 일보일 뿐이였어. 뭐 앞으로의 얘기는 차후에 하지. 지금은 장로님과 대화중이니...

entries.en: ^[Qu]# It seems to me that the Elder does not have the will to end this war…
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 장로님은 전쟁을 끝낼 의지가 없으신 건지..

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Do you expect me to just go along with that? What a joke!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 어째서 그런 결정을 제가 따라야 하죠?

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … Watch your tone, Qu. There is no need for such aggression.
^[Qu]# I don't care!
^[Qu]# The Askrans are occupying Soltian territory - OUR territory!
^[Qu]# The {Guardian's Relics# must not fall into Askran hands!
^[Tener]# The Relics are not so easily attainable, Qu.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 가디언의 유물은, 그렇게 쉽게 손에 넣을 수 있는 것이 아니야.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Have patience, and continue your talks with the Elgis. I assure you, there will be peace eventually.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 때를 기다려라. 엘지스와 계속 접촉하다보면, 평화를 잡을 수 있을 때가 올테니까.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Making a move now will only serve to provoke the Askrans further.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 지금 우리가 움직이면 안 그래도 큰 피해를 입은 아스크란들을 자극할 뿐이야.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# If we could regain the power we once had as Soltians, there would be no need for any sort of negotiations!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 솔티아의 힘을 되찾으면 대화따위 없어도 평화를 쟁취할 수 있단 말입니다!!

entries.en: |[Rits]# You two remind me of those people from the Corbus Guild and Elgis, heh.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 네오 솔티아에도 있군.. 코르버스 같은, 그리고 엘지스 같은 사람이...

entries.en: ^[Qu]# You! I know you! How dare you show your face here, Askran!
^[Tener]# An Askran?! Here?
|[Rits]# There are those who desire all-out war…
|[Rits]# And there are others who wish for peace.
|[Rits]# … Just like in Askra.
|[Rits]# You're in trouble now, you slimy worm!
^[Qu]# Watch your tongue!
^[Qu]# You don't really expect me to talk to something like this, do you, Elder?!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 장로님은 정말로 이런 놈들과 대화를 할 생각이신가요?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I didn't come here to listen to your crap, worm!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 네 놈처럼 공격을 위해 이곳에 온게 아니야..

entries.en: |[Rits]# I came here to deal with jerks like you!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 다만.. 네 놈만큼은 그대로 둬선 안될 것 같아서.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Oh you're a funny one, aren't you?!
|[Rits]# Listen to me, old man. Peace will never come to Erebos with men like him around!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 영감, 이런 놈이 있는 한 평화는 오지 않는다고.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'll take care of him.
^[Tener]# Wait, stop! I don't know why you are really here…
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 기, 기다리게! 어떻게 여기까지 왔는지는 모르지만...

entries.en: ^[Tener]# But nothing good can come from this!
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 서로에 대한 적대감으로는 얻을 수 있는 게 없어, 희생만을 부를 뿐..

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Soltians and Askrans need to learn to forgive each other…
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 노력하고 있네, 솔티안도 아스크란도.. 서로를 용서하기 위해…

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Ugh… Qu…!?
^[Tener]# You…
|[Rits]# You damned bastard, how dare you!?
^[Qu]# I have to thank you, you little pest. You couldn't have picked a better time to show up here! You've just made my life so much easier!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 잘 나타나 줬어, 회색 파리.. 덕분에 한결 편해지겠군..

entries.en: |[Rits]# What?!
^[Qu]# Who needs peace when you have war?!
^[Qu]# The total annihilation of the enemy is a lot more satisfying, isn't it?
^[Qu]# Feeling a little pressure, aren't you? It's not a bad idea to keep everyone on their toes from time to time!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 우리쪽도 좀 더 긴장할 필요가 있을 것 같아.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# After all, it's not uncommon for an assassin to appear right in the middle of enemy territory during a war, is it?
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 마을 한가운데에 {암.살.자.#가 나타나면 안 되잖아? 전시에..

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Somebody help! An assassin! We're under attack!
|[Rits]# That damned bastard!
|[Rits]# … Looks like this concludes negotiations!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이게... 평화를 원하는 이들의 결말이란 말이냐...!

entries.en: ^[Tener]# You're already 19 this year… How time flies.
|[Kei]# Yeah, I think I'm just about ready to join the army.
^[Tener]# This war… it should have ended a long time ago.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 긴 전쟁이다. 너희들이 자라기 전엔 끝냈어야 하는데..

entries.en: ^[Tener]# I only wish Ian had returned with Reah then...
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 레아와 함께 이안이 돌아와 주었다면 좋았을 것을..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Elder, what do you think about Ian?
^[Tener]# Well, things between the Crusaders and the Elder Council did not turn out as I hoped…
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 허허... 크루세이더와 장로회의 분쟁이 비극적으로 끝나긴 했지만..

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … But I've always thought that he had Soltia's best interests at heart.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 나는 믿고 있다. 그는 솔티아를 지키기 위해 움직였던 남자라고...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Could he be the one behind all this? Trying to destroy Soltia and the Guardians?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저는.. 가디언의 소멸과 솔티아의 붕괴가 그 때문이라면..

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Peace never lasts forever, Kei. Human nature dictates that. Even as a former member of the Elder Council, I understood Ian's motivations.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 케이, 그 평화는 영원할 수 없었다. 나 역시 장로회였지만 그를 이해해.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# All I desire is peace for all of us, but in order to achieve that, this senseless war must come to an end...
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 이 전쟁만 끝난다면.. 우린 그때보다 더 큰 자유와 평화를 희생 없이 누리게 될 거야.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … Sadly, I don't suppose that will happen anytime soon.
^[Tener]# Thank you for bringing Sien back safely, Kei.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 시엔을 무사히 데리고 돌아와 줘서 고맙다, 케이.

entries.en: |[Kei]# I was just doing my job as her Guardian Knight.
^[Tener]# … Please don't hold it against me for trying to hide her away. Too many people are after her for all the wrong reasons.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# ... 시엔을 숨겨두는 걸 나쁘게 생각하지 말거라. 그 아이의 힘은 노리는 자가 너무 많아.

entries.en: |[Kei]# (I'll never let anything happen to her!)
^[Tener]# You'll have to excuse me, Kei. I have matters to discuss with Qu.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 잠깐 자리를 비켜주겠니, 큐와 할 이야기가 있으니..

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … No, not yet.
|[Kei]# Hello Elder, I was just… huh?
^[Sien]# ... How much longer do I have to wait?
^[Tener]# Perhaps a year… maybe two.
^[Sien]# I do not believe I can wait that long. War is almost upon us…
^[Tener]# Believe me, Sien, I understand. But your safety is of the utmost importance. You must stay at the Shrine of Light for now.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 알고 있다, 시엔. 하지만 지금은 빛의 신당에 머물러 다오.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … Kei! You're not eavesdropping, are you?!
|[Kei]# Ack! Sorry!
^[Tener]# You wouldn't tell me whom you were meeting, even if I asked you, would you?
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 누굴 만나고 왔는지 물어도... 대답하지 않겠지.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# … And if I asked you who the girl was, you wouldn't tell me either, would you?
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그 소녀의 정체를 물어도, 대답하지 않으실테죠.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# I think we both know the answer to that question.
^[Reah]# Well then, it looks like we are at an impasse. We both have something to hide.
^[Tener]# Sien?! What are you doing here?!
^[Sien]# The Sky Kingdom of Soltia is beginning its descent. Are you prepared for that?
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 솔티아가 떨어지기 시작했어. 준비는 된 거야?

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … No, it can't be! That's too soon!
|[Kei]# What?! Soltia's coming down?!
^[Reah]# No wonder I felt a disturbance in the power of the Light earlier…
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 방금 전에 느껴진.. 불길한 자연력의 움직임이 설마..?

entries.en: ^[Sien]# We must get to the {Tower of Light#. That is the only way to prevent this catastrophe.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# {등대#에서 제대로 제어하지 못하면.. 대륙이 날아가 버릴지도 몰라.

entries.en: ^[Sien]# You… are not ready for this, are you, Tener?
^[Tener]# You're damned right I'm not ready! I haven't even been able to determine the exact location of the Tower yet!
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 도대체 누가.. 아직 등대의 위치조차 찾지 못 했는데..

entries.en: ^[Sien]# Then we cannot afford to wait any longer. I am leaving.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 더이상 기다릴 수 없어. 내가 가겠어.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Sien, wait!
^[Sien]# We must move now, Tener. Time is a luxury we do not have.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 우린 어서 움직여야 해. 우리에겐 시간이 없어.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# We all know what needs to be done, Tener.
^[Reah]# Even the most powerful Guardians need to be bound to a Refiner.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 리파이너가 필요없는 가디언 따위, 있을 리가 없죠.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# You know what will happen if she gets herself killed, don't you? Her Guardians will wreak havoc indiscriminately.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 어쩌실 건가요? 리파이너가 죽게 되면 가디언은 폭주할 거예요.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# And yet, Sien is the only one who can stop this disaster.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 하지만.. 그 아이가 아니면 솔티아의 추락을 막을 사람도 없겠죠?

entries.en: ^[Tener]# … I'm counting on Sien to return. The eventual descent of Soltia was inevitable.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# ... 시엔은 돌아온다. 그리고 솔티아의 추락은 언젠가는 닥칠 재앙이었어.

entries.en: ^[Tener]# Please excuse me. I need to think about how to deal with the aftermath of this catastrophe.
entries.ko: ^[테너]# 지금 필요한 건 솔티아 추락 후의 대책이다.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# If Soltia falls to earth, it will only result in all-out war.
|[Kei]# All-out war?!
^[Reah]# We're talking about widespread damage here. I can't even begin to imagine the devastation… and the Askrans will blame us for all of it.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 단순한 파편이 아니라 본체야. 대륙은 괴멸적인 타격을 입을거다.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Where do you think Sien is going?
^[Reah]# I wish I knew. If I had to guess, she's probably heading out towards Askra to look for clues that could help prevent this disaster.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 모르겠어. 아마, 추락을 막을 단서를 찾아 아스크라로 가지 않을까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# That's ridiculous! She has no sense of direction at all! I've got to go after her!
^[Reah]# What?! Hold it, Kei, you're not going anywhere.
|[Kei]# I have to protect Sien! It's my sworn duty as her Guardian Knight!
|[Kei]# Besides, she's trying to prevent the fall of Soltia! I've got to do everything in my power to make sure she succeeds!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그 녀석이 우리를 위해 솔티아의 추락을 막으려 한다면 더더욱!

entries.en: ^[Reah]# … For a second there, Kei, you reminded me of Ian.
^[Reah]# You're right. A Refiner will need a Guardian Knight at her side... Ian was just like you - stubborn as a mule.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그래, 리파이너에겐 수호기사가 필요하지. 이안도.. 그렇게 막무가내였어.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Go, and take this with you. It'll make it easier for you to find her.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 이걸 가져가렴. 그녀를 찾는 데 도움이 될 거야.

entries.en: {Signal Pendant B} Obtained!
^[Reah]# You can get to Askra through a canyon near the {Soltian Garrison# to the southeast.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# {마을 남동쪽 주둔지#에서 협곡으로 들어가면 아스크라로 갈 수 있긴 한데...

entries.en: ^[Reah]# The air in the canyon is toxic, though. Bring me some {Holy Water# from a {Blacksmith#, and I will tell you what to do from there.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 협곡은 독소가 강하니까, {주둔지의 대장장이#에게서 {성수#를 꼭 조합해 가도록 해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# You have faith in me?
^[Reah]# I believe that you will get the job done, Kei. Besides, I don't trust that jerk Qu.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 누군가는 해야 할 일이니까. 큐 같은 녀석보단 낫겠지.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Bear in mind that if a Refiner dies, the Guardians will go berserk and unleash their powers against all who cross their path.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 명심해, 케이. 리파이너의 죽음은 홀리 가디언의 폭주로 이어진다.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# The future of Soltia rests upon your shoulders, Kei. Be careful.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 솔티안들의 운명이 걸린 일이야. 부디 신중하게 행동해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Thanks, Reah!
{The Directionally-Challenged Girl} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Toxic Canyon}
^[Qu]# You'll be joining the battle soon, won't you?
|[Kei]# Yes, Sir.
^[Qu]# Have you seen any Askrans yet?
|[Kei]# Not yet, Sir.
^[Qu]# Show them no mercy, for they will give you none.
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 그들을 인간이라고 생각하지 마라. 놈들도 우리를 인간으로 보지 않으니까.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# This war will not end until they are driven away for good.
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 놈들을 아예 대륙 동쪽으로 몰아내지 않는 한, 전쟁은 끝나지 않아.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Stay focused at all times, or you won't be able to survive.
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 정신 바짝 차리지 않으면 살아남지 못한다.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Don't you find all this a little… unusual?
|[Kei]# A young girl overpowering a beast, just like that! What's more, the Elder seems to be hiding something.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 비스트를 압도하는 소녀라니. 게다가 촌장님은 뭔가 숨기려 하고..

entries.en: |[Kei]# You know what's going on, don't you?
^[Reah]# Kei, do you know what a {Refiner# is?
|[Kei]# Yeah. A Refiner is a medium, a living bridge between humanity and the Guardians.
|[Kei]# … Hold up. You mean to say that girl is…
|[Kei]# But didn't the Elder tell us that the Holy Guardian had no need for a Refiner?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 하지만 홀리 가디언은 리파이너가 필요없다고 장로님이...

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Sadly, absolute power does not come without a terrible cost, Kei.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 누구도 희생하지 않고 강대한 힘을 얻을 수는 없어, 케이.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# To wield the power of a Guardian, a price must always be paid: That of the Refiner's life.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 리파이너는 자신의 생명을 깎아 가디언의 힘을 우리에게 준다.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Ian and I once fought alongside each other to put an end to that.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 나와 이안은 그 희생을 끝내기 위해 싸웠었지.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# It seems like the Holy Guardian is no exception to the rule…
|[Kei]# … The Elder lied to us?!
|[Kei]# Are you saying that Sien's life is at stake?!
^[Reah]# I'm just assuming for now. I need to find out more about the girl before I can be sure.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 아직은 짐작일 뿐이야. 일단 그 소녀.. 에 대해 알아봐야겠구나.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# You said Tener sent her to the Shrine of Light, didn't you?
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 테너가 그 아이를 빛의 신당으로 보냈다고 그랬지?

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Go find her, and give her this {Pendant#.
{Signal Pendant A} Obtained!
^[Reah]# You've always wanted to put an end to this war, Kei.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 전쟁을 끝내고 영웅이 되고 싶다고 했었지, 케이.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# That girl could be the key to achieving that.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 어쩌면 그 아이가 전쟁을 끝낼 열쇠가 될지도 몰라.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# I'm sorry to make you do this, but please, keep an eye on her for me.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 힘들겠지만, 그 옆에 붙어서 계속 감시해다오.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# And keep this strictly between us. I don't want to cause a fuss.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그리고 사람들이 동요할 수 있으니 이 임무는 반드시 비밀로 하고.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# I'll see what else I can do on my end to help.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 나는.. 내가 할 수 있는 일을 할 테니.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Wow. I can't believe it!
|[Kei]# What do you mean "I'm sorry"! This is the best assignment you've ever given me, Reah!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 힘들리가요! 이렇게 아름다운 임무를 저에게 주시다니 레아님 만세!

entries.en: |[Kei]# I can get to the {Shrine of Light# by heading through the Nemesis Forest. I'm on it!
entries.ko: |[케이]# {빛의 신당#은 네메시스 숲 따라 계속 가면 나오잖아요? 맡겨두세요!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Getting through the forest won't be a problem for me!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 네메시스 숲이야 뭐, 뜨거워진 제 심장에는 기별도 안간다구요!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Alright, I better get going! Sien, here I come!
{Somewhere in Town} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Best Assignment Ever}
{CHAPTER 1; The Girl Who Tamed the Beast#
^[Reah]# Like I said, you've got to join the military first.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그러니까 일단, 정규군은 되어야 할 것 아니냐.

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'm already trying my best!
^[Reah]# Listen, you are a very talented young man. Maybe you'll even get to play a big part in ending this war…
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 넌 재능도 있고, 아마 전쟁을 끝내는 데도 큰 기여를 할 수 있을거야.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Really? You think so too?
^[Reah]# ...But you never ever see things through. So I find it hard to believe you when you say you're trying your best.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그런데 너무 끈기가 없어. 노력하고 있다는 말은 믿을 수가 없네.

entries.en: |[Kei]# You're wrong! I'm always training myself to the point where it feels like my heart is burning out!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그건 잘못된 편견이예요! 저는 언제나 심장이 타버릴 정도의 수련을..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Oh really? Actions speak louder than words, so you've got to prove it to me. Here, take this.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 말로만 심장 태워먹지 말고 이걸로 증명 해봐.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Huh?
{Reah's Training List} Obtained.#
|[Kei]# This… what is this?
^[Reah]# What are you waiting for? Get going! Like I said, you're not going to end the war with just empty words, so get out there and prove yourself through action!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 가봐. 전쟁을 끝내겠다는 의지는 좋은데, 문제는 행동하는 거 아니겠어?

entries.en: {CHAPTER 7; Miracle on the Battlefield#
|[Kei]# … It really happened. Just like they said it would.
|[Kei]# I feel like such a failure… After all we've done, we still couldn't prevent the disaster.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아스크라까지 가서 바보짓만 하다 온 것 같은 기분이에요..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Don't be too hard on yourself, Kei. You did what you could, given the circumstances.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그나마 사막에 떨어졌기 때문에 마을 하나에서 피해가 그친거야.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Think about what might have happened if Soltia had fallen into the ocean instead. It would have been a lot worse than this.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 바다나 산맥 같은 곳에 떨어졌으면 엄청난 천재지변이 있었겠지.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# The Askrans, they might not appreciate what you've done here, but still…
^[Reah]# I believe you two have accomplished something truly great. You should be proud.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 너희들은 큰 일을 해낸거야, 낙심하지 마.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Heh.
|[Kei]# All I did was find some stupid Tower, and bring Soltia down in Enzak. Getting out of there in one piece was a fluke.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 등대를 찾은 것도, 솔티아를 엔자크로 이끈것도, 살아 돌아온 것도...

entries.en: |[Kei]# … I couldn't have done any of that without Sien. She's always been the driving force behind all of this… Not me.
|[Kei]# I've just been following her around like a fool, making a mess of everything…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저는 바보같이 끌려다니기만 했지.. 결과는 항상 엉망이었어요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Come to think of it, do you think Sien is OK?
^[Reah]# Well, Tener has sent her to {Shrine of Light#, as usual. I haven't heard from her since.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 글쎄... 테너의 뜻에 따라 {빛의 신당#에 혼자 보내진 뒤로는 특별한 일이 없었으니까.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Why don't you go see her? It might cheer you up.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 풀 죽어 있지 말고, 찾아가보는 건 어때?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wouldn't the {Shrine of Light# be forbidden to visitors now? I don't think the Elder wants to take any more chances with her…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 하지만 테너님이 {빛의 신당#을 다시 봉인하셨을 거예요..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# I suppose so. That sounds like what he would do.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 뭐, 원래 장로회는 항상 리파이너를 숨기려는 습성이 있지만..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# But, I would think that a Guardian Knight would be exempt from such restrictions.
^[Reah]# She's having a hard time, Kei. As her Guardian Knight, it is your duty to comfort her in her time of need.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그 아이도 힘들어 하고 있을텐데, 수호기사가 좀 달래줘야지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … You're right!
|[Kei]# I have to be there for her!
^[Reah]# … You seem to have grown up a little, Kei. About time!
^[Reah]# Back when I said you were talented, I meant it. You did your best.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 재능이 있다는 건 진심이었어. 열심히 해봐.

entries.en: |[Kei]# By the way, I ran into someone named {Kenneth# in the ruins.
|[Kei]# Isn't he the one who fought alongside Ian to end the conflict between the Elder Council and the Crusaders?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그 이안과 함께 장로회와 크루세이더의 분쟁을 마무리지었다는.. 맞죠?

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Kenneth…? What's he up to now?
|[Kei]# He told me Gilberg planned to bring down Soltia and seal off the Guardians forever.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 굴베이그의 뜻이.. 솔티아를 떨어트리고 가디언을 영원히 봉인하는 것이라고 했어요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# And that… he was going to finish what Gilberg started.
^[Reah]# He's a dangerous man, Kei. That sort of thing would have serious consequences on the entire world.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 위험한 남자야. 자신의 뜻을 위해서는 온 세계를 이용하는..

entries.en: |[Kei]# The entire world… He must be pretty sure of himself to try to pull off something like that.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 온 세계를.. 그 위압감은 그런 자신감에서 나오는 거로군요..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# I don't know if he's doing the right thing or not…
entries.ko: ^[레아]# ... 그 사람의 정의도 틀린 것은 아니지만...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Huh?! How can there be a good side to what he's planning to do?
^[Reah]# Who are we to judge between right and wrong, Kei?
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 명심해, 케이. 이 세계에 절대적인 정의란 건 없어.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Every individual does what they want for a reason.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 모두 다 각자의 정의를 위해 움직이지.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# You need to know what you stand for, so that you won't be swayed easily.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그 소용돌이에 휩쓸리지 않기 위해선, 너도 너만의 정의를 굳게 세워야해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# What I stand for… I guess I don't really know for sure yet.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 각자의 정의.. 저도 이번 여행에서 그걸 느끼긴 했어요..

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'll keep that in mind, Reah.
^[Reah]# You must always do what you firmly believe is right, no matter what the consequences may be.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 네가 옳다고 생각하는 것을 해. 결과를 두려워 말고.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# You seem to have grown stronger, Kei.
|[Kei]# Thanks... Speaking of which, I've completed the tasks you have given me.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아.. 그러고보니, 레아님이 주신 과제도 끝냈어요.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Looks like you've been working pretty hard!
|[Kei]# I just did my best.
^[Reah]# I suppose you deserve a reward. After all, it must have been pretty hard on you.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 그럼 선물을 줄까..? 힘든 과제를 완수했으니.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wow! I wasn't actually expecting a reward for this, but thanks, Reah!
{Strength Earring} Obtained!
&[Amy]# You're welcome to stay here. All you need to do is to make a contribution of 300 Gold.
entries.ko: &[에이미]# 운영비 300G만 보태면, 누구나 쉴 수 있는 쉼터입니다.

entries.en: Rest.
Don't rest.
&[Amy]# You've sure grown up, Kei. Would you like to take a rest?
Pay 300 Gold for a rest.
&[Amy]# Oh, you have returned! And you have the box, too!
|[Kei]# Hey… you didn't think I'd get it done? I've gotten a lot stronger lately, you know.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 절 못믿으신 거예요? 저도 이제 제법 한다구요.

entries.en: &[Amy]# Well done, Kei! Shall we take a look at what's inside?
entries.ko: &[에이미]# 그래, 장하다. 그럼.. 한번 확인해 보자.

entries.en: |[Kei]# OK, let's open it…
&[Amy]# Wow.. What a beautiful gem!
|[Kei]# It's called a Soul Stone.
&[Amy]# A Soul Stone? I suppose this is the "special item" that the Elder was talking about, then?
entries.ko: &[에이미]# 영혼석? 이게.. 장로님이 말씀하신 중요한 물건일까?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Definitely! Do you mind if I hold on to it?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 틀림없어요. 언젠가 꼭 필요해질 거예요. 제가 보관해도 될까요?

entries.en: &[Amy]# Oh, go right ahead. Like I said, the Elder would have wanted someone trustworthy to have it.
entries.ko: &[에이미]# 그래, 그러렴. 장로님도 믿을 만한 사람한테 맡겨주길 바라셨으니까... 찾아온 네가 제격이겠지.

entries.en: &[Amy]# Please keep the Soul Stone safe, Kei!

entries.en: &[Robyn]# If you say so, Kei. I'll only believe it when I see it! Bring me {30 Rat Leathers# from the {Shrine of Light#.
}New Quest! {A Map for Robyn}
&[Robyn]# {30 Rat Leathers# from the {Shrine of Light#! Don't try too hard, Kei, haha!
&[Instructor]# Would you like me to instruct you on the {Basics of Hunting#?
Weapon Properties
&[Instructor]# It is very important to understand the properties of the weapons you wield.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #제일 먼저, 자신이 사용하는 무기의 특성을 파악하는 것이 중요하다.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# A {Spear# has low offensive power, but it allows you to equip a {Shield# at the same time, which grants high {Defense# and a chance to block the enemies' attacks.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #{스피어#는 공격력이 약하지만, {방패#를 추가로 들 수 있어 {방어력#이 높고 때로는 적의 공격을 완전히 방어한다.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# The {Sword# has high offensive power and a wide attack range. It also has very high {Accuracy#, but your attacks will be slow.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #{스워드#는 범위가 넓고 공격력이 강하며 매우 높은 {명중률#을 갖지만, 공격 속도가 느리지.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# The {Knife# has a narrow attack range, but its attack speed is very fast. It also grants you a very high {Evasion Rate#.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #{나이프#는 범위가 좁지만 빠른 공격이 가능하며 매우 높은 {회피율#을 가질 수 있다.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Magic can have many different properties. For example,  {Dark# magic focuses on offensive abilities such as {Attack# and {Curse# while {Holy# magic focuses on defensive abilities such as {Recovery# and {Assistance#.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #또한 마법 역시 특징이 나뉘어, {다크# 쥬엘은 {공격과 저주#에, {홀리# 쥬엘은 {회복과 보조#에 초점이 맞춰져 있어.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# All classes are able to wield 2 types of weapons. Always bear in mind the advantages of each weapon type in order to make the most out of them.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #모든 클래스는 이중 2개의 무기를 사용한다. 각 무기들의 장점을 기억하고, 특화시키는 것이 강해지는 길임을 기억해라!

entries.en: Effective Attack
&[Instructor]# Every class is capable of two basic offense types. You may perform a combo with your main weapon (tap the main weapon icon), or your secondary weapon (tap the secondary weapon icon).
entries.ko: &[교관] # 각 클래스는 두 종류의 기본공격을 가진다. 주무기(주무기 아이콘 누르기)나 보조 무기(보조 무기 아이콘 누르기)로 콤보를 사용할 수 있지.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Both weapons can be used together for devastating combos. For example, try hitting with your main weapon twice and then one more time with your secondary weapon. Try alternating between weapons during a fight to discover new combos.
entries.ko: &[교관]# 이 두 무기를 함께 쓰면 강력한 콤보를 사용할 수 있지. 예를 들면, 주무기를 두 번 사용하고 보조 무기를 한 번 사용하는 식이지. 전투 시 무기를 번갈아 가면서 사용하여 새로운 콤보를 찾아봐.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Using your secondary weapon in a combo is very beneficial as you would not need to waste time changing your equipped weapon.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #보조 무기의 경우 바로 사용하면 무기를 교체하는 시간이 필요하므로, {콤보로 사용하는 것이 효과적#이야.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Also, the amount of {Mana recovered varies depending on the combos you perform.
entries.ko: &[교관]# # 또한, 콤보를 어떻게 조합하느냐에 따라 {마나가 회복되는 양도 천차만별이지.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Finding the optimal combo will speed up the rate of Mana recovery, allowing you to use powerful skills more frequently. This is the secret to an effective offense!
entries.ko: &[교관]# # 최적의 콤보를 찾아, 빠르게 마나를 채워 강력한 스킬을 사용하는 것. 이것이 바로 효율적인 공격의 비밀이다.

entries.en: Enemy Disposition
&[Instructor]# It is not wise to attack the enemy blindly without a plan. All enemies have their own unique characteristics.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #필드로 나간다고 무작정 적을 후려쳤다간 낭패를 보기 쉽다. 적들에게도 특징이란 게 있으니까.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# A {Peaceful Enemy# will not attack you without warning. A {Hostile Enemy#, however, will immediately attack you on sight.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #{평화적인 놈#은 먼저 싸움을 걸어오지 않고 얌전하지만, {호전적인 놈#들은 눈이 마주치면 바로 싸움을 걸어오지.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# Peaceful enemies are usually found in the fields out in the open, while hostile enemies are found in the dungeons.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #보통 필드에는 평화적인 놈들이 많고, 던전에는 호전적인 놈들이 많아.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# However, in some cases, peaceful enemies may actually be more dangerous. For example, they have a tendency to retaliate in a group, even if you attacked only one of them.
entries.ko: &[교관] #하지만 때론 평화적인 놈들이 더 위험할 수 있어. {한 놈을 치면 여러 마리가 몰려드는# 경우가 있거든.

entries.en: &[Instructor]# When entering a new area for the first time, it is recommended that you figure out the propensity of the enemies first.
entries.ko: &[교관]# #새로운 사냥터에 들어서면, 우선적으로 적의 성향을 파악하는데 주력하는 것이 좋을 거다.

entries.en: No, thank you
&[Trainee]# {Secondary Active Skills# are highly effective, so you will want to use them whenever you can.
entries.ko: &[수련생]# #{보조 액티브 스킬#들은 매우 높은 효과를 가지니, 가능하면 항상 달고 다니도록 해.

entries.en: &[Trainee]# During PVP, you must remember to use {Shot against Evade#, }Defense against Shot#, |Offense against Defense#, and {Evade against Offense#.
entries.ko: &[수련생]# #기억해 둬. PVP에서 {회피는 명중#으로, }명중은 방어#로, |방어는 공격#으로, {공격은 회피#로 잡는거야.

entries.en: &[Beggar]# Do we have to wait for another hero to come along..?
&[Shop owner]# Welcome, we do our best to serve you with the best!
entries.ko: &[상점]# 어서 오세요, 항상 좋은 물건으로 모시겠습니다!

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# Torez's refining skills are second to none.
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 토레즈의 제련 기술은 그 어느곳에도 뒤지지 않습니다!
