entries.ko: &[토레즈 시민]# 요즘은 엔자크의 난민들 때문에 시청이 항상 개방되어 있어요. 어차피 주요인사는 전장으로 나가있지만.

entries.en: |[Rits]# We're in Torez? How did we get here?
^[Helene]# Heh... I call it the {Gryphon Flute#...
|[Rits]# You teleported us out of there? Impressive.
^[Helene]# Yes... I am rather impressive… aren't I? Oho…
|[Rits]# Hey… What's wrong with you?
|[Rits]# … No! No, damn it!
^[Helene]# Yeah… he got me…
|[Rits]# An assassination round…?!
^[Helene]# Just as I thought… The Corbus guild is after the Guardians' power…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 예상대로.. 야.. 코르버스 길드는.. 가디언의 힘을 원해..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I don't think they want me interfering with their plans with the Nixcore…
|[Rits]# Don't talk! … Aw hell, you're bleeding pretty badly…
^[Helene]# I… I don't fear death, Rits…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 바보는.. 죽음을 두려워 하지 않아, 리츠...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I only fear that…
^[Helene]# My death… would mean nothing…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 내 죽음이.. 의미 없는 것이 되지.. 않을까 하는...

entries.en: |[Rits]# No… you foolish girl!
^[Helene]# Like my dad always used to say… Mankind cannot hope to make progress… without sacrifice…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 인간은.. 희생이 없으면.. 진보할 수 없데...

entries.en: |[Rits]# That's nonsense and you know it!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그런 말도 안 되는 소리가 어딨어!

entries.en: |[Rits]# I don't need a sacrifice now... Don't you die on me!
^[Helene]# I didn't believe it either…
^[Helene]# But… I don't want to die without having achieved anything…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만.. 나 이렇게.. 아무것도 못하고 죽으면...

entries.en: |[Rits]# NO! You're NOT going to die!
^[Helene]# It's too late for me… Rits…
^[Helene]# Please… will you do me one last favour?
^[Helene]# Rally the remaining members of Elgis…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 각지에 흩어져 버린.. 엘지스를.. 재결성 해줘..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# And end the war… together with them…
^[Helene]# The Nixcore… it must be completed…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 솔티안들과 함께.. 이 닉스 코어.. 완성해 줘...

entries.en: |[Rits]# I've never asked anything of you, even when I helped you out!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 보상금 한번 제대로 준적 없는 주제에...

entries.en: |[Rits]# Now all I'm asking is that you don't die on me like this!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이딴 의뢰나 남기고.. 멋대로 죽을 생각이냐!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Ah… You're right…
^[Helene]# I've never given you anything in return for your aid, have I?
^[Helene]# It's probably not enough… but it's all I have left…
Her trembling lips touched my cheek ever so lightly…
entries.ko: 떨리는 입술을; 조심스럽게 내 뺨에 대고

entries.en: And with that, Helene closed her eyes…
Never to open them again.
How much more will this senseless conflict take from me?!
{CHAPTER 9; What Must be Prevented#
The ones who continue to fan the flames of war go unpunished…
While the people who do all they can to end the fighting…
are the ones who suffer the consequences.
It's no longer about what I believe in, or where my loyalties lie.
This war is evil. I have to stop it.
|[Rits]# … I'll take it from here, Helene.
|[Rits]# Not just for you... but also for all the lives lost to this war.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 너만이 아니라.. 내 앞에서 전쟁에 휩쓸린 모든 죽음을 보상으로...

entries.en: |[Rits]# … That is my parting gift to you.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 네 영혼이 이 땅을 떠나기 전에 보여주겠어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'll gather the remaining members of Elgis back together again… and put a stop to this war once and for all!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 반드시 흩어진 엘지스를 다시 모아.. 전쟁을 끝내고..

entries.en: |[Rits]# I will see to it that your wish comes true. This I swear!
{Gryphon Flute} Obtained!
{The Final Step} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Passing the Torch}
&[Government Official]# I'll do my part to serve the citizens of Torez!
&[Government Official]# Hmm, the production output of the Ironware Factory has to be increased…
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 흠.. 철기공장의 가동시간을 좀 더 늘릴려면...

entries.en: &[Government Official]# We should have enough supplies to support the war effort against Soltia.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 솔티안과의 전쟁 물자는 본국으로부터 충분히 지원되고 있어.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# The people of Rowen are always unhappy about something. What a nuisance!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 로우엔 녀석들은 항상 불만만 한 가득이라 짜증나.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# The monsters are giving us bigger problems than the Soltians!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 난 솔티안들보다 몬스터들이 더 골 아파...

entries.en: &[Government Official]# What?! They refuse to aid us?!
&[Government Official]# … Those arrogant bastards! The nerve on them!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 이이.. 건방진 녀석들이!! 한낱 시골 마을 놈들이 현 세태를 파악하지 못하고...!!

entries.en: &[Government Official]# … Still, you did your job. I suppose I can't blame you for that.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 알겠네, 알겠어. 보수 주면 될 것 아닌가.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# Jeez... I'm paying good money and getting nothing in return…
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 이건 뭐.. 얻은 것도 없이 돈만 날리는군.

entries.en: {The Land of Chaos} Quest Complete!
&[Government Official]# The monsters have gotten stronger lately... What are we going to do about that?
&[Government Official]# Now that Enzak is gone, I have no choice but to get help from Rowen…
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 엔자크도 사라져버린 마당에 이제 로우엔과 협력할 수 밖에 없군.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# In times like these, I suppose I'll take any help I can get.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 그녀석들도 발등에 불이 떨어졌으니 협조 해주긴 할텐데..

entries.en: &[Government Official]# The problem is, I can't even get in contact with them!
&[Government Official]# Young man, would you be willing to deliver a message to Rowen for me? I'll pay you, of course!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 혹시 용병이라면, 보수는 넉넉히 줄테니 로우엔과 연락책을 해주지 않겠나?

entries.en: &[Government Official]# Thank you! Please, you have to get this message to the government officials in Rowen.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 고맙네, 이 서신을 로우엔의 공무원들에게 전해주게.

entries.en: {Message from Torez} Obtained!
&[Government Official]# It's not going to be easy getting there!
}New Quest! {The Land of Chaos}
Nah, not interested.
&[Government Official]# Have you delivered the message yet? You won't be paid until you do!
|[Rits]# This is the City Hall of Torez, isn't it?
|[Rits]# The doors are always locked. but that's nothing out of the ordinary.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 항상 문을 걸어잠궈 놓더니.. 별거 없군 그래.

entries.en: [??]# … you … think so!
|[Rits]# I think I hear someone on the second floor!
^[Able]# Haha! Refugees from Enzak, eh? I guess they're in pretty big trouble, aren't they?
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 허허, 엔자크의 난민들에.. 솔티안들까지 들고 일어나니, 한시도 쉴틈이 없군요.

entries.en: ^[Able]# The {Factory in Rowen#? Are you sure about this?
^[Melpheto]# {His# information has never been wrong.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 지금까지 {그 남자#의 예측이 빗나간 적이 있었습니까?

entries.en: ^[Able]# Finally! We can round up those Elgis idiots in one fell swoop!
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 드디어 일망타진 할 수 있겠군, 그 반동분자들을 말이야.

entries.en: ^[Able]# Continue to carry out your orders. I'll take care of the rest.
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 뒷수습는 내가 알아서 할테니, 깨끗하게만 처리해 주게.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Well then, I'll leave it up to you, Mayor.
^[Able]# Haha! Those idiots have been a thorn in my side for too long!
^[Melpheto]# Only fools would push for peace during a time like this!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 이런 시대에 평화를 외치는 건 어리석은 짓이죠.

entries.en: ^[Able]# If not for the war, Torez would not enjoy the prosperity it does today!
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 토레즈가 전쟁을 통해 얼마나 발전했는지 뻔히 아는 놈들이...

entries.en: ^[Able]# It's time we got rid of those meddling idiots!
^[Melpheto]# With Elgis gone, all-out war would be inevitable, wouldn't it?
^[Able]# Of course! You already know the answer to that question!
^[Able]# As long as the war drags on, weapons will always be in short supply! That can only mean more potential profit for arms manufacturers like us!
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 계속 국가 지원을 받고 무기를 만들어 팔려면 전쟁이 끝나선 안 돼.

entries.en: ^[Able]# We'll need to maintain a constant level of… tension between the two nations, don't you agree?
^[Able]# At the end of the day… War is nothing more than a business. A large-scale one, to be sure. But a business just the same.
entries.ko: ^[에이블]# 전쟁이란 건 말일세. 결국 좀 큰 규모의 사업일 뿐이라고, 수비대장.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I know you're young, but you'll be in big trouble if you cause a fuss.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 아무 혈기왕성한 때라도, 소동부리고 다니면 큰일나는 거 알지?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Be careful! Enzak is probably under the influence of the Corbus Guild now!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 조심해, 아마 엔자크도 코르버스의 영향권 아래 있을거야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Ah, you found one. Excellent!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 아예 정품 시민증을 구해와버렸구나.. 능력 좋은데?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Eh, I got lucky.
^[Helene]# It'll be easy to produce a forgery with this. Give me a minute!
|[Kei]# Citizen of Torez: Kei Shulheim... That's perfect!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 토레즈 시민 케이 슈 하임.. 감쪽 같아요!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Ohoho, but of course! I'm the best there is at what I do!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 내가 좀 완벽해. 이래 봬도 토레즈 제일가는 기술자라구.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Now, listen carefully. To the east of Torez are the {Plains of Rowen#. The town of {Rowen# is to the south.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 토레즈 동쪽으로 나가면 {로우엔 평원#이야. 그리고 남쪽으로 {로우엔#이 있어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Find the Blacksmith named {Robe# in town, and tell him I sent you.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# {대장장이 로브#씨를 찾아가서, 엘시즈와 접촉하고 싶다고 말하면 돼.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Alright, got it. Thanks, Helene, I really appreciate your help.
^[Helene]# Oh, don't mention it. I'm just looking out for everyone.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 천만에. 난 내가 할 수 있는 최선을 한 것 뿐이야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# If the Kingdom of Soltia really comes crashing down, you are the only people we can trust to set things right.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 만약 솔티아가 정말로 떨어지는 거라면, 우린 너희밖에 믿을 사람이 없으니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wait… You knew about that all along?
^[Helene]# Yes, though I find it hard to believe. It's difficult to imagine a catastrophe of that scale…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 완전히 믿을 순 없어. 보이지도 않는 대륙이 떨어진다는 거니까.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# For all I know, this could all be part of some Soltian conspiracy to get you and Sien into Askra for some nefarious reasons…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 솔티안의 음모일지도 모르지. 너나 시엔을 아스크라에 침투시켜 뭔가 꾸밀 수도 있는 거고..

entries.en: |[Kei]# What?! No, that's not true!
^[Helene]# I know, Kei. I know. I believe your intentions are good. That's why I'm helping you.
^[Helene]# As a member of Elgis, an organization that desires peace with Soltia, it's the least I can do.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 솔티안과 화해를 원하는 엘시즈니까, 앞장서서 믿어야겠지?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# So please, don't let me down. I'm putting my faith in you.
^[Helene]# … Tin Face? You mean the Masked Warrior, don't you?
|[Kei]# Yeah… And he's always telling me what to do! I can't stand his arrogance!
^[Helene]# Please, don't say that. His presence here keeps the city safe from Soltian attack, and I'm grateful for that.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그렇게 말하지 마, 그래도 그 사람 덕에 솔티안 군도 이쪽으로 못 쳐들어오고 있는 거야. 우리 입장에선 고마운 사람이지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# That's nonsense! Even without him, you have nothing to fear from us! We've got no reason to attack this place.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 흥, 저희는 그 사람 없어도 쳐들어올 생각 따위 없다고요!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Those are very comforting words, coming from a Soltian. But still, the Black Factory suffered an attack just a few days ago.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그러면 다행이지만.. 요번에 검은 공장이 습격당한 걸 보면 다 그렇지도 않은 것 같아.

entries.en: |[Kei]#  That was... probably an attempt to end hostilities by destroying your ability to create Fire Arms.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그건... 총기를 좀 줄여서 전쟁을 끝내려던 게 아닐까요?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# But the factory produces more than just Fire Arms. If the attack had succeeded, the entire population of Torez would have been affected.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그 공장, 총기만 만드는게 아니야. 문제가 생기면 토레즈의 생활 자체가 힘들어 진다구.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# The victims see it as an act of aggression, nothing more.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 당하는 쪽에선.. 쳐들어오는 걸로밖에 안 보여.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Besides, the idea that the war will end simply by cutting off the supply of Fire Arms is somewhat naïve, isn't it?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 뭣보다 총기만 없으면 전쟁이 끝날 거라고 생각하다니, 너무 단순한 생각이잖아.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# And you know what? All this is happening because Soltians and Askrans know next to nothing about each other!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 서로에 대해 너무 모르니까 이런 일도 벌어지는 거지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … I guess you're right.
^[Helene]# I wish to overcome this ignorance. To eliminate this mutual hatred. To end this war!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 이제부터 알아가면 되겠지? 전쟁을 끝내기 위해서라도.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wow. I couldn't have said it better myself.
^[Helene]# Ohoho, of course! I have a way with words, don't I?
^[Helene]# Ahem… Please excuse me. Anyway, since the Masked Warrior has vouched for you, I suppose I could let you meet the girl.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 음.. 어쨌든 가면의 검사가 너를 내게 보냈다는 건, 그 소녀를 만나게 해주라는 거 같아.

entries.en: |[Kei]# You mean Sien? Do you know where she is?!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아, 알고 있나요? 시엔이 어디 있는지!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Of course. She's currently under the protection of the {Elgis#.
|[Kei]# What's Elgis?
^[Helene]# Elgis is an organization composed of like-minded individuals who wish to make peace with Soltia.
^[Helene]# The Masked Warrior brought Sien to us, as she wanted access to the artifacts we recovered from the Refiner's Ruins.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 시엔은 우리가 리파이너의 유적에서 발굴한 자료들을 원했고, 그래서 가면의 검사는 그녀를 우리에게 보냈어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Oh, did I mention that I was the one who discovered the Refiner's Ruins?
|[Kei]# Oh, wow!
^[Helene]# Ohoho yes, I never fail to impress, don't I? Ohoho!
|[Kei]# (… She's got a really huge ego. That's for sure.)
|[Kei]# Right… So how do I get to her?
^[Helene]# OK, listen carefully.
^[Helene]# The members of Elgis usually gather at a {Small Factory# in the town of {Rowen#.
|[Kei]# A small factory in Rowen. Got it.
^[Helene]# I'm not finished! You're going to have to obtain a forged {Citizen Pass# in order to get to Rowen.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 로우엔 평원을 지나려면 {토레즈 시민증#을 위조해야 되는데...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# You should be able to find someone with a Citizen Pass at the {Black Factory#. If you can get your hands on one, bring it back here to me.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 일단 {검은 공장#에서 폐기된 시민증을 좀 주워올래?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Why the Black Factory, of all places?!
^[Helene]# Don't worry. Most of the army's attention is on Neo Soltia right now, so most places are relatively lightly guarded.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 괜찮아, 네오 솔티아 쪽에 병력이 집중되어 있어서 정작 토레즈 주변은 경비가 허술하니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Uh… I don't want to take any chances.
^[Helene]# Just keep a low profile! You're not going to run around announcing to the world that you're a Soltian, are you?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 조용히 다니면 아무 문제 없다구. 나 솔티안이요 광고하고 다닐 건 아니잖아?

entries.en: }New Quest! {Acquire Citizen Pass}
{A Trustworthy Person} Quest Complete!
^[Helene]# I see… So that's what happened.
|[Kei]# They told us not to worry. They said they would all be fine.
^[Helene]# We've been through this before… It's alright, Sien.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그런 위험은 항상 있어왔어. 신경쓰지마, 시엔..

entries.en: ^[Sien]# I have experienced much conflict and bloodshed in my lifetime…
^[Sien]# And yet, I have never gotten used to the loss of life…
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 하지만 역시 생명이 꺼져가는 걸 느끼는 건.. 싫어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# It's alright… Everyone was prepared for this. They all knew the risks.
^[Helene]# Besides, Elgis will not simply cease to be so easily.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그리고 아직.. 엘지스는 완전히 무너진게 아니야.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wait… Helene, what are you talking about?!
^[Helene]# The Signal Pendants belonging to those who were at the meeting are… no longer active, Kei.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 집회에 참가했던 이들의 시그널 펜던트가 모두 꺼졌어..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# We may be pacifists, but that doesn't mean we are exempt from the horrors of war. Never forget that, Kei.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 잊지마, 케이. 전쟁을 반대하는 우리도, 결국 전장 안에 있다는 걸..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# In times like these, it's a risk we have to take if we wish to achieve true peace.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 이 시대를 막아서려면, 목숨을 걸지 않으면 안 되는 거야.

entries.en: |[Kei]# But.. They died… because of me…
^[Helene]# And I was the one who sent you there! You don't see me moping around, do you?!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 널 그곳으로 보낸 건 나야! 약한 소리 하지마!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# In war, casualties are inevitable. We may not be able to save everyone, but we'll damn well try to save as many as we can!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 아무도 죽지 않을 순 없는거야, 한 사람이라도 더 구하기 위해 움직여야 된다고!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Time is of the essence here. Everyone is counting on you two to save the day!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 너희에겐 너희만이 할 수 있는, 정말 급한 일이 있잖아!

entries.en: {CHAPTER 9; The Holy Rest#
^[Helene]# … I'm sure of it. In order to lift the seal, we're going to need 3 {Soul Stones#.
^[Helene]# The problem is, I don't have any of those lying around.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 문제는 그 제조법이 남아있지 않다는 거.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Based upon what I know, they can usually be found in the remains of various ancient relics.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만 고대유물의 잔재로, 대륙 곳곳에 퍼져있다고 해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'll find them, even if I have to go through the gates of hell itself!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 지옥문 바로 앞에 있다고 해도, 찾아낼 거 예요.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# My, you're really determined, aren't you?
|[Kei]# Of course I am! That goes without saying!
^[Helene]# Sien is fortunate to have someone like you looking out for her.
^[Helene]# If Sien is a Guardian herself, then she might still be alive…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 시엔이 정말 가디언 그 자체라면, 살아있을 확률은 훨씬 높아.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# After all, Guardians are supposed to be immortal…
^[Helene]# But you must never forget the fact that she's a Guardian, Kei…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만 그 아이가.. 가디언이라는 걸 잊어선 안 돼, 케이.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Oh, you two…
^[Helene]# By the way, take this. You're going to need it, since you're going to be searching all over the place!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 이걸 가져가. 아무런 단서도 없이 대륙을 뒤지려면 필요할거야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# It only carries one charge, though. If you want to use it again, you'll need to get it recharged at a {Blacksmith#.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 사용하고 나면 {조합서#로 되돌아가니까, {대장장이에게서 특수조합으로 재조합#해 줘야해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Thanks, Helene!
|[Kei]# So… have you straightened out your thoughts about Gilberg?
^[Helene]# Yes, I have. His intentions were never just solely about sealing off the Guardians.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 응. 역시 굴베이그는 단순히 가디언을 봉하려 했던 게 아닌 것 같아.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# The true purpose of his research was to save lives. That's something I can get behind.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그녀는 진심으로 생명을 위해 가디언을 연구했던 사람이니까.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# The Nixcore… I'd like to finish what he started, Kei. To bring about the "hope" that he so desperately craved.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 닉스 코어... 그녀가 만든 희망이라는 이름을 내가 마무리 지어보려 해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Yeah… I guess my opinion of him changed as well.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저도 조금은 굴베이그라는 사람에 대한 생각이 변했어요.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Let's both do our best, alright?
^[Helene]# Yes!
^[Helene]# Oh, I almost forgot…
^[Helene]# You've come a long way, Kei. I just wanted you to know that I think you'll become a great hero one day.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 강해졌더라, 케이. 정말 영웅이 될 수 있을것 같아, 그말을 해주고 싶었어.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Soltia has fallen, and the war is getting worse by the day.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 유적이 떨어지고, 전쟁은 점점 커지고 있는데...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Yet, I don't give a damn about all that.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아무것도 할 생각을 못했어요. 머릿속은 시엔으로 가득차서..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Sien is all I care about… Even now... Especially now!
|[Kei]# … I don't deserve to be a hero, Helene.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 전 역시.. 영웅이 될 인물은 아닌거 같아요.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Well, you're great just the way you are!
|[Kei]# Haha, thanks! I hope Sien feels the same way…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 후후.. 시엔도 그렇게 생각해 준다면 좋겠는데 말이죠..

entries.en: The shockwaves caused by Soltia's impact have revealed previously hidden areas in the Refiner's Ruins.
entries.ko: 솔티아 추락의 충격으로; 리파이너의 유적의; 숨겨진 부분이 드러났다.

entries.en: These areas are likely to contain much valuable knowledge.
entries.ko: 어쩌면 상층부에서는; 볼 수 없었던 자료들이; 숨겨져 있을지도 몰라.

entries.en: It seems pretty dangerous to venture there alone…
But now that Elgis has suffered such a blow, all I can do is focus on my research.
entries.ko: 엘지스가 없는 지금, 내가 할 수 있는 건.. 연구 뿐이다.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Hey, what's your problem?! I'm staying home just like you told me to!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 왜왜, 시킨데로 집에 잘 붙어있잖아. 또 불만있어? 떽떽이 용병씨!

entries.en: |[Rits]# (Why do even I bother sometimes…)
entries.ko: |[리츠]# (내가 왜 자꾸 이런 여자를 신경쓰고 있지..)

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# Helene, we were worried sick about you!
^[Helene]# Sorry I'm late. We had to make a little detour…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 이런, 제가 좀 늦었네요. 조금 알아볼 것이 있어서요...

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Hmph. So that's what happened.
^[Helene]# Yes. Kenneth provided us with the financial support to excavate and inspect the ruins.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그래. 케네스는 우리가 유적을 발굴하고 조사하는 걸 적극 지원해 줬어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# But I never really trusted him.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만 완전히 신뢰할 수는 없는 남자였지.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I gave him only {half# of the Nixcore.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그래서 그에게 건내준 닉스 코어는 {반.쪽#. 이야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# So you're holding on to the real one, then?
^[Helene]# Well, I still have the other half, if that's what you're asking.
^[Helene]# I suppose it was a wise decision. Not long after that, we found out that he was actually an influential member of the Corbus Guild!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 결과적으로는 현명한 선택이었어. 얼마 안 되서 그가 코르버스 길드의 주요 인물임을 밝혀냈거든.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# He'd been manipulating us all along!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 역시 그 남자는 우릴 이용해 먹은 것 뿐인거야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hold on… This Nixcore…
|[Rits]# It has the power to seal off the Guardians, right?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 가디언을 영원히 봉인할 수 있다잖아.. 그게 가능하다면..

entries.en: |[Rits]# With this, we could roll right over the Soltians and end the war in a flash!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 솔티아 놈들을 단숨에 굴복시키고 전쟁을 끝낼 수 있다고.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Isn't that what you guys want? To end the war?
^[Helene]# No, Rits!
^[Helene]# If that is indeed the true purpose of the Nixcore…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 정말로 닉스 코어가 가디언을 영원히 봉인하는 도구라면.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I won't have anything to do with it any longer.
&[Elgis Member 1]# She's right. Peace through conquest is not our goal.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 그래. 우리는 전쟁으로 얻는 평화를 추구하는 게 아니니까.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# The Guardians are an important part of Soltian society.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 솔티안들에게 가디언은 삶의 일부가 되어있어.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# If we take that away from them… what does that make us?
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 그것을 빼앗는다고, 전쟁이 끝날 것 같진 않군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What the hell are you talking about?!
|[Rits]# Think about it, Helene! The Nixcore might be the greatest thing to ever fall into our hands!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 다시 생각해봐, 일레느! 그 닉스 코어란 건 다시없는 기회라고!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Do you really think you can achieve peace when such destructive power continues to exist?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그따위 힘을 남겨두고 정말 평화가 올거라고 생각하는 거야?!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# … My mind is made up, Rits.
^[Helene]# And it seems like you have made your choice, too.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그리고 너도.. 변하지 않을 것 같구나.

entries.en: |[Rits]# You're damn right I have! I've lost everything I've ever known, thanks to the power of the Guardians!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래, 변하지 않아. 나는 가디언의 힘에 나라를 잃고, 몸 담았던 기사단도 잃었다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# The Guardians only bring about death and destruction, nothing more! They must be destroyed!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그 힘은 파괴만을 불러. 없어져야 할 힘이라는 생각은 절대 변하지 않을거야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# … Would you forgive the Soltians if the Guardians no longer existed?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# ... 가디언의 힘이 없어지면 넌 솔티안들을 용서할거야?

entries.en: |[Rits]# How could I?! They're the enemy, Helene!
^[Helene]# That's precisely what I mean! That's why this war goes on day after day!
^[Helene]# I will cease all work on the Nixcore immediately.
^[Helene]# In any case, I cannot continue without Kenneth's support.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그리고 어차피 케네스의 원조가 없으면 닉스 코어의 완성은 불가능해.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# In order for the device to be completed, I would need the facilities at the {Black Factory#.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 나머지 공정을 위해선 {검은 공장#의 설비가 필요하니까.

entries.en: |[Rits]# You want peace… yet you wish to preserve the Guardians?! They are the cause for all of this!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 가디언은 없어지면 안 되고.. 가디언 때문에 일어난 전쟁은 끝내고 싶다?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Snap out of it, Helene!
&[Elgis Member 1]# He's a stubborn one.
&[Elgis Member 1]# He knows too much, Helene. Will that be a problem for us?
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 너무 많은 정보가 유출된 것 같은데, 괜찮은가? 일레느.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# He is... no longer the same man I used to know.
^[Helene]# He used to be a chivalrous Knight of Melhar, who valued human life, dignity, and trust above all else.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 인명과 신뢰를 중시하던 긍지높은 멜하르의 기사였어요.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I thought he could help us… I guess I was wrong.
|[Rits]# She's not here… I guess that's no surprise.
|[Rits]# I'll wait for her.
|[Rits]# I feel like taking a break anyway.
After a few days, there was still no sign of Helene.
But I didn't have anywhere else to go. I've lost all direction…
By now, everything I have ever known has lost it's meaning.
My hatred for the Soltians and loyalty to the Askrans seem utterly insignificant.
entries.ko: 솔티안에 대한 증오도, 아스크라에 대한 믿음도;흔들리는 지금…

entries.en: I don't know what to think anymore. I feel utterly lost.
entries.ko: 무엇을 더 생각해야 할지 모르겠다. 길을 잃은 듯한 기분이다.

entries.en: When will Helene come back?
|[Rits]# … Is she finally back yet?
|[Rits]# It's not like I miss her or anything… I just need to talk to her.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 연애하는 것도 아니고.. 매일매일 나도 참 할일 없군, 그래.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hey, I didn't see this the last time…
|[Rits]# … How could I have missed her! That's so typical of her to just leave without a word.
|[Rits]# She's… gone to the deeper areas of the {Refiner's Ruins#?
|[Rits]# She'd better not have gone there on her own! How is she going to defend herself if something happens?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이 녀석 설마.. 혼자서 간건가. 전투능력도 없는 주제에..

entries.en: |[Rits]# I've got to go after her! If I hurry, maybe I can catch up!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 도와줘야 겠어. 지금 서두르면 쫓아갈 수 있을거야.

entries.en: {A Change of Heart} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Forbidden Research}
&[Member of Elgis 1]# I heard that there were barely any casualties on either side during the battle at the Nemesis Plateau last week.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 지난주에 있었던 네메시스 고원의 교전에서도, 양측 다 사상자는 거의 없었다더군.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# It seems like the Red Witch and the Masked Warrior fought each other to a standstill. And since the battle revolved around their duel, casualties were minimal.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 붉은 마녀와 가면의 검사의 힘은 대등해.. 둘의 대결에 전쟁의 촛점이 맞춰져 있으니 사상자는 적을 수 밖에.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# I suppose we owe the Red Witch our thanks for that.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 그런 점에 있어서는 붉은 마녀에게 감사해야 겠어.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# I agree. The most important thing is to prevent further loss of life.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 그래, 어찌되었든 가장 중요한 건 사람의 생명이니까.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# We might have a chance to hold some peace talks soon… Tener, the Elder of Neo Soltia, is scheduled to visit Askra soon.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 조만간 대화의 기회가 있을 것 같아. 네오 솔티아의 장로, 테너가 한번 아스크라로 넘어온다는 연락이 있다.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# That sounds like a great opportunity!
&[Elgis Member 1]# Indeed. Even in Neo Soltia, there are those who desire peace.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 우리 생각대로, 네오 솔티아에도 역시 평화를 원하고 있는 사람들이 있는 거야.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# The war isn't going to solve anything… There is nothing that can't be settled through peaceful negotiation.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 전쟁은 아무것도 해결해주지 못해.. 이 전쟁은 대화를 통해 충분히 끝낼 수 있다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# We'll need to put our trust in the Soltians.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 무엇보다, 우리는 솔티안들을 믿는 자세로 다가가야해.

entries.en: |[Rits]# (Ugh, I can't believe I'm hearing all this…)
&[Elgis Member 1]# What about our efforts in Enzak? Have you made any progress?
^[Helene]# I haven't been able to find any more information about the {Nixcore#.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# {닉스 코어#에 대한 추가 자료는 찾지 못했어요.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I still have no idea what it's purpose is…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 어디다 쓰는 물건인지 도저히 감이 안잡히지만...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Considering how I felt about it during it's creation though…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만 만들면서 드는 감도 그렇고, 엔자크 자객 건도 그렇고..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I firmly believe that it is an artifact that should never be used for war.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 필시 전쟁을 위한 물건은 아닌 것 같아요.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# Very good, Helene. In the meantime, please continue your efforts on the {Nixcore#. I suspect it has an important part to play in all this.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 일단은 {닉스 코어#의 제작은 계속 진행하세, 일레느. 대화의 중요한 열쇠가 될지도 모르니까.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# Let's meet again sometime soon. Hopefully we'll have more information to work with by then.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 다음번에 다시 한번 찾아오겠네. 그때쯤이면 좀 더 자세한 걸 알 수 있겠지.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Well, Rits, what do you think?
|[Rits]# What else is there to say?
|[Rits]# What a bunch of naïve idiots! You speak of negotiation, peace, and even putting our trust in the Soltians?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그냥 착하기만 한 바보들 아닌가? 대화라는 둥, 평화라는 둥, 하물며 솔티안을 믿는 자세를 가져야 한다고?

entries.en: |[Rits]# You guys must be losing touch with reality!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 현 상황에 대해 전혀 감을 못잡고 있는 걸로 밖에 안보여.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Hey, I take offense at that, Rits. We've spent a lot more time fighting than you might think.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 실례야, 리츠. 우린 너보다 훨씬 오래 전장에 있었다구.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Eventually, we came to realize that all this fighting was never going to bring us peace.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그속에서, 전쟁이 평화를 낳지는 못한다는 걸 깨달은거고.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What's the Nixcore?
|[Rits]# You're not working on something that has to do with the Guardians, are you?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 너 설마, 가디언과 관련된 무언가를 만들고 있는 거냐?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# ... Actually, yes, I am.
^[Helene]# The Refiner's Ruins were discovered in the Enzak Desert some time ago. I've been digging through the area for information.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 엔자크 사막에서 발견된 리파이너의 유적.. 거기에 있던 자료를 바탕으로.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Refiners? Aren't those the ones with the ability to control the Guardians?
^[Helene]# Yes, indeed. Those ruins are more than 200 years old. They were likely left behind by Soltians.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 200년도 더 된 유적이야. 아마 솔티안들의 선조가 지상에 있을 때 남긴 유적이겠지.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Hopefully, we can learn more about the Guardians from there.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 어쩌면 가디언에 대한 궁금증이 꽤 많이 밝혀질지도 몰라.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Forget it. I guess you're just another academic who lacks the will to fight.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 됐다, 결국 너도 전쟁에 대한 자각이 부족한 학자일 뿐이군.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# ... So, you're not going to help us?
|[Rits]# Hell no!
|[Rits]# I'm leaving for the garrison.
^[Helene]# Oh, really? That's where I'm going too!
|[Rits]# Take care of yourself.
^[Helene]# Hey, what do you mean by that? You're coming with me, right?
^[Helene]# What if something happens to poor little old me…?
|[Rits]# … You're impossible.
^[Helene]# Haha! What do you know about Holy Water?
^[Helene]# See what I mean? You know next to nothing about this place!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그것봐, 아무것도 모르잖아. 이 지역에 대해..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# The air in the Nemesis Canyon where the garrison is located is poisonous! You'll need Holy Water to get through that area!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 주둔지가 있는 네메시스 협곡은 독소가 심해서, 꼭 성수로 면역을 만들어서 가야한다고.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I think I've heard that before somewhere…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 네메시스 협곡의 독소.. 들어본 것 같기도 한데...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Right, I'm sure you must have. It'll be a lot more helpful having me around, wouldn't you say?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 들어는 봤지? 거봐거봐, 혼자 다니면 고생한다니까.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Don't you worry, I'll get you to the garrison safely!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 내가 안전하게 주둔지 까지 모셔다 줄테니 걱정말라고.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Let's stop by the {Blacksmith# for some {Holy Water# first.
|[Rits]# … You're going to drive me crazy.
^[Helene]# Let's go!
{Elgis: The Pacifist Faction} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Holy Water}
^[Helene]# That's not true.
^[Helene]# Most of the people here are supportive of the war against Neo Soltia. We have to keep a low profile…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 대세는 네오 솔티아와의 전쟁이야. 소수인 우리가 그렇게 막나갈 수 있는 입장이 아닌거 알잖아.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# There's no way that any of our contacts would have waltzed right through the border garrison! That would be big trouble for us!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 만나야 될 사람들이 주둔지를 정면 돌파해 버리면, 오히려 접촉이 힘들어지는데 우리가 그러겠어?

entries.en: |[Rits]# So why don't you just smuggle them in?
^[Helene]# I'm serious, Rits!
^[Helene]# We were supposed to meet the Elder of Neo Soltia, not a couple of kids!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 우리가 만난다고 했던건 네오 솔티아의 장로야. 그런 어린 애들이 아니라.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … So you DO plan on smuggling him in somehow, aren't you?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 뒷구멍으로 만난다면서, 그렇게 쉽게 얘기해줘도 되는거냐.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# … Yeah, well, I trust you won't rat an old friend out, will you?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 괜찮아. 그래도 옛 고향 친구를 팔지는 않겠지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Heh, I'm not as nice as you think I am.
^[Helene]# Anyway, I think those two Soltians might have gone to the {Refiner's Ruins#.
|[Rits]# What makes you so sure?
^[Helene]# If they went through all that trouble to get to the desert, that's the only logical conclusion.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그렇게 무리해서, 사막쪽으로 도망쳤다면 목적은 그것 뿐이겠지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# We've got to go after them, then. How do we get there? Do you know the way?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어디냐, 그 유적이라는 곳은..? 알고 있어?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Of course I do! I discovered that place!
^[Helene]# Please, take me with you! I'd like to meet them.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 단, 알려주는 대신 나도 데려가줘. 나도 그들을 만나보고 싶으니까.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … I'm supposed to babysit you again, huh? Figures…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 흥.. 너 혼자가긴 위험한 곳이란 얘기로군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# As for those two, I'm planning on getting rid of them as soon as I locate them. You're not going to be OK with that, are you?
^[Helene]# You know I can't let you do that.
|[Rits]# Heh, you're welcome to come along. Just don't get in my way.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 따라오는 건 자유다. 다만 날 막을 생각은 하지마.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Yeah, I get it! Jeez, you're pretty hard to get along with!
^[Helene]# Let's head to the {Enzak Desert# first. I stashed a key in the {Abandoned House# where you saved me from the assassin. We'll need that key to get into the ruins.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 일단은 {엔자크 사막#으로 가자. 너와 다시 만났던 그 {폐가#에, 유적으로 가는 길을 뚫을 열쇠가 있어.

entries.en: {Purpose of the Invasion} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {In Hot Pursuit}
&[Part-time Employee]# Helene? You've mistaken me for someone else.
&[Part-time Employee]# If you're looking for someone, you can try asking the {Homeless Man#. You can find him behind the {City Hall#. Believe it or not, he's incredibly well-informed.
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 사람을 찾는 거라면 {시청 뒤#에 {노숙자 아저씨#한테 물어보세요. 그분 엄청난 정보통이랍니다!

entries.en: |[Guest]# Torez is known for its ironware. The Black Factory is really amazing!
entries.ko: |[투숙객]# 토레즈는 정말로 철기들을 잘 활용하는군. 검은 공장의 기술력은 정말 대단해!

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# He doesn't pay me enough to begin with anyway!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 시급도 쥐꼬리만큼 주면서 자기방 정리는 왜시키는 거야 정말!

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# He'd better not turn around and pin the blame on me when the business fails!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 에고.. 일은 산더미 같이 주면서 장사 안 되면 다 내 탓이래..

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# Hey, the noise from below is gone!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 와, 정말 바닥에서 들려오는 소리가 눈에 띄게 줄었네요!

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# I should've gotten someone to do this earlier!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 진작에 여관을 찾아오는 모험가나 용병들한테 의뢰할 걸 그랬어요.

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# Here is a little token of appreciation from our inn. Thank you!
{10,000 Gold} Obtained!
&[Part-time Employee]# All that noise… was it really the cries of the dead? That's so creepy!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 그런데 정말 죽은이들이 내는 소리였다니.. 으스스하네요.

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# The world is such a dangerous place these days…
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 세상이 뭔가 변한 느낌이예요. 가디언도 그렇고, 몬스터들도 더 포악해지고..

entries.en: {Threat from the Underground} Quest Complete!
&[Part-time Employee]# My boss thinks I'm the Red Witch, apparently.
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 우리 사장님, 이젠 내가 완전 붉은 마녀라도 되는 줄 알아.

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# He ordered me to deal with the strange noises coming from below. Some say that the sounds are coming from monsters from underground!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 요즘 바닥에서 들려오는 이상한 절규 소리를 해결하라는데, 이게 소문으로는 토레즈 지하에 있는 해골 몬스터들의 소리래거든요.

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# What am I supposed to do? Run in with a kitchen knife and hunt them all down?!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 칼들고 그 놈들을 때려잡으라는 소린지 원...

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# Hey, you're an adventurer, right? Do you think you can help me get rid of those monsters?
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 혹시 모험가? 의뢰하면, 그런 몬스터들도 사냥해 주실수 있나요?

entries.en: Sure, why not?
&[Part-time Employee]# Wow, thanks! I didn't think you'd agree to it!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 와우, 멋쟁이! 이렇게 의뢰를 하면 되는 거구나!

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# I'll discuss your reward with my boss. In the meantime, please take care of the {underground monsters#!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 사장님께 말해서 사례금은 꼭 준비해둘테니, {지하의 해골 몬스터#들을 잔뜩 때려잡아주세요!

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# I think defeating about {30 Skull Knights# would be enough to silence the screams.
}New Quest! {Threat from the Underground}
I don't have time for this.
&[Part-time Employee]# Uh… I'll just have to do it myself, I guess.
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# 역시 내가 직접 때려 잡는 수밖에 없나..

entries.en: &[Part-time Employee]# Please, you have to defeat 30 {Skull Knights#! Good luck!
entries.ko: &[아르바이트]# {토레즈 지하의 해골 몬스터들#을 때려잡아 주세요, 화이팅!

entries.en: &[Staff]# The charge for lodging is 300 Gold. Would you like to take a rest?
&[Millionaire's Maid]# Some people get rich without working a single day in their life. What an unfair world this is!
entries.ko: &[졸부의 하녀]# 평생 하루도 일하지 않고도 이렇게 부자가 될 수 있다니, 세상은 참 불공평해요.

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# I dislike mercenaries. Please go away.
entries.ko: &[졸부의 하녀]# 전 용병이 싫어요. 저리로 가주세요.

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# Wow, you've already managed to get them!!
|[Rits]# Yes, and it seems I've earned you a day off.
&[Millionaire's Maid]# Excuse me!?
|[Rits]# Since you don't have to go to Enzak anymore. That's a pretty good deal, isn't it?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 엔자크 간다 그러고 하루 쉴 생각이겠지. 그것도 요령이잖아?

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# S-Sure! Thank you!
|[Rits]# So the reward was {2,500 Gold, wasn't it?
&[Millionaire's Maid]# No, it was 1,500 Gold…
|[Rits]# Aren't you going to show me any gratitude for what I've done for you?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 도움을 받았으면 조금 성의를 보여줘야 하지 않겠어?

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# Ok…2,500 Gold…
|[Rits]# Don't try to outsmart a mercenary!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 용병을 상대로 잔머리 굴리는 건 좋지 않은 생각이야, 아가씨.

entries.en: {2,500 Gold} Obtained!
{Millionaire's Maid} Quest Complete!
&[Millionaire's Maid]# Excuse me, you look like a mercenary, are you one?
|[Rits]# That depends, do you have a request for me?
&[Millionaire's Maid]# My master wants to make a request for {20 Rikan's Teeth# to the Enzak mercenary guild. It's a little dangerous for me to go to Enzak so..
entries.ko: &[졸부의 하녀]# 주인님이 엔자크 용병 길드에 {라이칸의 이빨 20개#를 좀 의뢰하라는 데요, 엔자크까지 가기가 좀 위험하잖아요..

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# Will you please help me? it's not that difficult of a task. Please..
entries.ko: &[졸부의 하녀]# 그래서 부탁 좀 드릴게요, 그리 어려운 일은 아니거든요? 제발..

entries.en: I'll do it but I want a reward.
&[Millionaire's Maid]# Thanks! I was worried I would have to go all the way to Enzak by myself.
entries.ko: &[졸부의 하녀]# 고마워요! 진짜 이런 걸 엔자크까지 가서 의뢰하러 가려니 속 상했다고요!

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# I'll pay you 1,500 Gold for {20 Rikan's Teeth#! It should be a piece of cake for you, right?
|[Rits]# (giggle)..I guess he's trying to make a necklace of some sort. The rich have money to burn but no taste…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 크크.. 목걸이라도 만들려는 건가? 부자들은 돈 쓸데가 없어 안달이로군…

entries.en: &[Millionaire's Maid]# I was thinking the same thing!
|[Rits]# Anyways, request accepted.
}New Quest! {Millionaire's Maid}
I'm not really in the mood…
&[Millionaire's Maid]#  (sneer).. Acting like a tough guy, eh?!
&[Millionaire's Maid]# Bring me {20 Rikan's Teeth#, please!
&[Millionaire]# Keep in mind that you'll only get paid after you complete your tasks.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 돈이란 건 말이지, 자신이 노력한 만큼 들어오는 거라고. 명심하게.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I liked you more when you had your mouth shut.
&[Millionaire]# Ouch..You're a feisty one. I like that!
|[Rits]# My reward?
&[Millionaire]# You've got talent when it comes to fighting, but you seem to lack social skills. Fine then, I'll give you your reward.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 거참 능력은 좋은데, 딱딱한 친굴세. 좋아 좋아, 보상 먼저 하지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Anything else?
&[Millionaire]# Sure, listen up.
&[Millionaire]# A weapon looks great when it's upgraded, but I like the crude weapons more, just the way they are.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 무기란 건 말이야, 발전하는 것도 좋지만 투박한 게 더 보기엔 좋다고.

entries.en: &[Millionaire]# I'm thinking about opening the arena with these weapons. The more savage it gets, the more brutal it is!
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 나는 이 무기들로 투기장을 열까하네. 더 야만적이고 더 잔혹해지겠지!

entries.en: &[Millionaire]# You look pretty strong. You can give it a try if you'd like.. What do you say...?
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 어떤가, 자네도 강해 보이는 데 한번…도전하겠나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# If you're up for it yourself, count me in.
{Rikan's Blade} Quest Complete!
&[Millionaire]# You look really strong. Would you be interested in a job?
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 자네 말일세, 무척이나 강해 보이는 데 혹시 일거리를 찾고 있나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Tell me the reward first. My strenght is proportionate to the amount of gold I get paid!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 보상부터 말해. 난 받는 만큼은 분명히 일한다.

entries.en: &[Millionaire]# Fine. The reward is {15,000 Gold#.
I'm interested…
&[Millionaire]# You know about Rikans, right? These days the Rikans have become pretty smart.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 자네도 라이칸을 알고 있지? 요즘 그 라이칸이 매우 영리해 졌다고 하는군.

entries.en: &[Millionaire]# Apparently they started using some kind of weapon. I hear that weapon is quite something.. I want you to get it for me.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 놈들이 무기를 쓴다는데, 그게 또 물건인가 봐. 그걸 좀 대량으로 구하고 싶네.

entries.en: |[Rits]# It will probably be no match for a human's weapon, though.. I assume this is just a hobby of yours?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래봐야 인간의 무기에 비할바 안될텐데.. 취향인가?

entries.en: &[Millionaire]#  Just bring me {20 Rikan's Blades#. The reward is 15,000 Gold. Do we have a deal?
|[Rits]# If you want to spend money on such a trivial thing, be my guest, I have no reason to refuse your request.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그딴 것에 돈을 쓰고 싶으시다면야, 내가 거절할 이유는 없지.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Rikan's Blade}
I don't want it!
&[Millionaire]# W.. What! Why did you ask about the reward, then?
entries.ko: &[졸부]# 뭐.. 뭐야! 보상은 왜 물어본 건가!

entries.en: |[Rits]# All of sudden, I just don't feel like working for you.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그냥. 갑자기 당신을 위해 일하기 싫어졌거든.

entries.en: &[Millionaire]# Bring me {20 Rikan's Blades#. The reward is ready.
entries.ko: &[졸부]# {라이칸의 칼날 20개#를 가지고 오게. 보상은 준비되어 있네.

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'll also make one later and give it to Sien as a gift.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 햐아- 나도 나중에 하나 만들어서 시엔에게 선물해야 겠는걸.

entries.en: |[Kei]# That way, I can protect her wherever she goes…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 어딜가든 나의 수호가 그녀에게 닿을 수 있도록…

entries.en: |[Kei]# Oh, I'm so pumped up about doing this!

entries.en: #I will never back down no matter what happens!
I will rescue Sien. I will prevent Soltia's descent. I will end the war.

Gigantic boulders rained from the sky. Mighty beasts roamed free, wreaking havoc across the land.

entries.en: Mighty beasts roamed free, wreaking havoc across the land.
The forests in the Western Lands were occupied by a tribe of magic-users, the Soltians, that had seemingly appeared out of nowhere.
The kingdom of Askra, recently shaken by the collapse of the Legalis Church, regarded the Soltians' presence as an invasion.

^[Reah]# ... Listen, I don't know who you are and what you're doing here, but…
^[Reah]# Could you not go any further? Ian is in there…
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 잠시 기다려 주겠어? 지금... 이안은 마지막 싸움을 하고 있어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# And Kenneth is with him, isn't he?
|[Rits]# The final showdown between Ian and Kenneth... You must be the Red Witch, Reah, then.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이안과 케네스의 최후의 싸움.. 그러면 당신은 붉은 마녀인가?

entries.en: ^[Reah]# … That's right.
|[Rits]# If this battle is so important to you, why are you just… watching? You're supposed to be pretty damned powerful yourself, aren't you?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 마지막 싸움인데, 구경이나 할 생각인가? 당신도 충분히 강할텐데.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# I'm not just watching…
^[Reah]# Besides… I'm in no condition to fight.
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 사실... 싸울 수 있는 여건도 안 되고..

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Wait, you're hurt!
^[Reah]# Yes… That bastard had the nerve to hit me while I wasn't looking!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 완전히 속았지. 가면을 쓴 나쁜 남자에게 말이야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Are you just going to leave it to Ian?
|[Rits]# I'm perfectly fine, I can help take that bastard down!
|[Rits]# Besides, I want to see how this smug bastard who thinks he can manipulate all of us like toys looks like!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 적어도 지금까지 아스크란과 솔티안을 이용해 먹어온 케네스란 남자의 낯짝이라도 보고 싶으니 말이야.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# It will all be over soon…
|[Rits]# What's this?!
^[Reah]# No, the Holy Guardian is going out of control!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 말도 안 돼, 진정되기 시작했던 홀리 가디언이 다시 폭주하고 있어!

entries.en: ^[Reah]# … Wait, isn't that... the Nixcore?!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 설마 이것이 가디언을 영원히 봉인할 힘, 닉스 코어.. 인가?

entries.en: |[Rits]# No, not really. Well, I mean-
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아니, 아니야. 분명히 이건 닉스 코어지만...

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Who the hell are you?! And how did you get a hold of something like that?!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 당신 도대체 누구지? 어떻게 그런 물건을 가지고 있는 거야?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I… Helene said it was only half-complete! I don't even know how this thing is supposed to work!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 일레느는 분명히 미완성이라고 했어! 게다가 나는 사용법도 모른다고!

entries.en: ^[Reah]# It's … resonating with something inside!
|[Rits]# … I get it! The power of the Nixcore will kick in when the two halves meet!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# ... 완성.. 된건가... 미완성인 두개의 닉스 코어가 만나..

entries.en: ^[Reah]# The Holy Guardian cannot be contained for much longer… Is it resisting the Nixcore?!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 가디언의 폭주가 가속화 되고 있어.. 홀리 가디언이 거부하고 있는 건가? 닉스 코어를?

entries.en: ^[Reah]# Give it to me, now!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 닉스 코어를.. 닉스 코어를 내게 줘!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Woah, hold on a second! I demand to know what's going on!
|[Rits]# The Nixcore is MY responsibility!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 적어도 난 이 닉스 코어만큼은 마지막까지 책임을 져야 하니까!

entries.en: ^[Reah]# The Holy Guardian is resisting! If it goes out of control now…
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 가디언이 봉인을 거부하고 있어.. 이대로 여기서 폭주해버리면...

entries.en: ^[Reah]# This entire region will be wiped clean off the map!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 솔티아 대륙은 완전히 파괴될거야, 어떤 재해가 올지 모른다고!

entries.en: |[Rits]# What are you going to do?!
^[Reah]# We'll have to bring the Holy Guardian under control, then seal it off!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 당장의 폭주를 막으려면.. 반항하는 홀리가디언을 제압하고 .. 봉인하는 수밖에 없어.

entries.en: ^[Reah]# A normal human being like you can't possibly do that! You'll have to let me handle it!
entries.ko: ^[레아]# 평범한 인간은 안 돼. 가디언과 맞서본 적이 있는 내가 해야만 하는 일이라고!

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Fine! I'll just have to subdue the Holy Guardian, right?
^[Reah]# … No, you can't-
|[Rits]# I guess you can say this is destiny or something.
|[Rits]# This is something I have to do on my own!
|[Rits]# I said I'll carry on Helene's legacy, and that's exactly what I'm going to do!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 일레느의 의지를 이곳에 가져온 순간부터, 이건 나의 운명이다!

entries.en: {CHAPTER 2; The Enemy Within#
}New Quest! {Dangerous gorge}
}This factory has been shut down due to frequent monster attacks.
|[Rits]# I thought you said this place was supposed to be dangerous? He doesn't look like much…
|[Rits]# Hah! Too easy... This is where you wanted to go, isn't it?
^[Helene]# Wow! Rits, you're really strong…
|[Rits]# We're here, right?
^[Helene]# Yes, we'll have to go inside. I'm looking for something…
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 응, 이 공장 안쪽에 찾아야 할게 있어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I think I'm going too far into Neo Soltia…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 지나치게 네오 솔티아 쪽으로 들어가는 것 같군..

entries.en: |[Kei]# The pendant… Is it glowing?
|[Kei]# It's directing me to that cave… Oh, I get it now! So that's what Reah meant when she said that this would help me find her.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저 동굴을 가리키고 있어.. 이 펜던트는 시엔의 펜던트와 공명해 서로를 찾아내는 건가..

entries.en: |[Kei]# The two pendants are linked to each other! What a useful item for a Guardian Knight like me! Thanks, Reah!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 레아님도 참, 수호기사에 어울리는 선물을 주셨구나! 센스있으셔-

entries.en: |[Kei]# Woah, what's this?!
|[Kei]# The pendant is pointing me the other way, to the north. I should head there instead.
|[Kei]# No, this leads back to Soltia.
^[Helene]# Noooo Rits! I'm afraid of the dark! Let's not go there, please!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 난 어두운 동굴은 질색이야, 리츠! 목적지는 여기가 아니라구~

entries.en: |[Rits]# … And I thought I'd seen it all.
{CHAPTER 2; An Uninvited Guest#
^[Helene]# If we head west, then south, we'll come across an old abandoned factory.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 서쪽으로 가다가 남쪽으로 내려가면 오래전에 폐쇄된 공장이 있어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# That's our destination. We've got to be careful not to cross over into Neo Soltian territory, though.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 우리의 목적지는 그곳이야. 네오 솔티아 쪽으로 너무 접근하지 않게 조심하고..

entries.en: |[Rits]# Don't worry. I'm not going to get myself killed over this!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 걱정마라. 이런 쓸데없는 일 때문에 죽고 싶진 않으니까..

entries.en: |[Kei]# This cave…
|[Kei]# This is where I caught up with Sien the last time.
|[Kei]# I haven't done anything. I can't go back to Neo Soltia yet.
entries.ko: |[케이]#  난 아무것도 하지 못했다. 아직 네오 솔티아로 돌아갈 순 없어.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Sien, wait up!
|[Kei]# I knew you'd get lost! I wouldn't have caught up with you if not for your lousy sense of direction!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 역시, 헤매고 있었나 보네! 덕분에 따라잡았어!

entries.en: ^[Sien]# I… I am not lost! In fact, I only just got here.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 헤.. 헤맨 거 아냐! 단지.. 이곳에...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Right… Speaking of which, where are we anyway?
^[Sien]# This place contains faint traces of the elements of fire, water, and earth…
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 가디언의 기운이 남아있어. 아주 그리운.. 불과, 물과, 대지의...

entries.en: ^[Sien]# Someone who wields the power of the Guardians has been here recently.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 아마... 가디언을 다루는 자들이 최근에 머물렀던 것 같아.

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Could it have been Reah? But what would she be doing in a place like this?
^[Sien]# But enough about that. Why are you here?
|[Kei]# I… Uh…
^[Sien]# Did Tener send you? Were you ordered to bring me back?
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 테너가, 날 붙잡아 오라 그런 거야?

entries.en: |[Kei]# What? No! That's not why I'm here!
^[Sien]# Is that so? Why are you here, then?
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 그럼 어째서 이런 곳에 있는 거야?

entries.en: |[Kei]# I thought I'd go after you in case you got lost! It's the least I could do as your Guardian Knight…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 네가 길 잃어 버릴까 봐 쫓아온 거잖아, 이 수호기사님이!

entries.en: ^[Sien]# … My Guardian Knight?
|[Kei]# Yes! A Refiner must always have a Guardian Knight by her side. That's how it always goes!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 내 말 들어! 리파이너는 항상 수호기사를 달고 다녀야 한다고!

entries.en: ^[Sien]# … I suppose that is not entirely untrue.
|[Kei]# You intend to stop Soltia from crashing down on top of us, right?
^[Sien]# Yes. I do.
|[Kei]# Well that sounds like a pretty difficult task, don't you think? Let me help you! I could, uh, serve as a guide, at least!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 힘든 일은 혼자 떠안는 게 아니야. 함께 가자, 내가 너를 지켜주진 못할지 몰라도 길잡이는 해줄 수 있어.

entries.en: ^[Sien]# A guide? Do you know the way to Askra, then?
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 대륙의 길도 잘 아는 거야? 이제 아스크라로 갈 건데..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Not really… But I'm sure we can find our way there together! It beats getting lost alone, right?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 몰라. 그래도 혼자 헤매는 거보단 둘이 헤매는 게 빠르다.

entries.en: ^[Sien]# … You are really persistent, aren't you?
|[Kei]# So, where exactly are we headed?
^[Sien]# I seek the old Refiner's facility located somewhere within the desert region of Askra.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 대륙 사막지역에 있는 옛 리파이너의 연구시설...

entries.en: ^[Sien]# We will have to find a way to get to Soltia from there.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 그곳에서, 솔티아와 접촉할 방법을 찾아야 해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Got it! First, we've got to find a way past the border into Askra.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 좋아, 그럼 일단 아스크라로 돌입하는 게 우선이군!

entries.en: {Dangerous Gorge} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Crossing the Border}
|[Rits]# They've tunnelled through here, the bastards!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이런 곳에 땅굴을 뚫어놨구나, 솔티안 놈들..!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hold it right there!
|[Rits]# I don't know what you people are up to, but I'll stop you just the same!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 두더지 같은 놈들, 이따위 짓이나 하고..

entries.en: ^[Qu]# It seems like we have an intruder…
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 허.. 이건 또 왠 파리가 붙었군...

entries.en: |[Rits]# Look who's talking, you slimy bastard!
&[Soltian Officer]# You got some nerve to come here alone!
|[Rits]# You already have the Nemesis forest! Not satisfied with that?!
^[Qu]# I'm not interested in territorial gain, fool!
^[Qu]# What I'm after is your ability to wage war!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 네놈들이 더이상 그 위험한 힘을 만들어내지 못하게 하려는 것 뿐이다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# That's ridiculous! What could be more dangerous in the hands of men than those Guardians of yours?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 웃기는군. 정말 위험한 힘은 너희들의 가디언이 아닌가?

entries.en: ^[Qu]# Your Fire Arms!
^[Qu]# Those weapons cause nothing but death and despair!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 그 누가 어떤 변명을 해도 그건 살상무기에 불과해.

entries.en: ^[Qu]# They must all be destroyed, or this war will never end!
entries.ko: ^[큐]# 그게 없어지지 않는한, 전쟁은 끝나지 않는다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I could say the same thing about those damned Guardians of yours!
&[Soltian Officer]# Silence! Prepare to die!
|[Rits]# Damn it, he got away!
|[Rits]# No thanks to you!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 덕분에 중요한 놈을 놓친 것 같군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# They were trying to eliminate our capability to produce Fire Arms, huh?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 공장을 습격한 이유가 총기를 못만들게 하기 위해서라고?

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Yeah, right!
^[Melpheto]# The Soltians have been fighting a defensive war for too long. They were probably itching to attack us.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 놈들도 달아올랐나. 방어만 하려니 몸이 근질근질했겠지.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Their objective was the Black Factory. This was definitely a planned assault.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 검은 공장을 노리다니, 놈들도 중요한 게 뭔지는 알고 있나보군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# To get rid of our Fire Arms? As if that's going to do any good…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 총기를 못 만들게 하겠다니... 어리석은 생각입니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Why don't they take care of their own Guardians first? That'll save us a lot of trouble.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 전쟁을 끝내려면 자신들의 가디언부터 처리를 해야죠.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Haha! The Guardians are a powerful force indeed.
^[Melpheto]# Do you not desire their power for yourself?
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 자네는 어떤가, 가디언의 힘을 갖고 싶지 않나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# What?
^[Melpheto]# You don't wish to wield that power?
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 말 그대로. 저들의 강대한 힘.. 원하지 않느냐는 질문이지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# No! The Guardians are nothing but harbingers of disaster for humanity!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 말도 안 되는 말씀 마십시오! 가디언의 힘은 인류의 재앙일 뿐입니다!

entries.en: |[Rits]# They should be destroyed - their power sealed away for eternity!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 하루빨리 솔티안들을 굴복시키고, 봉인해 버려야 할 힘이지 않습니까?

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# … It seems like you harbor a deep hatred for Guardians, Rits.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# .. 자네도 가디언에 대한 증오가 뼈에 사무쳤군.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# I suppose it stems from the day we Melhar Knights were annihilated, doesn't it?
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 멜하르 기사단이 맥없이 전멸한 그날.. 부터 겠지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Us fearless knights, who have honed our skills at warfare for years…
|[Rits]# Utterly defeated by one man wielding the power of the Guardians.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 단 한 명의 남자에게, 오직 가디언을 가졌다는 특권만으로 전멸당했을 때...

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# I understand how you must feel.
^[Melpheto]# There are many opinions about power…
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 뭐, 힘을 바라보는 관점은 다양한 거니까...

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# And I think I can see where you are coming from.
^[Melpheto]# Tear down the passageway, and seal this tunnel!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 통로를 무너트려서, 이 땅굴을 다시 막아버려. 솔티안들이 다시 장난질 하지 못하게.

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# Yes Sir!
|[Rits]# Sir, I…
^[Melpheto]# Wait for me back in Torez.
|[Rits]# Huh?
^[Melpheto]# If you're feeling bored, I suggest you pay a visit to the {Dungeon# and check on our guest.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 심심할 것 같으면, {토레즈의 지하감옥#을 찾아가서 솔티안이 이상한 짓 안하나 감시나 하고 있게.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# One of the enemies we captured in the factory is locked up there. He seemed a lot stronger than the others.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 공장에서 잡은 놈들 중에 제법 튼튼한 녀석이 있어서 가둬놨거든.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# You will find the way to the dungeon in a quiet corner of the town.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# {토레즈 마을 구석#에 지하감옥으로 가는 길이 있으니 잘 찾아봐.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Do I desire the power of the Guardians for myself?
|[Rits]# Just what kind of question is that?! Doesn't he know how I feel about them?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 무슨 생각을 하고 계신거지.. 뭔가 내가 마음에 안드시는 것 같았는데.

entries.en: |[Rits]# A task is a task.. I gotta find the {Dungeon# first..
{Pursue the Soltians} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Dungeon}
|[Kei]# Damn… How are we going to get past all of this?
|[Rits]# No need to go back to the gorge again.
&[Askran soldier]# The plateau is the battlefield with Soltia. We secure the gate.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 고원은 솔티안과의 전장으로, 출입을 통제하고 있습니다.

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# Soltians hold out this plateau as their restriction line. What tedious fellas they are.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 솔티안들은 이 고원을 저지선으로 버티고 있어. 지겨운 놈들이지.

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# The Red Witch and Masked Warrior are too balanced in power, so neither side wants to risk attacking first. It's time for a new hero to stand out and make a difference.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 붉은 마녀와 가면의 검사가 너무 팽팽하다 보니 요즘은 좀처럼 어느 한 쪽이 먼저 공격을 못하고 있어. 또 다른 영웅이 필요한 때인데 말이지.

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# Looking at their power of dark magic, it feels strange that they don't attack first.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 암흑마법의 위력을 보고 있자면, 놈들이 먼저 쳐들어오지 않는게 이상할 정도야.

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# The ancient document reads Soltians offer sacrifices for the Guardian. They're just demon's spawn.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 고문서에서 봤는데, 솔티안들은 가디언을 위해 제물을 바친다더군. 그야말로 악마의 자식들이야..

entries.en: ^[Duke]# If you feel like in danger, just run away.  I'll be ready to back you up.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 위험해질 것 같으면 바로 도망쳐. 출동 대기하고 있을테니.

entries.en: |[Rits]# You'd better save your stamina for emergencies.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그냥 체력이나 비축하고 있는 게 나을걸.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# ..I protect this place. It's the way to protect Askra.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# .. 난 이곳을 지킨다. 그게 곧 아스크라를 지키는 길이니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Oh my! Sien, it's too bold!
&[Soldier]# Halt! Who goes there?!
|[Kei]# None of your damned business!
^[Duke]# What's going on?
^[Helene]# What's all that racket?
|[Rits]# Those two… Are they Soltians?
^[Duke]# What are they doing here? They must be up to something.
|[Kei]# Damn it… What do we do now, Sien? We're surrounded!
^[Sien]# Yes, I can see that. Both nations are at war, after all.
|[Kei]# Hey… What are you doing?
^[Sien]# Close your eyes, Kei.
^[Duke]# Argh! My eyes! I can't see!
^[Sien]# This is our chance. We must go, now!
|[Kei]# Hey, you're going the wrong way again! That's where we came from!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 야잇, 이 왕 길치야! 그쪽은 되돌아가는 길이잖아!!

entries.en: &[Askran Soldier]# Where… where are they?! We got to go after them!
&[Askran Soldier]# Ow! Hey! Quit pinching me!
|[Kei]# Hurry, this way!
^[Duke]# I see you have returned.
|[Rits]# Yes. I'm here to enlist in the army!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래. 나는 전쟁에 참여하기 위해 이곳에 온거니까.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# I apologize, but I don't think I can have you here.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 안됐지만 심사는 불합격이었어. 자네는 이곳에서 근무하긴 힘들 것 같군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What?! Why?!
^[Duke]# You returned from the canyon alive, that part is true. But you are also extremely brash and impulsive.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 협곡에 들어갔다 나온 건 그렇다 쳐도.. 너무 과격하고 충동적이더군.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# You do not exhibit the qualities of a good soldier.
|[Rits]# … That's not all, is it?!
|[Rits]# You never liked me from the start! You're worried I'd get in the way of your little relationship with Helene, aren't you?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 일레느와 함께 이곳에 왔을 때부터 날 맘에 안들어 했던 것 같은데.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# Leave Helene out of this! This has nothing to do with her!
|[Rits]# You're lying! What other reason could you possibly have?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 상관없다기엔 이해가 잘 안 가서. 싸워주러 온 용병을 거부하다니, 그것도 전장에서.

entries.en: |[Rits]# You're putting your personal relationships above your duty!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 군인 실격 운운하기전에, 여자관계부터 정리해야 하는 것 아닌가?

entries.en: ^[Duke]# This attitude of yours is precisely why I am doing this!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 그런 당신의 태도부터가, 군인으로는 실격이라는 거야!

entries.en: [??]# Calm down, Duke. It's so unbecoming of you.
entries.ko: [??]# 듀크, 자네답지 않게 너무 흥분하는 것 같군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Melpheto?
^[Melpheto]# It's been a while, Rits. I never thought I'd see you here as a mercenary!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 오랜만이군, 리츠. 용병이 되어 있을 줄은.

entries.en: |[Rits]# How long have you been here in Torez?
^[Melpheto]# Ever since the Melhar Knights were wiped out, Rits…
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 그래. 그때 멜하르 기사단이 붕괴된 뒤부터 주욱.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# All along I thought I was the only one who survived the massacre. It seems I was wrong!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 그 빙해의 검사로부터 살아남은 건 나 뿐인줄 알았는데..

entries.en: ^[Duke]# You know this man, Melpheto?
^[Melpheto]# Of course! I know this gentleman very well. Despite appearances, he used to be a knight!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 잘 알고 있지.. 저래뵈도 기사 출신이라네.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# A knight?! Him?! I find that hard to believe…
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 기사 출신이라구요? 저 막 되먹은 용병이?

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# And not just any knight too! He was one of the best!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 후후, 멜하르 기사단 시절엔 올곧은 견습 기사였는데 말이지.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# You look a lot more mature now, Rits.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 용병이 되더니 제법 남자다워진 것 같군 그래.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# I'd say otherwise…
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 전 저런 걸 남자답다고 보지 않습니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hey, watch your mouth!
^[Melpheto]# Well, since you and Duke don't get along, why don't you consider working for me?
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 어떤가, 듀크와 잘 안맞으면 내 밑에서 일해보는게.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# My responsibility is the defense of Torez. Now, I know you've always preferred to be at the frontlines, but the defense of the city is no less important.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 최전방은 아니지만, 토레즈 방어라는 중요한 임무를 띄고 있는 부대니까.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# You want him on board, Melpheto? Are you serious?
^[Melpheto]# Of course! I'm well aware of what he's capable of.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 능력은 확실한 친구야. 수비군에 좀 적응되면, 그때 주둔군에 편입하는 것도 좋겠지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# It would be an honor to once again serve under you!
^[Melpheto]# Good man! You'll have to get used to being in a regular army, though. Life will be different for you, I'm sure.
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 잘 생각했어. 용병과 정규군은 많이 다르니까, 천천히 적응하는 게 좋지.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# When you're ready, drop by the {Black Factory# to the south of Torez. I'm sure we'll have a lot to talk about…
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# {토레즈 남쪽#의 {검은 공장#으로 찾아오게나. 왠지, 서로 할 얘기도 많을 것 같은데...

entries.en: |[Rits]# Thanks, Melpheto!
^[Duke]# He seems like the only person you show respect for.
|[Rits]# I only show respect to people who deserve it!
|[Rits]# Sorry to disappoint, but you don't fit into that category!
^[Duke]# … Don't even think about coming back here.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 주둔군으로 올 생각은 꿈도 꾸지않는게 좋겠어, 당신.

entries.en: {Back in Action} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Black Factory}
^[Duke]# You're going to get me in trouble one of these days, Helene! You can't keep showing up here like this!
^[Helene]# Hey! I've brought you a potential recruit, you know!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 널 위해서 우수한 인재를 데리고 온거 잖아, 이 정도는 이해해 줘.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# This is Rits, an old friend of mine.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 자 인사해, 이쪽은 내 고향 친구 리츠야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# And this is Duke, the Commander of the Askran Garrison.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 그리고 이분이 대 솔티아군 네메시스 고원 주둔 대장 듀크.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# An old friend, huh? Pleased to meet you.
|[Rits]# The Garrison Commander?! Damn, I thought you were bluffing!
^[Helene]# What, you didn't believe me back there?!
|[Rits]# No, I didn't.
^[Helene]# Waaaah how could you! That's so mean!
^[Duke]# Did you come to enlist in the regular army?
|[Rits]# Yeah. I can't wait to get my hands on those damned Soltians!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래. 솔티안들이 설치는 걸 더이상 봐줄 수가 없어서.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# Well, in order to join the army, you'll need to-
^[Helene]# He needs to pass a test, doesn't he?
^[Helene]# If you're going to be fighting on the front lines, you've got to prove your strength first!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 심사가 필요하다구. 최전방의 정규군이 되려면 엄청 강해야 되니까.

entries.en: |[Rits]# (Ok, now she's just scaring me.)
^[Helene]# And I have just the perfect test for you!
^[Helene]# You'll have to go to the Nemesis Canyon, and return here in one piece!
^[Helene]# And I'm coming with you!
|[Rits]# … Wait, what?!
^[Duke]# … You want to visit the canyon again, Helene?
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 결국 한번 더 협곡에 들어가고 싶다, 이거였군.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# That's the only reason you ever visit this place, I suppose. After all, you hate war.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 전쟁이라면 치를 떠는 네가 주둔지를 찾아올 일은 그것 뿐이겠지.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Please, Duke. Just one last time!
^[Helene]# I'd just like to poke around the abandoned factory a little more.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 지난번에 폐쇄된 공장에서 하던 연구가 안 끝났단 말야..

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hey, don't I have a say in all this?!
^[Helene]# Oh be quiet, Rits!
^[Helene]# All you need to do is help me with my search. After that, you can come back here and be a good little soldier for all I care!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 협곡 수색 한번이면 바로 주둔군의 에이스가 될수도 있다구!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I've even gone to the trouble of preparing the Holy Water, too!
|[Rits]# You… You've had this planned since the beginning, haven't you?
^[Duke]# Helene, I can't let you go to the canyon. You know how dangerous it can be.
entries.ko: [듀크]# 일레느, 협곡은 안 돼. 알잖아, 얼마나 위험한 곳인지.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# I only gave you permission the last time because you had trustworthy mercenaries with you.
entries.ko: [듀크]# 지난번엔 믿음직한 용병들이 호위를 했으니까 허락했지만..

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아, 잠깐 잠깐 이건 또 무슨 소리지?

entries.en: |[Rits]# That I'm not trustworthy?!
^[Duke]# I'm just worried that Helene might be putting a little too much faith in your abilities.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 일레느가 고향친구라고 지나치게 신뢰하는 것 같아서 말이지.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# The canyon is far more dangerous than it looks. What makes you think you are capable of protecting her?
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 자네 생각보다 협곡은 훨씬 위험해. 일레느를 정말 지킬 수 있겠나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Bah! You're supposed to be the Garrison Commander, yet you sound like you're terrified of some puny little monsters!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 흥, 명색이 최전방의 대장이라는 남자가 협곡의 몬스터 따위를 두려워하는군.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# What!? How dare you!
|[Rits]# Those monsters are barely worth the effort…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어차피 용병들, 이라면 여럿이 뭉쳐다니는 피래미지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# But I'll deal with them if I have to!
|[Rits]# Just be prepared to give me an officer's commision when I get back!
^[Helene]# (Wow, I barely had to say anything! Looks like he's got things covered.)
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# (난 아무 말도 안했는데 술술 풀리네... 이래도 되나?)

entries.en: |[Rits]# Let's go, Helene!
^[Helene]# Right! I'm coming!
{Holy Water} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Exploring the Canyon}
^[Helene]# Go ahead, drink it all up. This will grant you full immunity from the toxins in the canyon.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 자, 자, 주우욱 들이켜. 한번만 마시면 면역이 생기니까, 협곡의 독소는 문제없어진다구.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Damn, this tastes like crap!
^[Helene]# Wow, you finished it. The first time I drank this, I threw up!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 와.. 그래도 태연한데? 난 처음마셨을때 다 토해서 두번 마셨거든-

entries.en: |[Rits]# So, what's your relationship with the Garrison Commander?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 나와는 고향친구고.. 주둔군 대장... 과는 무슨 관계지?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Huh?
|[Rits]# It looks like you two are more than just friends.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그냥 안면이 있는 정도가 아닌 것 같던데.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Uh... I'm not so sure about that…
|[Rits]# Not so sure? I guess that's pretty obvious then.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 였을까... 라고 하는 걸 보니 뻔하군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What is he, some kind of "work-in-progress" for you?
|[Rits]# … Whatever. I won't talk about him again.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 네 장단에 맞춰주는 것도 이게 마지막이야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# ... Why is it so hard to talk to you?
^[Helene]# "Work-in-progress"… That's a good one.
^[Helene]# Oh, I'm terribly sorry! I didn't mean to pinch you, I couldn't see anything!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 어머나 호호호 죄송해요, 갑작스러운 빛에 놀라서 꼬집어 버렸네요!

entries.en: &[Askran Soldier]# That hurt, you son-of-a… Young Miss! What is a fine lady like you doing in a dangerous place like this?
entries.ko: 아프 잖아,이 빌어먹을 ... 아가씨! 당신 같은 여자가, 이런 위험한 곳에서 뭐하는거요?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hey! Shouldn't you be going after them instead?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 쓸데없는 얘기 할 시간이 있으면 놈들을 쫓는게 먼저 아닌가!!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Have you lost your mind?! We're in the middle of a war here, damn it!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 전쟁 중에 최전방에서 정신줄을 놓고있구만 아주...!!

entries.en: ^[Duke]# Contact the Torez Garrison immediately! Secure the area!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 일단 토레즈 수비대에 연락하고, 우리는 이곳을 사수한다.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# It could have been a diversion to draw our attention. Stay on your toes, everyone!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 유인책일수도 있어. 모두 경계태세를 최대로 올려라.

entries.en: &[Askran Soldier]# Yes Sir!
^[Duke]# I'll have someone escort you back to Torez, Helene. It's not safe here.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 그리고 한 명 붙여줄테니 토레즈로 돌아가, 일레느. 여긴 전장이다.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# This is no place for someone who is not a warrior.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 전쟁을 반대하는 사람이 있을 곳이 아니야.

entries.en: &[Bohemian merchant]# The war area is dangerous, but I like it here because I can make a good profit.
entries.ko: &[떠돌이상인]# 전쟁 지역은 위험해도 수입이 괜찮아서 좋아요.

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# What I desire is to make strong weapons. I don't care about nations.
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 내가 원하는 건 강한 무기를 만드는 것뿐. 국가 따윈 상관 없어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# That girl…!?
&[Anti-war supporter]# What Torez's upper class desires is not Nemesis forest.
entries.ko: &[반전주의자]# 역시 토레즈의 윗놈들이 바라는 건 네메시스 숲 따위가 아니었어.

entries.en: &[Miner]# The mining industry is the lifeblood of Torez!
&[Miner]# You've done it! The mines are a lot safer now. We can finally return to work!
entries.ko: &[광부]# 그래도 역시 용병들에게 의뢰하는 게 확실하군. 채굴장의 몬스터가 눈에 띄게 줄었다더군!

entries.en: &[Miner]# Here's the reward I promised you!
&[Miner]# Everyone wants to obtain the Soltian relics… They're all blinded by the promise of power.
entries.ko: &[광부]# 다들 솔티아의 유물에 눈이 멀어서.. 전쟁에만 몰두하고 말이지..

entries.en: &[Miner]# I just wish people would pay more attention to what was going on back home.
entries.ko: &[광부]# 사실 우리가 발전하기 위해 지켜야 할 것은 따로있는데.. 안타까워.

entries.en: {Clearing out the Mine} Quest Complete!
&[Miner]# Hey, you're a mercenary, aren't you? I've been trying to find you guys ever since Enzak was destroyed!
entries.ko: &[광부]# 아, 자네 용병인가? 엔자크의 용병길드가 없어져 버려서 이곳에 죽치고 있었는데 다행히 몇명 찾아오는군.

entries.en: &[Miner]# I need your help to restore the lifeblood of Torez! Could you lend me your strength?
entries.ko: &[광부]# 토레즈의 생명줄인 광산을 다시 살리기 위해 용병들의 힘을 빌리고 있는데, 자네도 도와줄 수 있겠나?

entries.en: &[Miner]# As you know, Torez depends on mining for its survival. But there are currently too many monsters roaming about in the mines!
entries.ko: &[광부]# 알다시피 토레즈 광산의 생명줄은 채굴이네만.. 요즘은 몬스터가 넘쳐나 채굴을 할 수 없는 상황이거든.

entries.en: &[Miner]# I'll need you to go in there and clear out the monsters so that it'll be safe for us to work again!
entries.ko: &[광부]# 채굴장을 활성화시키기 위해 그곳의 몬스터 개체수를 줄이는 것을 용병들에게 의뢰하고 있지.

entries.en: &[Miner]# I'll pay you {15,000 Gold# if you can kill {30 Spectres# while in the mines. Please hurry, we'd really like to return to work as soon as possible!
entries.ko: &[광부]# 채굴장의 {스펙터 30마리#를 줄이면 {15,000G#일세. 토레즈의 부흥을 위해 꼭 좀 부탁하네.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Clearing out the Mine}
Not right now, sorry!

entries.en: &[Miner]# You need to clear out {30 Spectres# from the {Stope#.
|[Rits]# … I can't run away from this.
^[Duke]# … We're pulling back.
|[Rits]# … Yes… we are.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# I don't think they're interested in Askran territory. At least, not for now.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 놈들은.. 아스크라의 땅 따위에는 관심이 없는 것 같다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Soltians... Askrans… what's the difference?
|[Rits]# They all want the Guardians' power.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 가디언의 힘을 얻고자 하는 것 뿐인거야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Do we go after them?
^[Duke]# If that is what we must do.
^[Duke]# What's going on? It looks like there's a lot of activity over on the Soltian side…
&[Askran Soldier]# Sir! It looks like they are in pursuit of a single man!

entries.en: ^[Duke]# They're getting too close for comfort. I have to do something about this!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 너무 가까워, 이제 방관할 수 없다!

entries.en: ^[Duke]# Everyone to their battle stations! Now!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 전 병력, 지정된 방어 진지로 이동시켜! 어서!

entries.en: ^[Duke]# What the hell? Isn't that…?
|[Rits]# … Whew… still alive!
{Desperate Escape} Quest Complete!
&[Askran Soldier]# Who are you?!
^[Duke]# Rits?!
|[Rits]# The leader of the Soltians is dead.
^[Duke]# What!?
|[Rits]# It was an inside job, a plot to get them riled up!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 내분이야.. 놈들은 한층 더 공격적이 될거다..!

entries.en: &[Askran Soldier]# Sir! The Soltian troops are massing!
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 듀.. 듀크님! 놈들이 집결하고 있습니다!

entries.en: |[Rits]# They're coming for the ruins of Soltia!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 솔티아의 힘을 손에 넣기 위해.. 놈들은 반드시 온다.

entries.en: ^[Duke]# … They're going for a full-scale attack, aren't they?
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 무슨 소릴 하는거야, 놈들이 먼저 공격해 올거라는 얘긴가?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Yes.
^[Duke]# This is not good! Most of our men and supplies have already been moved to the ruins of Soltia.
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 제길.. 솔티아의 유적쪽으로 대부분의 전력이 차출 되었는데..

entries.en: ^[Duke]# This is going to be an uphill battle!
^[Duke]# Everyone, move quickly!
^[Duke]# We must hold the line! The safety of Askra is at stake!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 여기가 뚫리면, 아스크라의 안전은 보장할 수 없다!!

entries.en: ^[Duke]# No matter the odds, we WILL fulfill our sacred duty as the defenders of our glorious nation!
entries.ko: ^[듀크]# 조국을 지키는 최후의 방어선이라는 성스러운 임무를 지금 수행하자!

entries.en: YYEEEEAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
The defenders are ready. The Soltian forces draw closer every passing moment.
entries.ko: 준비가 끝난 병사들. 그리고 점차 밀려오는 솔티안들.

entries.en: Is this how it all begins?
The tension in the air… It was so thick I could barely breathe!
I will be a part of this battle. There's no running away from that fact.
The awful sounds of war will fill the air very soon.
I have never felt this way before a battle…
This sense of hesitation, it was completely alien to me.
entries.ko: 전장을 앞에두고; 이렇게 망설인 적이 있었던가?

entries.en: For once, here was a fight I had no desire to be part of.
entries.ko: 이게 정말 단지.. 어설픈 정의감이란 건가?

entries.en: }New Quest! {Prelude to War}
{CHAPTER 8; Crossroads#
|[Rits]# Helene... You were right, I think.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 일레느.. 너의 말이 옳았던 것 같다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# The power of the Guardians… is more than just a weapon.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 힘이 전쟁을 일으키는 게 아니라는... 너의 말이.

entries.en: |[Rits]# That girl… she showed me...
|[Rits]# I need to talk to Helene.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 다시 만나서 좀 더 얘기를 해보고 싶군..

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'm so confused right now. I don't know what to do.
{Prelude to War} Quest Complete!

entries.en: &[Bohemian Merchant]# I don't feel safe here anymore.
&[Blacksmith]# It might be peaceful now, but…
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 여기는 은근히 평화로워 졌군. 슬슬 떠나야 하나.

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# I might have to leave in a hurry if things go south.
|[Rits]# ... It's locked!
^[Helene]# Hold on... Here, I have the key.
|[Rits]# … Why are you being so secretive? There's no one else here!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 꼭 이런 음침한 곳에서 만들어야 하는 건가?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Well, technically, we ARE trespassing...
^[Helene]# Just as I thought… Nothing more can be done here.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 예상대로.. 여기서 할 수 있을 만큼의 공정은 끝난 거 같네.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I'm going to need better equipment from the {Black Factory# if any progress is to be made.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만.. 이 이상은 무리야. 역시 {검은 공장# 수준의 설비는 필요해.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What's that? It looks like some kind of toy…
^[Helene]# I built this based upon some plans I found in the Refiner's Ruins.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 리파이너의 유적에서 발견된 연구자료를 토대로 만든거야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I have no idea what it's suppose to do, but it seems pretty harmless.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 용도는 불명이지만, 위험한 물건은 아닌것 같지?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I wouldn't mess around with things like that if I were you.
|[Rits]# You have no idea what it's really capable of.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어떤 결과를 초래할 지 상상이 되지 않나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# It may look like a toy, but for all you know, it might be a weapon just like the Guardians!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아무리 장난감 같아보여도.. 가디언, 그건 병기 그 이상도 그 이하도 아니야.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# If people truly wish to fight, anything can become a weapon, Rits.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 전쟁을 하려는 자의 손에 들어가면 무엇이든 병기가 된다...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# That's… what my father used to say.
^[Helene]# Have you ever realized that technological progress is a lot faster during times of great conflict?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 기술의 발달은 어째서 전쟁을 넘어서야 이루어질까?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I think the Guardians were just a natural part of that progress.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 어쩌면 가디언도, 인류가 걸어온 진보의 길이 아닐까?

entries.en: |[Rits]# What?! Are you crazy?!
|[Rits]# How can you even say that?! We lost our home to these Guardians!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어떻게 가디언에 나라를 잃고도... 그런 생각을 할 수 있는거지..!?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Far more people have lost everything to Fire Arms.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 총기에 의해 나라를 잃은 사람은 더, 훨씬 더 많지.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I believe my father was right about that, at least.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 하지만 난 아버지의 연구가 잘못된 것이 아니라 믿어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# ... Whatever. Forget it.
^[Helene]# Rits, what if the Soltians and the Guardians are-
|[Rits]# Stop right there! I don't want to hear it!
|[Rits]# It's not safe here, let's head back to the {Garrison#.
|[Rits]# We can call it a day from there.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그곳에서 하루빨리 헤어지는 게 나을 것 같군.. 우리는.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Humanity will never change until they learn to appreciate the value of true sacrifice...
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 사람은 정말.. 희생 없이는 변할 수 없는 걸까...

entries.ko: &[상인]# 무더위 속에서도 변치 않는 품질, 엔자크 상회입니다!

entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 제련인가? 아니면 조합인가? 특수조합은 조합서가 필요하다네.

entries.ko: &[군인]# 밖에 나갈땐 항상 준비를 철저히 해. 대장장이는 조금의 재료만으로도 물약을 만들어주니까.

entries.en: |[Rits]# …What are you looking at?
&[Passerby]# … No-nothing! (Scary...)
|[Rits]# That girl… She looks really familiar.
|[Rits]# I didn't think I knew anyone in this town.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이런 동네에 내가 아는 사람이 있을리가 없을텐데 희안하군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Wait a minute. Isn't that Helene?
}New Quest! {A Familiar Face}
|[Kei]# Oh .... Nothing. It's good to meet a soldier now.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 이크크.. 괜히 군인과 마주쳐봐야 좋을 일은 없겠지.

entries.en: &[Girl]# It's a little hot, but I like Enzak so much!
entries.ko: &[소녀]# 좀 덥긴 하지만, 전 엔자크가 참 좋아요!

entries.ko: &[행인]# 요즘 왠지 사막의 모래들이 묘하게 떨리는 듯한 느낌이 들어.

entries.en: &[Merchant]# Hey, kids. Go back. The mercenary guild is not a playground.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 허헛, 애들은 돌아가. 용병 길드는 장난이 아니란다.

entries.en: &[Merchant]# It's hard to find good clients these days. Mostly guys with strange tattoos.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 요즘은 의뢰가 별로 없군. 이상한 문신을 한 놈들도 뜸하고.

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# This is just a little town, but we have everything
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 후줄근한 동네지만 할 건 다 한다고.

entries.en: &[Soldier]# (yawn).. This damn country town is so boring.
&[Passerby]# Many mercenaries came here when the war started, but not these days…
entries.ko: &[행인]# 전쟁이 났다고 한참 용병들이 몰려들더니 요즘은 좀 뜸하네...

entries.en: |[Kei]# A town… Security seems to be pretty lax.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 마을... 인가. 그다지 삼엄해 보이진 않는데.

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# Right on time...  I was only half-expecting you to show up.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 겨우 시간을 맞췄군. 이쪽으로 올 줄은 몰랐는데.

entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 당신이로군요. 그 동굴에 가디언의 기운을 남긴 건...
