entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 역시, 어리지만 리파이너라는 건가. 가디언에 관한 건 완벽하게 파악하는군.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Sien, get away from him!
^[Sien]# Kei?! How did you get back here?
|[Kei]# You idiot, don't you know who this guy is?!
|[Kei]# He's the most formidable warrior in the Askran army! He's just as good as Reah!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 아스크라군 최강의 사내라고! 붉은 마녀 레아 님과도 호각인...

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# I'm honored.
|[Kei]# OK… This is not good.
^[Masked Warrior]# I wouldn't be so quick to judge... I know what you seek, girl, and I can give it to you.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 그건 아냐. 소녀가 원하는 것을 내가 줄 수 있으니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# What?! That's ridiculous!
^[Masked Warrior]# You seek the remnants of Gilberg's knowledge, don't you?
^[Sien]# You know of the Refiner's Ruins?
^[Masked Warrior]# Of course. It is a matter of personal interest to me, as well.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 그래. 나름대로 연구를 하고 있었지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# What?! You don't buy this, do you, Sien?
^[Sien]# Actually… Yes. I believe him.
^[Masked Warrior]# Sounds like her mind is already made up.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 같이 갈 생각은 아닌 것 같군.

entries.en: ^[Sien]#... Kei, please. Return to Neo Soltia.
|[Kei]# I don't believe this! How could you trust him over me?!
^[Masked Warrior]# She has made a wise decision. Her power will only bring about sorrow and tragedy for the ones around her.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 현명한 선택이야. 가디언의 힘은 주변 사람들을 불행하게 만드니까..

entries.en: |[Kei]# You! What do you know about this?!
^[Masked Warrior]# We would all be better off if fewer people were cursed with the burden of the Guardians' power.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 가디언의 업을 짊어진 자가 많아져 봐야 좋을 건 없어.

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# Go home, boy. It's for your own good.
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 돌아가라. 널 위해서 하는 말이다.

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# Let us take our leave.
|[Kei]# NO, YOU BASTARD! GET AWAY FROM HER! DAMN IT!
|[Kei]# Ugh... How long was I out?
|[Kei]# Sien said something about the Refiner's Ruins…
|[Kei]# The pendant... It's directing me to the {Southeast#. I've got to go after them, quickly!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 좋아, 펜던트는 {남동쪽#을 가리키고 있군. 서둘러 정비하고 쫓아가야 해!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Damn it! I can't believe I let this happen!
|[Kei]# I'll show you what happens when you piss off a Guardian Knight, Tin Face!
{The Desert in the North} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Will of a Guardian Knight}
^[Sien]# Kei, even to me, this way doesn't look like the path to the ruins…
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 케이, 내가 봐도 이쪽은 유적이 아닌 거 같은데…

entries.en: |[Kei]# I have no idea what the Warrior of Mask is going to do . Sien is first!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 가면의 검사가 무슨 짓을 할지 몰라. 지금은 시엔이 먼저다!

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Rits, the ruins are to the southeast of the desert.
|[Rits]# I gotta go to the Lighthouse in the north. No time to waste!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 지금 가야할 곳은 북쪽의 등대다. 지체할 틈이 없어!

entries.en: Aaaahhhh! Somebody, help!
|[Kei]# Hey, what's going on?!
&[Enzak Citizen]# Run! Get out of here! The Masked Warrior has lost his mind! He's going on a rampage!
entries.ko: &[엔자크주민]# 어.. 어서 도망가! 가면의 검사가 미쳐서 마을을 다 파괴하고 있어!!

entries.en: &[Soldier]# Hold it right there! What do you think you are doing?!
^[Masked Warrior]# Leave this place now! No one is to remain here!
&[Soldier]# Damn it! You bastard!
&[Soldier]# You'll pay for this! I should have known that a dirty mercenary like you can't be trusted!
entries.ko: &[병사]# 보.. 본국에 보고하겠다, 너의 용병인생은 이제 끝이야!

entries.en: |[Kei]# What's up with Tin Face?! Has he gone crazy?!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저놈은 진짜 미쳤나 갑자기 무슨 짓을...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Whatever! No time to worry about him. I've got to go after Sien!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 어쨌든 저런 놈한테 신경 뺏길때가 아니야. 신호는 여전히 북서쪽이다!

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# … Hurry, boy. We're all counting on you.
&[Girl]# I 've been having a bad feeling these days. I feel like the town will be in danger ...
entries.ko: &[소녀]# 요즘 오싹오싹한 느낌이 들어요.. 마을이 뭔가 위험해진 것 같은..

entries.en: &[Passerby]# There are so many mercenaries with a red wolf tattoo. I heard it is because Soltians appeared.
entries.ko: &[행인]# 붉은 늑대 문신을 한 용병들이 잔뜩이야. 솔티안이 나타났다는 거 같아.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Soltians are strangely quiet nowadays. What are they up to..
entries.ko: &[용병]# 요즘 솔티안 놈들이 이상하게 조용하군. 무슨 꿍꿍이지..

entries.en: &[Merchant]# Enzak Co. offers you best quality always even in the middle of hot weather.
entries.ko: &[상인]# 무더위 속에서도 변치않는 품질, 엔자크 상회입니다!

entries.en: &[Bohemian merchant]# I feel like something big is about to happen…!
entries.ko: &[떠돌이상인]# 이거.. 뭔가 큰일이 날거 같은 분위긴데요..!

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]#I guess the business might be great because of wolf tattoo buddies.
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 늑대 문신들 덕에 장사는 자알 해 먹었구만.

entries.en: &[Soldier]# It is a special order.. Don't touch the tiger tattoo guys.
entries.ko: &[군인]# 위에서 특명이야.. 호랑이 문신은 건드리지 말래.

entries.en: &[Passerby]# What is it with this tensed atmosphere .. Maybe it will calm down once those soltians are gone

entries.en: Aaaarrgghh!
|[Rits]# What was that?!
^[Helene]# Rits, look, over there!
^[Masked Warrior]# Uugghh!
^[Kenneth]# I've been waiting a long time for this!
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 이 기회를 노리고 있었다.. 면 너무 우연같은가?

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# Impossible… How did you…
^[Kenneth]# You tried to evacuate the town, didn't you? Nice try, but it didn't work out as well as you hoped it would!
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 힘으로라도 엔자크 사람들을 피신시키려는 마음은 좋았는데, 빈틈이 너무 많았어.

entries.en: ^[Masked Warrior]# How… dare you!
entries.ko: ^[가면의 검사]# 그걸 이용해먹고도 남을 남자니까.. 당신은!

entries.en: ^[Kenneth]# You've been putting on a great show thus far, but now…
^[Kenneth]# It's my turn to step onto the stage!
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 이제 큰 일을 치뤄야 할 때가 다가오니까.

entries.en: ^[Kenneth]# I hope you don't mind if I borrow this!
|[Rits]# Isn't that…!?
^[Helene]# … Ian!
|[Rits]# The Masked Warrior is... Ian?
^[Helene]# How did he defeat Ian…?
^[Ian]# Uuugh... Just what are you up to?!
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 크윽.. 또 가면으로 모습을 감추고 무슨 짓을 하려고..!!

entries.en: ^[Kenneth]# Haha! Wow. It even changes my voice! Interesting toy you have here, Ian.
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 목소리 변조장치도 있고.. 좋은 가면이야, 이안.

entries.en: ^[Kenneth]# With this, I can take care of the last remaining {Obstacle# easily.
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 이게 있으면, 나머지 한 명의 {방.해.꾼.#을 쉽게 처리할 수 있거든.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# No… You… can't do that!
^[Kenneth]# It is time to restore everything to how it once was…
entries.ko: ^[케네스]# 이대로 흘러가면 돼. 모든 것은 원점으로 돌아간다.

entries.en: ^[Kenneth]# And neither you nor anyone else will stand in my way!
|[Rits]# … So much for being a legendary hero, huh.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 결국.. 통일전쟁의 영웅이란 것들의 실체는 저거로군.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# No…
^[Helene]# We have to evacuate the town immediately, Rits!
|[Rits]# You do it, Helene!
^[Helene]# What?! Where are you going?!
|[Rits]# To the Tower of Light. I know where it is!
^[Helene]# Are you crazy!? We have no idea when Soltia is gonna fall!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 미쳤어? 솔티아가 언제 떨어질 지 모르는데!!

entries.en: |[Rits]# You just focus on getting the people out of here!
|[Rits]# I'll figure out what's going on!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 난 무슨 일이 일어나는 건지 내 눈으로 확인해야 겠어.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Rits, what you're doing is suicide!
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 리츠, 지금 등대로 가는 건 자살 행위야!

entries.en: |[Rits]# There has to be a way to stop Soltia from coming down at the Tower!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어쩌면 등대에, 아직 솔티아를 막을 방법이 있을지도 몰라.

entries.en: |[Rits]# The Soul Stone… I'll destroy it if I have to!
^[Helene]# No, come back, you idiot! It's too late for that!
&[Corbus Soldier]# Sir Kenneth! There's somebody there!
{Enzak in Danger} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {To the Tower of Light}
{CHAPTER 1; Land Of War#
|[Rits]# Damn it! All I've got are some lousy assignments…
&[Guide]# We're pretty far away from the frontlines here.
&[Guide]# Did you come here to join the war effort against the Soltians?
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 리츠씨도 사실은 솔티안과의 전쟁에 참여하기위해 온거잖아요?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Yeah, I'm here to trounce those Soltian bastards.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래, 저 빌어먹을 솔티안 놈들을 좀 밟아주러 왔지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# But before that, I got to line my own pockets first.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그래도 주머니는 좀 채워야 하지 않겠어?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I just got here all the way from the Eastern Lands.. I'm penniless!
&[Guide]# Oh, let me see if I can help you out with that… Looking at the the list of available assignments here..
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 그나마 지금 들어와 있는 의뢰중에선 음..

entries.en: &[Guide]# It looks like the request to deliver a package to the {Northern Ruins# has the best reward.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# {북쪽의 유적#에 물건을 보내달라는 의뢰가 보수가 제일 낫네요.

entries.en: |[Rits]# OK, I'll do it. I can have it delivered by tonight.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그걸로 하지. 당장 오늘 밤이 급하니까.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Alright then, here's the package.
{Mysterious jewel} Obtained!
&[Guide]# You'll have to deliver this jewel to a person bearing a {Red Wolf Tattoo# in the {Ruins resembling the shape of a lighthouse# located in the Northern Desert.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 사막 북쪽, {등대 모양의 유적#에 있는 {붉은 늑대 문신#의 사람에게 이 보석을 전달해 주세요.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Mysterious Jewel}
&[Veteran mercenary]# Would you like me to instruct you on the {Basics of Hunting#?
Weapon Classes
&[Mercenary]# It is very important to understand the properties of the weapons you wield.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #제일 먼저, 자신이 사용하는 무기의 특성을 파악하는 것이 중요하다.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# A {Spear# has low offensive power, but it allows you to equip a {Shield# at the same time, which grants high {Defense# and a chance to block the enemies' attacks.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #{스피어#는 공격력이 약하지만, {방패#를 추가로 들 수 있어 {방어력#이 높고 때로는 적의 공격을 완전히 방어한다.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# The {Sword# has high offensive power and a wide attack range. It also has very high {Accuracy#, but your attacks will be slow.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #{스워드#는 범위가 넓고 공격력이 강하며 매우 높은 {명중률#을 갖지만, 공격 속도가 느리지.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# The {Knife# has a narrow attack range, but it's attack speed is very fast. It also grants you a very high {Evasion Rate#.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #{나이프#는 범위가 좁지만 빠른 공격이 가능하며 매우 높은 {회피율#을 가질 수 있다.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# In regards to Fire Arms, {Guns# specialize in a high rate of fire and critical hits, while {Cannons# do exceptionally high damage but are slow to fire.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #총기 역시 특징이 나뉘어, {건#은 {빠른 공격과 크리티컬#에, {캐논#은 {강력한 한방#에 초점이 맞춰져 있어.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# All classes are able to wield 2 types of weapons. Always bear in mind the advantages of each weapon type in order to make the most out of them.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #모든 클래스는 이중 2개의 무기를 사용한다. 각 무기들의 장점을 기억하고, 특화시키는 것이 강해지는 길임을 기억해라!

entries.en: Offensive Techniques
&[Mercenary]# Every class is capable of two basic offense types. You may perform a combo with your main weapon (tap the main weapon icon), or your secondary weapon (tap the secondary weapon icon).
entries.ko: &[용병]# 각 클래스는 두 종류의 기본공격을 가진다. 주무기(주무기 아이콘 누르기)나 보조 무기(보조 무기 아이콘 누르기)로 콤보를 사용할 수 있지.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Both weapons can be used together for devastating combos. For example, try hitting with your main weapon twice and then one more time with your secondary weapon. Try alternating between weapons during a fight to discover new combos.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 이 두 무기를 함께 쓰면 강력한 콤보를 사용할 수 있지. 예를 들면, 주무기를 두 번 사용하고 보조 무기를 한 번 사용하는 식이지. 전투 시 무기를 번갈아 가면서 사용하여 새로운 콤보를 찾아봐.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Using your secondary weapon in a combo is very beneficial as you would not need to waste time changing your equipped weapon.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #보조 무기의 경우 바로 사용하면 무기를 교체하는 시간이 필요하므로, {콤보로 사용하는 것이 효과적#이야.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Also, the amount of {Mana recovered varies depending on the combos you perform.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 또한, 콤보를 어떻게 조합하느냐에 따라 {마나가 회복되는 양#도 천차만별이지.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Finding the optimal combo will speed up the rate of Mana recovery, allowing you to use powerful skills more frequently. This is the secret to an effective offense!
entries.ko: &[용병]# 최적의 콤보를 찾아, 빠르게 마나를 채워 강력한 스킬을 사용하는 것. 이것이 바로 효율적인 공격의 비밀이다.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# It is not wise to attack the enemy blindly without a plan. All enemies have their own unique characteristics.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #필드로 나간다고 무작정 적을 후려쳤다간 낭패를 보기 쉽다. 적들에게도 특징이란 게 있으니까.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# A {Peaceful Enemy# will not attack you without warning. A {Hostile Enemy#, however, will immediately attack you on sight.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #{평화적인 놈#은 먼저 싸움을 걸어오지 않고 얌전하지만, {호전적인 놈#들은 눈이 마주치면 바로 싸움을 걸어오지.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Peaceful enemies are usually found in the fields out in the open, while hostile enemies are found in the dungeons.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #보통 필드에는 평화적인 놈들이 많고, 던전에는 호전적인 놈들이 많아.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# However, in some cases, peaceful enemies may actually be more dangerous. For example, they have a tendency to retaliate in a group, even if you attacked only one of them.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #하지만 때론 평화적인 놈들이 더 위험할 수 있어. {한 놈을 치면 여러마리가 몰려드는# 경우가 있거든.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# When entering a new area for the first time, it is recommended that you figure out the propensity of the enemies first.
entries.ko: &[용병]# #새로운 사냥터에 들어서면, 우선적으로 적의 성향을 파악하는데 주력하는 것이 좋을 거다.

entries.en: There is nothing more to say.
&[Mercenary]# Choose your weapons carefully during online play. {Short Range Weapons# are slower, but allow you to make good use of {combos#. {Long Range Weapons# are better at {single-hit attacks#.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 네트워크의 전투는 무기의 활용에 달렸다. {근거리 무기#는 발동이 느리지만 {강력한 콤보#를, {원거리 무기#는 {빠른 단타 공격#을 위주로 싸우게 되지.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# When entering a new area for the first time, it is recommended that you figure out the propensity of the enemies first.
entries.ko: &[용병]# 수월한 모험을 위해선 다른 세계의 물품이 필요할 때가 있어. {네트워크 접속#을 해서 {캐시 상점#에 한번 들어가 보라구.

entries.en: &[Mercenary]# Choose your weapons carefully during online play. {Short Range Weapons# are slower, but allow you to make good use of {combos#. {Long Range Weapons# are better at {single-hit attacks#.
entries.ko: &[용병]# {오브#라는 건 말이지, 여러개 결합시킬 수록 그 효과가 상상을 초월해.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Would you like to see if there are new quests available?
Rat Extermination Campaign
Alchemist Council Request
Urban Legend Investigation
This is not a good time.
&[Guide]# Would you like to check the list of requests?
The Supply of Fire Arms Material
The Ultimate Plant
Soltian Invasion
&[Guide]# You can fulfill one request only once.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 하나의 의뢰는 한번만 수행하실 수 있습니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# We don't offer the request to those who didn't sign up in the mercenary register.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 용병 등록이 안 되신 분께는 의뢰를 드리지 않습니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# All the available quests have been completed
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 현재 길드에 들어온 의뢰는 모두 처리하셨습니다.

entries.en: {5 Rat Claws} Delivered!
&[Guide]# Thank you for participating in rat extermation campaign of Enzak.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 엔자크의 쥐 박멸 운동에 참여해 주셔서 감사합니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I don't need appreciation.
{10 Potions, 300 Gold} Obtained!
{Petty Task} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# Enzak are now holding the campaign to exterminate rats raging in the desert in the north area.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 현재 엔자크에선 북쪽 사막지역에 창궐하는 쥐를 박멸하기 위한 운동을 전개중입니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# If you hunt down rats and bring {5 Rat Claws# as evidence, I will give you a reward.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 쥐를 잡으시고, 그 증거로 {쥐 발톱 5개#를 가져오면 소정의 보상품을 드리고 있습니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Such a fool.. Famous mercenary guilds takes this kind of request.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 명색이 용병 길드라면서, 이따위 의뢰나 받고 있다니 한심하군..

entries.en: }New Quest! {Petty Task}
{Soul Chain} Delivered!
&[Guide]# You've completed the request. Here is a Reward from the Alchemist Council.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 의뢰를 완료하셨습니다. 다음은 상금과 연금협회에서 준비한 사은품입니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Is this a guild or a convenient store..?
{Seal of Gorem, 300 Gold} Obtained!
{The Request of Alchemist Council} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# The Alchemist Council requested research material on the Soul Chain, specialty of Enzak.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 연금협회에서 엔자크 특산 {영혼사슬#을 연구 재료로 의뢰해 왔습니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# We offer you the material, so compound a {Soul Chain# through blacksmith's {Blacksmith Recipes#.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 재료는 제공되고 있으니, 대장장이의 {일반조합#을 이용해 {영혼사슬 1개#를 조합해 오십시오.

entries.en: {5 Scorched Leathers} Obtained!
|[Rits]# The Alchemist Council is pretty cheap when it comes to a reward.
}New Quest! {The Request of Alchemist Council}
{5 Bat Wings} Delivered!
&[Guide]# You've completed the request. The materials you've offered will contribute to eliminate a ghost story and attract tourists to Enzak.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 의뢰를 완료하셨습니다. 제공하신 재료는 괴담을 분쇄하고 엔자크의 관광객 유치에 큰 기여를 할 것입니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What are you gonna do if it's a real vampire?
&[Guide]# A beautiful woman like me should leave this town quickly
|[Rits]# Do whatever you want.
{1,000 Gold} Obtained!
{The town's ghost story} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# The rumor about vampires making frequent appearances in Enzak is all over the Winter Hearts.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 엔자크에 흡혈귀가 출몰한다는 소문이 윈터하츠에 만연하다고 합니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Inspectors of Winter Hearts requested research materials related to this issue.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 윈터하츠의 조사단이 이에 관련해 연구자료를 요청했군요...

entries.en: &[Guide]# Please bring {5 Bat Wings# in the ruined Light House.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 등대 형태의 유적 지역에서, {박쥐의 날개를 5개# 구해 오십시오.

entries.en: |[Rits]# A vampire.. Inspectors really come for such a thing?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 흡혈귀.. 그런 걸로 정말로 조사단이 온다고?

entries.en: }New Quest! {The town's ghost story}
{5 Fire Arms Components} Delivered!
&[Guide]# Thank you on behalf of the guild. I guess the development of Fire Arms technology within our guild will increase greatly.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 길드를 대표해서 감사드립니다. 길드의 자체 총기 개발 기술도 크게 발전할 듯합니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Can I buy cheaply if the guild manufactures Fire Arms? They are generally very expensive.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 길드에서 총기를 제조하면 싸게 구매가 가능한 건가? 공짜는 아닐 테고.

entries.en: &[Guide]# I think we'll sell them to the mercenaries on the battlefield first. Once we produce enough, we'll sell them to general mercenaries as well.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 일단은 전장 쪽 용병들에게 우선으로 판매할 듯하네요. 물량이 확보되면 일반 용병에게도 판매가 될 겁니다.

entries.en: {2,000 Gold} Obtained!
{The Supply of Fire Arms} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# Recently, the supply of fire arms within the guild has been insufficient.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 최근 길드 내에 총기 수급이 원활하지 않습니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# But you're not seriously expecting us to sell you fire arms.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# .. 라고 해도, 우리에게 길드에 총기를 갖다바칠 충성심을 기대하진 않겠지.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Of course not. We can't buy fire arms continuously anyway, due to serious financial problems.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 물론입니다. 다만, 계속해서 총기를 사들이는 건 적자가 심해서..

entries.en: &[Guide]# We offer a little reward to those bringing {5 Fire Arms Components#.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# {총기재료#를 5개 구해오시는 분께 소정의 사례금을 드리고 있습니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Hm.. It seems they are going to produce Fire Arm by themselves
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 흠.. 총기를 자체적으로 만들어 보겠다는 건가.

entries.en: }New Quest! {The Supply of Fire Arms}
&[Guide]# We received the report about you getting rid of the Elder Mushfulra of Rowen.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 로우엔의 엘더 머쉬풀라의 퇴치가 보고되었습니다. 어려운 임무였는데 훌륭하시네요!

entries.en: |[Rits]# It's no big deal.
&[Guide]# But I heard the number of Elder Mushfulra has been increasing lately.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 하지만 엘더 머쉬풀라는 개체 수가 계속 늘어나고 있다고 하네요.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Unfortunately, as the number has increased, the reward has decreased.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 아쉽지만 개체 수가 많아지면서 포상금이 상대적으로 줄었는데…

entries.en: |[Rits]# Stop making excuses. Just give it to me.
{3,000 Gold} Obtained!
{The Ultimate Plant} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# For this new request you have to travel a little far. Are you okay with it?
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 약간 멀리 나가야 하는 의뢰인데, 괜찮으시겠어요?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I don't care.I will take care of it later when I have enough time.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 뭐 상관없어. 일단 받아두고 시간 날 때 처리하면 되니까.

entries.en: &[Guide]#  You have to hunt down a {Plant form of Monster# that appeared in the {Rowen area#.
&[Guide]# Despite the fact it's just a plant, it is really tough. I heard the journey between Winter Hearts and Torez is very dangerous because of it.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 식물이라고 생각되지 않을 만큼 생명력이 강해서, 윈터하츠와 토레즈 간의 이동이 원활하지 못하다고 하네요.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Whatever! I'll do it.
}New Quest! {The Ultimate Plant}
{10 Soltian's Marks} Delivered!
&[Guide]# Oh..  It's the Soltian's Marks. You're the first one who actually finished this request!
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 핫.. 솔티안의 문장이네요, 이 의뢰를 해결하신 분은 처음이군요!

entries.en: |[Rits]# I had a chance to get them all.
&[Guide]# Normally, they just give up after killing one or two Soltian spies. You're awesome.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 보통은 솔티안 첩자 한두명 잡고 포기하던데, 대단하시네요.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'm always open to a request like this.
{4,000 Gold} Obtained!
{Soltian's Mark} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# Have you heard Soltians make a frequent appearance within Askran these days?
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 솔티안들이 요즘 아스크라 내에 출몰한다는 소식은 들으셨나요?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I've even encountered them before. Did you find them?!
&[Guide]# No. I think they're more than just one or two. It seems they are spying in many locations.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 아니, 한두 명이 아닌 듯합니다. 곳곳에서 침입해 들어와 염탐하는 듯하네요.

entries.en: &[Guide]# I don't know when and where, but if you encounter Soltians, make sure you kill them and acquire their {Mark#.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 언제, 어디가 될진 모르겠지만, 솔티안들을 마주치면 반드시 사살하고 그들의 {문장#을 확보해주세요.

entries.en: &[Guide]# Our country grants a reward to warriors acquiring {10 Soltian's Mark#.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# {솔티안의 문장 10개#를 확보한 전사에게는 본국으로부터 소정의 보상이 있을것입니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]#.. That is best request I've received here.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# .. 이곳에서 받은 의뢰중에 제일 맘에드는 의뢰로군 그래.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Soltian's Mark}
{20 Corbus's Mark} Delivered!
&[Guide]# … Thank you. The HQ of our guild will identify the Mark
entries.ko: &[안내원]# ... 감사합니다. 해당 문장에 대한 판단은 길드 지휘부에서 있을 것입니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Tell the old fellas that the Corbus guild actually exists,
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 코르버스 길드는 실존한다, 고 노친네들한테 전해줘.

entries.en: |[Rits]# And they're aiming at bigger things than hunting rights.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 놈들은 사냥터 이권 따위보다 더 큰 고기를 노리고 있다고도...

entries.en: {5,000 Gold} Obtained!
{The Enmity between Guilds} Quest Complete!
&[Guide]# According to our intel, mercenaries with a red wolf tattoo have been recently appearing around Enzak.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 근래 부쩍 엔자크 주변에 붉은 늑대 문신의 용병들이 자주 보인다고 합니다.

entries.en: &[Guide]# If the rumor about the Corbus guild is true, we should investigate this.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 소문의 {코르버스 길드#가 실존하는 거라면, 우리 길드 입장에선 견제를 해주어야 하겠죠.

entries.en: &[Guide]# To get to the bottom of this, please acquire {20# of the {Marks# they are carrying.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 진위를 파악하기 위해, 그들이 가지고 다니는 {문장#을 {20개#만 확보해주시기 바랍니다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# The mercenary guild will also be interested about this.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 나름대로, 신경을 쓰긴 쓰는군.. 용병 길드에서도.

entries.en: }New Quest! {The Enmity between Guilds}
&[Guide]# There are no more new requests for now. Please focus on acuiring the unknown guild's Mark.
entries.ko: &[안내원]# 더 의뢰가 없습니다. 일단 {정체불명의 길드원들이 가진 문장# 확보에 주력해주세요.

entries.en: {[Vanished earth]};… the land in this part of Erebos has a very unnatural look. This is most noticeable in the western end.
entries.ko: {[사라진 대지]#};... 에레보스 대륙은 묘하게 부자연스러운 형태를 띠고 있다. 가장 눈에 띄는 것은 대륙의 서쪽 끝.

entries.en: }It's like the trace of a once gigantic peninsula. This area is called the land of dusk and became the object of people's long-cherished desire.
entries.ko: }마치 거대한 반도 하나가 사라져버린 듯한 그 흔적은, 황혼의 땅이라 불리며 사람들이 동경하는 대상이 되었다.

entries.en: }Maybe it has something to do with some Guardian researchers who allegedly vanished all together about 100 years ago…
entries.ko: }어쩌면, 그것은 100여년전 일제히 사라졌다는 일단의 가디언 연구자들과 어떤 연관이 있는 건 아닐까? ...

entries.en: {[To find out the Enzak's truth]}; …According to old research reports, the impoverished Enzak desert used to be a rich field.
entries.ko: {[엔자크의 진실을 찾아]#}; ... 하지만 그 피폐한 엔자크 사막도 한때는 비옥한 초원이었다는 연구 결과가 나오고 있다.

entries.en: }Knowing this, we can imagine what dangerous research on the Guardians was performed there.
entries.ko: }그 사실을 통해 우리는 그곳에서 이루어졌던 가디언에 대한 연구가 얼마나 위험했는지를 반추할 수 있다.

entries.en: }As you can imagine, the following ideas are based on the fact that the Refiner actually existed.
entries.ko: }여기까지만 봐도 예상하지만, 앞으로 다룰 내용은 리파이너가 정말로 존재했다는 가정을 기반으로 하고 있다. ...

entries.en: {[The turning point of the unification war]} … When the Guardians were revealed to the people, it represented a turning point in history…
entries.ko: {[통일 전쟁의 반환점]#}; ... 역사가 낳은 허구라고 생각되던 가디언의 존재가 그의 손에 의해 사람들 앞에 드러났을 때-

entries.en: }Everyone must have felt at least one thing amongst delight, despair, fear, hope…
entries.ko: }모든 이들은 환희, 절망, 공포, 희망의 네 가지 감정 중 적어도 한 가지 이상씩은 본능적으로 느꼈을 것이다.

entries.en: }Under the influence of these feelings, the unification war has come to an end very quickly.
entries.ko: }그 감정의 지배하에, 거짓말처럼 빠르게 통일 전쟁은 마무리되어 갔다. 아스크라의 이름으로.. ...

entries.en: {[Country and Religion]} … The strong partnership of Askra kingdom and Legalis religion.
entries.ko: {[국가와 종교]#}; ... 아스크라 왕국과 레갈리스 교단의 굳건한 결착.

entries.en: }The regal power might collapse when religion loses it's influence.
entries.ko: }이렇게 교권을 기반으로 형성된 왕권은 종교가 그 신뢰를 잃을 때 함께 붕괴할 위험성이 다분하다.

entries.en: }If the Legalis religion loses its support someday, the Askra government will have to find another way to ensure the people's loyalty.
entries.ko: }언젠가 레갈리스교가 그 신앙적 지지를 잃게 된다면, 아스크라 정부는 국민의 뜻을 모을 다른 어떤 방법을 강구해야 할 것이다. ...

entries.en: }After the High Priest Julike went missing, the rainfall of rocks, outrageous beasts, and epidemic rampaged about the land.
entries.ko: 교황 율리케의 실종 직후, 바위의 비와 흉악한 비스트, 돌림병이 대륙을 휩쓸었으니.

entries.en: }Who were the ones who lost their faith? The ones who betrayed the truth of the world against the High Priest's will..
entries.ko: }누구인가, 믿음을 저버린 자는, 교황의 의지에 반하여 끝끝내 세계의 진실을 배신한 자는..

entries.en: }We must face the wrath the gods of Legalis on the upcoming judgement's day.
entries.ko: }우리는 흔들림 없이 레갈리스의 신들을 추종하며 다가올 심판의 날에 거인신들과 맞서야 할 것이다. ...

entries.en: {[The shadow of hero]};… Two heroes remain silent even in the middle of the collapse of Legalis religion, inner strife of Askra, and forebodings of apocalyse.
entries.ko: {[영웅의 그림자]#};... 레갈리스 교단의 붕괴와 아스크라의 내분, 종말의 징후들 속에서도 두 영웅은 침묵하고 있다.

entries.en: }Ian and Kenneth. Are they really satisfied with what has happened?
entries.ko: }이안과 케네스, 그들은 정녕 과거의 위업에 만족하는 것일까?

entries.en: }Maybe this is the true world they've been really looking forward to…
entries.ko: }아니, 어쩌면 이것이야말로 진정 그들이 원하는 세계의 모습일지도 모르겠다. ...

entries.en: {[The wisdom of life]};… It's a good idea to drink a beer ice cold.
entries.ko: {[생활의 지혜]#};... 맥주가 미지근해졌을 때에는 얼음을 넣어 마시면 좋다...

entries.en: &[Keeper]# When you get old, you can't read books anymore even though you want to. Read as many books as you can when you are young.
entries.ko: &[관리인]# 늙으면 읽고 싶어도 못 읽는 게 책이야. 젊을 때 부지런히 읽으라고.

entries.en: &[Bookworm]# When can I get the detailed info about the collapse of Legalis religion?
entries.ko: &[독서광]# 레갈리스교 붕괴에 대한 좀 더 정확한 정보는 언제쯤 나올까?

entries.en: &[Girl]# Refiner is something like a magician? I'd like to see it someday.
entries.ko: &[소녀]# 리파이너라는 건, 마법사 같은 걸까요? 직접 보고 싶어요.

entries.en: &[Guest]# Alas- Torez is allegedly prosperous thanks to the war, but there is no work to do in Enzak..
entries.ko: &[투숙객]# 아- 토레즈는 전쟁으로 대호황이라는 데, 엔자크는 영 돈벌이할 게 보이질 않는구나..

entries.en: &[Staff]# The room is 300 Gold. Would you like to take a rest?
&[Staff]# Oh my, this is such a rare thing..
^[Helene]# The holy water will guide your path, so relax..
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 성스러운 물의 가호가 있을거예요. 그러니 마음 푹 놓으세요..

entries.en: &[Staff]# I really appreciate this. How can I pay you back?
|[Rits]#  That charm seems to be worth about 5,000 Gold.
^[Helene]# I don't need any payment. We'll rest here for a while. Just take good care of us.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 보답은 무슨요. 앞으로도 자주 들릴 텐데 잘 챙겨주시기만 하면 돼요.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Do you even know what my profession is?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 너 내 직업이 뭔지는 알고 있냐?

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Sure. You're a mercenary…?
|[Rits]# A mercenary is not a philanthropist!
^[Helene]# Don't worry, don't worry. I'll give you a reward later on. But now I'm penniless.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 걱정마 걱정마. 보상은 꼭 해줄게. 지금은 내가 무일푼이라..

entries.en: |[Rits]# Come to think of it, I didn't get anything for the escorting Torez case or the gorge case.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그러고 보니 지난번 토레즈 호위 건도, 협곡 호위 건도..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# I'm not gonna cheat you about the money. Don't worry, you stingy …
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 안 떼어먹을 테니까 걱정하지 말라고, 쪼잔하긴..

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Do you want me to kiss you instead? It's quite expensive..
|[Rits]# I'd better cease talking…
^[Helene]# You'll regret it..
|[Rits]# Just follow me quickly.
{Restless minds of people} Quest Complete!
&[Staff]# Sir, did something serious happen in the desert area?
entries.ko: &[종업원]# 손님, 혹시 무슨 큰일이라도 났나요? 사막지역에…

entries.en: |[Rits]# …well, Did you hear some kind of rumor?
&[Staff]# No.. A fortune-teller came here yesterday..and told me this town will disappear soon..
entries.ko: &[종업원]# 아뇨.. 어제 찾아온 한 점쟁이가.. 이제 곧 이 마을이 사라져 버릴 거라고...

entries.en: |[Rits]# Don't believe such a thing. It's never gonna happen.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 점쟁이의 말 따위 믿지마. 그런일은 없을 거다.

entries.en: &[Staff]# But war, Soltians' invasion.. There are too many restless things…
entries.ko: &[종업원]# 하지만 전쟁에, 솔티안들의 침입에.. 불안한 일들 뿐인걸요...

entries.en: ^[Helene]# Don't worry. Nothing..will happen.
&[Staff]# This inn is all our family has.. I'm afraid if it's gone…
entries.ko: &[종업원]# 저희 가족에겐 이 여관이 전부예요.. 사라져 버릴까 두려워서...

entries.en: ^[Helene]#Take this. It is the {The Charm of Woondine#.
&[Staff]# That.. Is too.. Expensive…
^[Helene]# Don't worry. As one of the patrons of this store, I can give you one.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 걱정 말아요. 저도 나름 이가게 단골인데. 하나 장만해 드릴게요.

entries.en: ^[Helene]# If you have the water spirit's guard, will you calm down?
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 물의정령의 수호가 있으면, 안심하실 수 있겠죠?

entries.en: |[Rits]# What is it?
^[Helene]# It's a charm. The water spirit's charm, and is really invaluable to people in the desert.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 뭐긴 뭐야. 부적이지.. 사막의 사람들에게 물의 정령의 부적은 굉장히 소중하다고.

entries.en: |[Rits]# You got even something like that?
^[Helene]# No, but I will get it.
|[Rits]# you, you…
^[Helene]# I can understand people feeling restless. I wanna ease their anxiety a little bit..
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 사람들이 불안해 하는 심정도 이해가 가. 조금이라도 그 불안감을 덜어주고 싶어..

entries.en: |[Rits]# It was you who said we got no time.
^[Helene]# It'll only take a few minutes. We can compound it from a {Blacksmith#. Please, Rits.
entries.ko: ^[일레느]# 금방이야. {대장장이#에게서 조합하면 되는 걸. 부탁해 리츠, 응?

entries.en: }New Quest! {Restless Minds of People}
|[Rits]# Unbelievable…she just does as she pleases…
&[Staff]# The inn is always topsy-turby because mercenaries are our main customers..but I'm happy as long as there are many guests.
entries.ko: &[종업원]# 용병들이 주 고객이다 보니 여관 상태가 늘 엉망이지만.. 손님은 많아서 좋아요.

entries.en: &[Boy]# What does it feel like to be a hero? If only I had a sword...
entries.ko: &[소년]# 영웅이 된다는 건 어떤 기분일까? 나에게 검이 있다면…

entries.en: |[Kei]# (I now have a {Gladius# but..)
Hand it over.
&[Youth]# … A sword?!
|[Kei]# Look, I couldn't stand seeing you behave like that, alright?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 같은 영웅지망생으로서, 찌질대는 모습을 더 볼 수가 없더라고.

entries.en: &[Youth]# Who.. are you?
|[Kei]# My name is Kei! If you want be a hero, you got to do something about it! Just like me!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 케이, 19세! 영웅을 지망한다면 지금 바로 움직이라고, 나처럼!

entries.en: &[Youth]# This may not be my father's sword, but…
&[Youth]# Yes, I understand now! I will never show weakness again!
entries.ko: &[청년]# 내가 너의 마음에 부응해 주지! 다시는 찌질한 모습을 보이지 않으마!

entries.en: &[Youth]# Next time we meet, I'll be strong enough to be your rival! Be ready for it!
entries.ko: &[청년]# 다음에 만날 때는 라이벌이 되어 있을 테니, 각오하라고!

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Well that wasn't what I was expecting at all.
entries.ko: |[케이]# ... 뭐 딱히 보상을 기대한 건 아니지마는...

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'm fine with no reward, but he didn't even say "thank you"! I feel somewhat cheated.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 저렇게 인사도 없이 파바박 사라지니 뭔가 당한 듯한 기분이..

{Factory Tour} Quest Complete!
|[Kei]# Robe the Blacksmith, I presume?
&[Robe]# Haha! You know my name, which means you're after something! What do you want, boy?
entries.ko: &[로브]# 흐흐, 내 이름을 알고 찾아오다니. 깨끗한 친구는 아닌 것 같군.

entries.en: |[Kei]# I'd like to get in touch with Elgis.
&[Robe]# Oh, look what we've got here! A curious young fellow! I bet you have many questions you'd like answered!
entries.ko: &[로브]# 오호라, 젊은 친구가 세상에 관심이 많은데?

entries.en: &[Robe]# But I'm afraid I can't help you there, my friend. I'm terribly sorry, but I know nothing about Elgis.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 엘지스 같은 건 그저 헛소문인데... 누가 나를 찾으라던가?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Helene sent me.
&[Robe]# … Ah. How about a tour of the factory instead? Maybe that would satisfy your curiousity.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 엘지스는 모르겠고, 공장 견학은 시켜줄 수 있어.

entries.en: &[Robe]# You'll need an {Entry Pass#, though. Bring me {10 Polishing Powders# and {5 Dark Stones#, and I will make you an Entry Pass.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 원한다면, 몰래 {출입카드#를 만들어줄 수 있어. {연마가루 10개#와 {흑암석 5개#만 모아오면 내가 조합해주지.

entries.en: &[Robe]# Since Helene sent you, I suppose it's the least I could do.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 일레느의 소개라면 그 정도 성의는 보여야겠지?

entries.en: |[Kei]# (I remember Helene mentioned something about a gathering in the factory… )
|[Kei]# Sure, a tour of the factory would be great! I'll be back soon!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 공장 견학이라, 꼭 해보고 싶네요. 재료는 금방 모아올게요!

entries.en: {The Town of Rowen} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Factory Tour}
&[Kid]# I enjoy playing outside, but My parents don't let me to go out since the number of demons have increased lately.
entries.ko: &[꼬마]# 나가 노는 게 좋은데, 요즘 마물들이 늘어났다고 어른들이 못 나가게 해요-

entries.en: &[Man]# The townsfolk are all afraid of the Gargoyles that roam about to the southeast…
entries.ko: &[남자]# 다들 마을 남동쪽에 출현한 가고일들을 두려워하고 있어..

entries.en: |[Kei]# I thought you wanted to fight them?
&[Man]# We cannot! They are the offspring of the Great Demon Shiva!
&[Man]# We can only await the return of the Legalis gods…
entries.ko: &[남자]# 우린.. 레갈리스의 신들이 돌아와주길 바라는 수 밖에..

entries.en: |[Rits]# As expected..Being brave is not an easy thing.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 역시.. 용기란 그렇게 가벼운 게 아니지.

entries.en: &[Man]# Thank you! Here is a small reward for your trouble!
entries.ko: &[남자]# 고마워, 이건 약소하지만 내가 주는 보상이야!

entries.en: &[Man]# … !!! …These horns…
&[Man]# They are all enchanted with the magic of Shiva!
&[Man]# Could it be that the Legalis Church was right all along?!
{The Demons of the South} Quest Complete!
&[Man]# I have no idea why people are so terrified.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 난 사람들이 왜이렇게 겁에 질려있는지 모르겠어.

entries.en: &[Man]# We have more than enough weapons and manpower.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 우리에겐 무기를 만들 공장도 있고, 사람도 충분한데..

entries.en: &[Man]# I think we can handle the {Demons# to the {southeast# easily.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 마을 {남동쪽#에 출현한 {데몬#들과도 충분히 싸울 수 있다고 생각해.

entries.en: &[Man]# I just want to prove to everyone that the demons can be defeated!
entries.ko: &[남자]# 모두에게 용기를 주고 싶어. 데몬들을 쓰러트릴 수 있다는 걸 보여주고 싶어!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Exactly how strong are these demons you're talking about?
&[Man]# Not very strong at all! What we're lacking here is courage!
entries.ko: &[남자]# 강하겠지.. 하지만 못 이길 것도 없어. 우리에게 필요한 건 용기라구!

entries.en: &[Man]# Do you think you can help me? Bring back as many of their {Horns# as you can?
entries.ko: &[남자]# 모험가라면 부탁할게. 놈들의 {뿔#을 따와 줘, 되도록 많이!

entries.en: |[Kei]# How many?
&[Man]# 15 should be enough. The people must know that the demons are far from invincible!
entries.ko: &[남자]# 15개 정도면 돼. 데몬들이 쓰러트릴 수 있는 상대란 걸 보여줄 수만 있으면 다들 싸울 수 있을거야!

entries.en: Leave it to me!
&[Man]# Thank you! You are indeed a real hero!
entries.ko: &[남자]# 고마워, 넌 우리 마을을 구할 영웅이 될거야!

entries.en: }New Quest! {The Demons to the South}
Not interested.
&[Man]# Ugh. I thought you were braver than that!
|[Rits]# Why don't you throw them some dead bodies?
&[Guy]# No way, I can't do it alone…That's too much..
&[Guy]# Are you an adventurer? Can you help me by bringing back their {Horns#?
entries.ko: &[남자]# 자네 모험가인가! 날 대신해서 놈들의 {뿔#을 따와줄 수 있나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'm a mercenary. You should show me your respect
&[Guy]# 15 should be enough.I will pay you. You won't be dissappointed.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 15개 정도면 돼. 내 사례는 분명히 해주지!

entries.en: Fine then.
&[Guy]# Thanks, Maybe our town will get its courage back, thanks to you.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 고마워, 이걸로 우리 마을도 용기를 되찾을 수 있을 거야!

entries.en: }New Quest! {Demon of the South}
Do it by your hands
&[Guy]# No way..I can't do it alone...
&[Man]# Please bring back 15 {Demon Horns#.
&[Old man]# Soltians are raging in the west, gargoyles are increasing in the south… We shouldn't have abandoned the Legalis religioin.
entries.ko: &[노인]# 서쪽에는 솔티안들이 극성이고, 남쪽에는 가고일들이 점점 늘어나.. 우리는 레갈리스교를 버려서는 안 되는 거였어.

entries.en: &[Merchant]# Welcome, we're just a small-town store, but there is nothing we don't have.
entries.ko: &[상인]# 어서 오세요, 시골 가게지만 있을 건 다 있답니다~

entries.en: &[Robe]# …For your information, the card can be used only once. When you need to enter again, compound it here.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 참고로 공장 출입카드는 일회용이야. 들어갈 때마다 하나씩 조합해야 한다구.

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# This is the most famous forge in Rowen. We'll make an unbreakable shield!
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 로우엔의 대표 대장간입니다. 절대 깨지지 않는 방패를 만들어 드리죠!

entries.en: &[Mrs. folk]# This town is small and weak, so I'm always scared.. I'd better go to Torez..
entries.ko: &[아줌마]# 이 마을은 작고 약해서, 항상 불안해.. 어서 토레즈로 가야..

entries.en: &[Robe]# I like your eyes
&[Robe]# You're pretty quick. Hold on… here you go!
&[Robe]# You look pretty strong, so I'm not too worried. We have some pretty tight security measures in place though, so be careful.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 제법 강해보이는 용병이니 걱정은 않겠지만, 경비체제가 튼튼하니 조심해.

entries.en: &[Robe]# To get past security, just {cut off the power#.
|[Rits]# I'll keep that in mind, thanks!
{Automated Security System} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {A Forbidden Gathering}
|[Rits]# Hey, I'd like to get in to that factory.
&[Robe]# What, another one?! Who sent you?!
entries.ko: &[로브]# 뭐야, 자넨 또 누구 소개로 온거지?

entries.en: |[Rits]# (Someone's been here before me. I wonder who...)
|[Rits]# Helene sent me.
&[Robe]# … That Helene, I fear she's too trusting…
entries.ko: &[로브]# ... 거참, 일레느도 신입을 너무 과하게 들이는구만.

entries.en: &[Robe]# I made an Entry Pass for a red-haired boy just a while ago.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 좀 전에도 빨간머리 꼬마가 카드를 받아가더니...

entries.en: |[Rits]# … That sounds familiar.
|[Rits]# (In any case, I've found someone who can get me an Entry Pass.)
&[Robe]# Here, let me help you with that.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 뭐 어쨌든.. 내가 할 일이 큰건 아니지만.

entries.en: &[Robe]# Bring me {10 Polishing Powders# and {5 Dark Stones#.
&[Robe]# I'll need those items in order to make you an {Entry Pass#.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 모아오면 조합해 주지, 공장 견학을 위한 {씨크릿 카드#를 말이야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Fine, I'll be back soon.
|[Rits]# You seriously think your plan is going to work out?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그런 방법으로 정말 될 거라고 생각하는 건 아니겠지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# And where do you think you're going?!
^[Ian]# Elgis was never meant to be a military organization.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 그들은 전투인원이 아니야. 애초부터 그걸 기대하고 만든 조직도 아니고..

entries.en: ^[Ian]# But… like you said, this situation can't be solved peacefully.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 다만.. 당신 말대로 지금 상황은, 평화적인 방법으로만 해결할 수 있는 상황이 아니니까.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I've accomplished only 1 of the 3 tasks.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 해야할 일 세가지 중에 한가지밖에 해결못했어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Even if we can force the Askran forces to retreat, how do we stop Kenneth?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아스크라군을 유적에서 퇴각시키고, 케네스를 막을 방법은 있는 건가?

entries.en: ^[Ian]# There is a way.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 아스크라군을 멈출 방법은 한 가지 있어.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# I will take down Melpheto.
^[Ian]# After that, you'll be free to infiltrate the ruins… and stop Kenneth.
|[Rits]# You mean to decapitate the Corbus Guild leadership.
^[Ian]# … Kenneth is behind all of this.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# ... 내겐 케네스가 이 전쟁의 배후라는 확신이 있어.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# And only I and Reah can stop him.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 그리고 그를 막을 수 있는 건 나와 레아 뿐이다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Only a Guardian can handle another Guardian, huh.
^[Ian]# I don't know if I can handle both Melpheto and Kenneth, though.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 하지만 솔직히.. 혼자서는 둘 다 해낼 자신이 없군.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# Reah may have already been defeated by now.
|[Rits]# Hah! It's your lucky day.
|[Rits]# I have a personal vendetta against Melpheto…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 내 복수의 대상이 당신에서 멜페토로 바뀐 걸 말이야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … due to something that happened recently.
^[Ian]# … Very well. I understand.
|[Rits]# Leave Melpheto to me. You go stop Kenneth.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 멜페토는 나에게 맡겨라. 당신이 케네스를 막아.

entries.en: |[Rits]# He's probably too much for me to handle anyway.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 내게는 케네스라는 남자를 막을 방법이 없으니 각자 할 수 있는 걸 하자고.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# If even one of us fails, an incredible catastrophe will be the result. Are you ready for this?
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 둘 중 하나라도 실패하면 참극이 일어날거야. 괜찮겠나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# I'm not the type to leave my fate up to someone else.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 넋놓고 다른 사람에게 운명을 맡기는 체질이 아니라서.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Besides, our chances of success are better if we do this together.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그리고 한 명이 둘 모두 맡는 것 보단 성공 확률이 높겠지.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# ... Then we shall head for the ruins!
^[Ian]# But before that, I ask of you to put aside your hatred for me for now.
^[Ian]# I will not seek to hide from the consequences.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 내가 지은 죄에 대한 대가라면.. 피하진 않을 테니.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# For what it's worth, I apologize… for all that I've done in the past.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 사죄하마. 분명히 과거의 나는 죄를 지었었다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … Heh. I'm not interested in you anymore.
|[Rits]# I want Melpheto's blood!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 지금은 너보다, 멜페토 그 변질자 부단장 놈이 훨씬 죽일가치가 있겠어.

entries.en: {The Final Change} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Battlefield at the Ruins}
&[Boy]# It would be great if the adventurer at the inn was just a little more brave.
entries.ko: &[꼬마]# 여관에 있는 모험가 아저씨도, 좀 더 용감하면 멋있을 텐데.

entries.en: &[Guy]# It looks like the Gargoyles have evoluated greatly. Not to mention their large numbers. There is nothing we can do about them anymore.
entries.ko: &[남자]# 가고일들의 수도 수지만, 엄청 진화한거 같아. 이제 손쓸 수가 없어.

entries.en: &[Old Man]# Restoring the Legalis religion is the only way to get out of this disaster!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 레갈리스교를 재건하는 것만이 이 재앙을 벗어나는 길인게야!

entries.en: &[Old Man]# Oh my! I thought I'd never see this chest with my own eyes ever again!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 오오오.. 이 보석함을 다시 보게 될 줄이야...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Why don't you check it out?
&[Old Man]# Yes, yes! It's been almost half a century since the last time I opened this!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 그러도록 하지, 이걸 열어보는 게 거진 반세기 만이로군!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Wow… that's really shiny, alright!
&[Old Man]# Here it is! The Reid Family Crest!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 이것이 리이드가의 저력이지.. 우린 다시 일어설 수 있어..!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Aha, there IS a {Soul Stone# in here!
&[Old Man]# That's the gem you were looking for? It doesn't look all that impressive...
entries.ko: &[노인]# 허.. 그런 걸 찾고 있었는가.. 그다지 귀해보이지도 않네만...

entries.en: &[Old Man]# You deserve a bigger reward than that, young man! Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
entries.ko: &[노인]# 그 정도로는 내가 마음이 부족할세. 내 사례금을 좀더 처주도록 하지.

entries.en: {Soul Stone, 20,000 Gold} Obtained!
&[Old Man]# With the Family Crest, I can finally restore my clan to it's former glory!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 이 문장으로 다시 시작할 수 있어. 당주를 잃고 뿔뿔히 흩어진 일족을 모아..

entries.en: &[Old Man]# I'll revive the Legalis Church in the name of the house of Reid!
{The Reid Family Crest} Quest Complete!
&[Old Man]# We're going to need the power of the Legalis Church to face those demons!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 이제 저 마물들과 맞서려면 레갈리스교를 재건하는 것 뿐이야..

entries.en: &[Old Man]# We used to have great influence once… but not anymore. Our members have been scattered all over.
entries.ko: &[노인]# 우리가 정신적 지주가 되어야 하는데, 이렇게 뿔뿔히 흩어져 있으니...

entries.en: |[Kei]# Were you a senior member of the Legalis Church?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그.. 무슨 교에서 중요한 분이셨나 봐요?

entries.en: &[Old Man]# Six years ago, the Duke of our clan was assassinated. Before that, we used to serve the High Priest really closely…
entries.ko: &[노인]# 6년 전 당주가 암살되기 전까지만 해도, 우린 교황님을 가장 가까운 곳에서 모셨었더랬지..

entries.en: &[Old Man]# But all that is history now. Even our Family Crest has fallen into the hands of the demons!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 이젠 무리야. 가문의 힘을 모으기 위한 문장도 악마의 손에 떨어지게 생겼어.. 끌끌..

entries.en: &[Old Man]# I just wish to see the Family Crest one last time before I die… To me, it outshines all the other precious stones kept in the very same jewel chest!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 내 죽기전에 그 문장을 한번더 보기라도 했으면. 세계의 모든 보석들을 모아둔 보석함 한 가운데에, 보석보다 더 밝게 빛나는..

entries.en: |[Kei]# … Other precious stones?
|[Kei]# Hey, are there many other gems in that jewel chest? I happen to be looking for a specific kind…
entries.ko: |[케이]# 정말로 모든 보석이 다있나요? 제가 지금 어떤 보석을 찾고 있어서요.

entries.en: &[Old Man]# The chest belonged to the Duke… It contains the Family Crest, as well as many other jewels and precious stones.
entries.ko: &[노인]# 초대 당주께서 리이드가에 위기가 닥쳤을 때를 위해 숨겨둔 보석함일세. 보석은 물론 신비로운 마법석까지 모두 들어있지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# If I get the chest for you, and the chest happens to contain the kind of gem I am looking for, could you let me have it?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 제가 만약 다시 찾아온다면.. 그리고 그안에 제가 찾는 보석이 있다면 받을 수 있을까요?

entries.en: &[Old Man]# Of course! If you can get through all those demons in the {Ghost's Cave#, I'm sure I could spare one measly gemstone!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 정말인가? {사령의 동굴#은 이미 악마들의 소굴이 되었을 텐데.. 자네가 해낼 수 있다면 보석 한 개정도가 문제겠나!

entries.en: }New Quest! {The Reid Family Crest}
&[Old Man]# Bring me the {Jewel Chest# from the Ghost's Cave, and I will give you what you are looking for!
entries.ko: &[노인]# 사령의 동굴에 있는 {보석함#을 찾아다 줄 수만 있다면, 자네가 찾는 보석은 꼭 사례 해주겠네.

entries.en: &[Robe]# Elgis has been destroyed and the people in town have no intentions to fight back. I'm feeling discouraged.
entries.ko: &[로브]# 엘지스는 붕괴되고 마을 사람들을 싸울 생각조차 없어. 의욕이 생기질 않는군.

entries.en: &[Blacksmith]# What we need is the best shield to protect ourselves!
entries.ko: &[대장장이]# 우리에게 필요한 것은 우리 몸을 보호할 최강의 방패입니다!

entries.en: &[Mrs. folk]# Now Enzak is gone… There is no safe place left.
entries.ko: &[아줌마]# 엔자크도 사라졌다면서요.. 이제 불안하지 않은 곳이 없네요.

entries.en: &[Anti-war supporter]# Nothing can be done.. The war of Askra will not end.
entries.ko: &[반전주의자]# 이제 틀렸어.. 아스크라의 전란은 끝나지 않을거야.

entries.en: {Crest of Elgis} Delivered!
&[Elgis Member]# You retrieved it for us? I guess Helene was right about you…
|[Rits]# You may find it hard to believe, but yes.
&[Elgis Member]# I suppose if she trusted you, so can I.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 일레느가 믿던 남자라면.. 나도 믿을 수 있다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# But… I'm not so sure about the others.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 하지만... 다른 사람들은 어떨지 모르지.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# Anyways, I'll try to gather as many people as I can using this crest.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 일단 난 이 문장으로, 흩어진 사람들을 좀 모아보도록 하겠다.

entries.en: {The Symbol of Peace} Quest Complete!
|[Rits]# Hey, do you remember me?
&[Elgis Member]# Huh? You're…
|[Rits]# I met you before at Helene's place.
&[Elgis Member]# Ah, so that was you…
|[Rits]# So you're one of those who got out alive.
&[Elgis Member]# Actually, I was lucky. I wasn't at that meeting.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 난 .. 그때의 집회에 참가하지 못했거든.

entries.en: |[Rits]# … I want to rally Elgis together again.
&[Elgis Member]# Why? I thought you supported the war.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 무엇을 하려고 그러나..? 당신은 솔티안과의 싸움을 원했던 것 같은데.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# … Helene… She…
|[Rits]# I can't leave things like this. We need Elgis.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 이대로 둘순 없어. 다시 엘지스가 필요할 때다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# You need an {Crest#.
|[Rits]# You mean, like an insignia of some sort?
&[Elgis Member]# We lost almost everything from our headquarters during the attack. To restore Elgis, we'll need our crest back.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 우린 지난번 집회때 지휘부의 대부분을 잃었어. 엘지스를 다시 결집시키려면, 우리의 문장이 필요하다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Why don't you just make a new one?
&[Elgis Member]# The crest is a physical representation of what we stand for. We cannot simply replace it so easily.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 틀려. 또 새로운 단체를 만들려면 너무 오랜 시간이 소요된다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# The fastest way to restore the group would be to gather the remaining members under the {Crest of Elgis#!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 엘지스를 부활시켜야 해. 그러려면, {엘지스의 문장# 아래에 집결 하는게 가장 빠르다!

entries.en: |[Rits]# We have no time… where is it?
&[Elgis Member]# It could still be in the {Rowen Factory#.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 아마.. {로우엔 공장의 집회장소#에 그대로 남아있을거야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# OK. I'll go get it!
}New Quest! {The Symbol of Peace}
&[Elgis Member]# We must gather the remaining members under the {Crest of Elgis#!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 엘지스의 재집결을 위해선, 로우엔 공장에 남겨진 {엘지스의 문장#이 필요해.

entries.en: &[Rowen citizen]# If the number of demons continue to increase, all the men will be recruited as town guards..  I've never even grabbed a sword before..
entries.ko: &[로우엔 주민]# 마물들이 더 증가하면 모든 남자가 마을경비대로 차출될 거야.. 난 검을 잡아본 적도 없는데..

entries.en: &[Askran soldier]# (sigh).. The outer area is not safe, either.
entries.ko: &[아스크라 병사]# 후우.. 변방 지역이라고 안전하지도 않군 그래.

entries.en: &[Rowen citizen]# None of the townsmen seem to know what they're doing..
entries.ko: &[로우엔 주민]# 마을의 남자들은 도통 믿음직스럽지가 못하다니까..

entries.en: &[Rowen girl]# Demons have never attacked the town, so I'm not worried..
entries.ko: &[로우엔 소녀]# 마물들이 마을에 쳐들어온 적이 없어서.. 전 걱정이 안 돼요.

entries.en: &[Rowen girl]# I guess demons also need a place to live.
entries.ko: &[로우엔 소녀]# 마물들도 살 곳이 필요한게 아닐까요?

entries.en: &[Rowen citizen]# The blacksmith who makes the spear..and the blacksmith who makes the shield..they have been enemies for a long time.
entries.ko: &[로우엔 주민]# 창을 만드는 대장장이.. 방패를 만드는 대장장이.. 두 사람은 오래전부터 앙숙이었죠.

entries.en: &[Rowen citizen]# If they could just put aside their differences and work together in making spears and shields for us, it would be a big help in our fight against the demons..
entries.ko: &[로우엔 주민]# 두 사람이 힘을 합쳐 창과 방패를 만든다면, 마물과의 싸움에 더 힘이 될텐데..

entries.en: &[Government Official]# It's common knowledge that small towns tend to be rather unsafe. I'm sick of dealing with bandits and demons.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 망할 시골마을, 도적들도 마물들도 지긋지긋해 이제.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# I think you did a good job, though.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 훌륭하군, 자네도. 요즘 도적들이 한층 늘어나서..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Why are they turning to crime?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 어째서 도적질 따윌 하는 걸까요 그들은?

entries.en: &[Government Official]# Who knows. Perhaps all the war orphans are getting older and have nothing better to do.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 알게 뭐야. 전쟁 고아 녀석들이 나이들고 할짓없으니 그러는 거겠지.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# I'll go bring them in. I'm getting tired of all these reports coming in.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 다 때려잡아야지 원, 신고가 많아서 귀찮아 죽겠어.

entries.en: |[Kei]# (These bandits… They're all war orphans who've been left to fend for themselves...)
&[Government Official]# Hey, you forgot your reward!
{Preserving the Peace} Quest Complete!
&[Government Official]# Hmm, you're really fast. Are you a mercenary?
|[Rits]# I'm not for hire. I have no time to waste.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 고용할 생각은 하지마. 더 이상 시간 뺏기긴 싫군.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# Don't be so uptight. Anyways, I guess the number of reports will decrease a bit, if at all.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 깐깐하게 굴기는. 어쨌든 조금은 신고가 줄겠지, 없어지진 않겠지만.

entries.en: &[Government Official]#  Here is the reward I promised you. You may go now.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 약속한 포상금일세. 어여 갈길 가 봐.

entries.en: {The Public Peace of Rowen} Quest Complete!
&[Government Official]# Hey! You look like you could use some money! There's a bounty on the {Bandits# that are plaguing this town.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 이봐, 모험가라면 포상금이나 노려보라고. {마을 주변의 도적들# 말야.

entries.en: &[Government Official]# If you arrest 15 bandits, you will be rewarded with 10,000 Gold!
Bandits, huh? Sounds good.
&[Government Official]# The crime rate has gone up lately… I'm counting on you, young man!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 마을 주변에 징그럽게 늘었어 요즘. 잘 좀 부탁하네.

entries.en: }New Quest! {Preserving the Peace}
I have no time for this.
&[Government Official]# What a shame. No one has a sense of justice these days…
&[Government Official]# You'll have to capture 15 {Bandits# near the town.
&[Government Official]# Torez is not interested in the demons appearing here. They think it has nothing to do with them, I guess.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 토레즈는 이쪽에 출현하는 마물들에 대해서는 관심을 안 갖는구만. 자기네 일이 아니라는 거지.

entries.en: {Message of Torez} Delivered!
&[Government Official]# ... Let's see, what's this about?
&[Government Official]# Hah! They didn't give a damn back when we were under attack by demons from the south.
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 우리가 남쪽의 마물들 때문에 고생할 때는 쳐다도 안 보고 불평하지 말라더니!

entries.en: &[Government Official]# And now they expect us to help them fight off the monsters?! What a joke!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 이제와서 협조해서 몬스터들을 물리쳐? 웃기지 마!

entries.en: &[Government Official]# Tell them they're on their own!
entries.ko: &[공무원]# 가서 우린 우리 힘으로 살테니, 그쪽도 알아서 하라고 그래!

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# I came here to render aid to the townspeople by getting rid of the monsters in the area… but they all seem so depressed for some reason.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 이곳에 출몰하는 마수들의 소문을 듣고 퇴치하러 왔는데.. 마을 사람들이 의욕이 없어서 안 되겠어.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# Well, if another job comes along, I'll be happy to work with you again.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 뭐, 혹시 다른 의뢰 할만한게 들어오면 또 같이 하자구.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# Haha, I was expecting you! It looks like we've already defeated more than 60 Bloody Demons combined!
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 후후, 생각보다 늦었군. 어쨌든 내가 잡은 놈들까지 60마리 이상의 블러디 데몬을 퇴치했어.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# Let's split the 30,000 Gold reward equally!
&[Adventurer]# You know, those demons didn't seem like they were going to attack the town anytime soon…
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 근데 말이야, 아무래도 그 데몬들이 마을을 습격할 것 같진 않더란 말이지.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# They weren't as hostile as the townspeople made them out to be… I wonder why.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 마을 사람들이 두려워하는 것 만큼 호전적인 것 같지도 않고.. 희안한 일이야.

entries.en: {The Ghost's Cave} Quest Complete!
&[Adventurer]# The townspeople have hired me to deal with the {Bloody Demons# in the cave to the south.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 마을 사람들이 남쪽 동굴에 출몰하는 {블러디데몬의 퇴치#를 의뢰해오긴 했는데, 이게 참 난감해.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# They want me to defeat more than 50 of them. That's way too much for me to handle alone!
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 50마리 이상의 개체수를 줄여달라는데, 그게 혼자 힘으로는 좀 벅차거든.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# If you're interested, we can co-operate. If you could help me defeat 30 {Bloody Demons#, I'll split the reward with you, 50-50!
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 혹시 생각있으면 나눠서 해보지 않겠나? {30마리#만 잡아 준다면 보수는 50대 50으로 해주지.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# Great! You're a brave one, aren't you! It's not easy finding good company in this town.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 좋아, 용기있는 친구로군. 다른 마을 사람들은 영 동료구하기가 쉽지 않아서.

entries.en: &[Adventurer]# Come look for me when you've defeated 30 {Bloody Demons# in the {Ghost's Cave# to the south.
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 마을 남쪽 {사령의 동굴#에서 {블러디데몬 30마리#를 퇴치하거든 다시 오게.

entries.en: }New Quest! {The Ghost's Cave}
No, I don't think so.
&[Adventurer]# What, are all the people in this town cowards or something?
entries.ko: &[모험가]# 이 동네 사람들은 영 용기가 없군 그래..

entries.en: &[Rowen citizen]# I barely get my life by daily income from working in factory. All I can wish for is that the demons will not attack.
entries.ko: &[로우엔주민]# 공장일 해서 하루 벌어 하루 먹고 살기 빠듯해요. 마물들이 습격해오지 않기만을 바래야죠..

entries.en: |[Kei]# Let's hurry up and get to Rowen. It's going to be a pain if we happen to run into that person again
entries.ko: |[케이]# 서둘러 로우엔으로 가자. 혹시라도 그 사람을 다시 마주치게 되면 골치아파 질거야.

entries.en: {CHAPTER 5; The Secret Meeting#
{Acquire Citizen Pass} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Town of Rowen}
{CHAPTER 5; On the Battlefield#
|[Rits]# Rowen… it's to the south.
{Elgis in Crisis} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The Factory in Rowen}
|[Kei]# Haha! Yes!
|[Kei]# I finally finished it! Now I can face Reah with my dignity intact!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 해냈다!! 이제 레아님 앞에서도 떳떳할 수 있어!!

entries.en: |[Kei]# … I'm a long way from home. When can I go back…?
entries.ko: |[케이]# 근데.. 이걸 언제 돌아가서 레아님한테 자랑하지?

entries.en: |[Kei]# Eh, whatever, I feel a lot better about myself now anyways!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 어쨌든 이제 나도 어느 정도 자신감을 가질 수 있을 것 같아!

entries.en: {Proof of Effort 4} Quest Complete!!
|[Kei]# Wait a minute! Isn't that…?!
|[Kei]# Yes, no doubt about it! Elder Mushfulra!
|[Kei]# At long last, I can complete Reah's training list!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 드디어 레아님의 수련목록을 마스터 할 수 있는 건가!!

entries.en: }New Quest! {Proof of Effort 4}
|[Kei]# It seems like things always take a turn for the worse whenever I show up.
|[Kei]# … I can't help but feel that it was my fault somehow.
^[Sien]# We would have parted ways with them eventually. Besides, we can save time this way.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 어차피 헤어져야 했을 사람들이야. 혼자서 움직이는 게 더 빠르니까.

entries.en: |[Kei]# That's not the point, Miss I-get-lost-in-my-own-backyard!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 그건 아니라고 봐, 초절정 길치 아가씨..

entries.en: ^[Sien]# … Oh.
|[Kei]# … Uh, I'm sorry.
^[Sien]# … It's alright. Let us go to the Refiner's Ruins.
^[Sien]# There must be a way to get to Soltia from there.
entries.ko: ^[시엔]# 솔티아와 접속할 수 있는 방법을 알아내야 해.

entries.en: |[Kei]# You mean the Refiner's Ruins in the desert, right?
|[Kei]# Well, if we're going that way, we'll need to stop by Torez first. We should pay Helene a visit.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 일단 토레즈를 지나야 하니까.. 일레느씨를 찾아가자.

entries.en: ^[Sien]# Helene?
|[Kei]# Believe me, she is the only person we can trust right now.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 지금 상황에서 유일하게 믿을 수 있는 사람이지.

entries.en: }New Quest! {A Trustworthy Person}
&[Mercenary]# This area is strictly prohibited, so please go back.
}You feel a rumbling, as if a heavy weight was being moved nearby.
|[Rits]# Damn it... Can't things be easy for a change?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 제길.. 귀찮은 건 꼭 하나씩 남겨두는군..!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Just as I thought. Most of the troops have left for the ruins of Soltia already. There're barely any guards.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 역시.. 경비 병력을 빼고는 전부 솔티아의 유적으로 간건가.

entries.en: I came to Askra seeking to join the war effort against the Soltians.
Ironically, I'm now working to save the man whom I have loathed for the past 10 years.
entries.ko: 지금 나는 10년을 경멸해온 그 남자를 도우려 한다.

entries.en: This man caused the destruction of the Knights of Melhar and my homeland…
Because of him, I have wandered the land aimlessly as a mercenary for those 10 years.
This endless conflict has cost me all that I have ever known.
entries.ko: 그동안 내가 바라보았던 세계는, 생각해왔던 이념은

entries.en: And this man carries at least part of the blame for that.
entries.ko: 그리고 최소한 그도 그 일에 대한 책임이 있다.

entries.en: This is it.
Can I bring myself to forgive him?
^[Ian]# … Back again?
|[Rits]# … I'm not who you think I am, whoever that may be.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아니.. 정식으로 얼굴을 맞대는 건 처음이 되겠군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# The invincible Warrior of the Frozen Sea, reduced to such a state… Pathetic.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그 강대했던 빙해의 검사가 이런 꼴이라니.. 기분이 어때?

entries.en: ^[Ian]# You must listen to me! Kenneth has been manipulating everyone all along.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 이 시간에도 너희는 케네스에게 이용당하고 있을 뿐이야.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# He has no intention of handing over the Guardian's power to anyone.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 다시 말하지만.. 그는 너희에게 가디언의 힘을 줄 생각 따윈 추호도 없다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# I guessed as much. He plans to seal off the Guardians for good, doesn't he?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 그렇겠지. 그는 가디언을 영원히 봉인할 생각일 테니까.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# If he succeeds, the entire area around Soltia will be utterly destroyed.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 그의 계획이 완성되면 솔티아를 둘러싼 모든 것이 파괴될거야.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# The Nemesis Forest, the city of Torez, even the town of Rowen!
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 네메시스 숲, 토레즈 광산, 멀리는 로우엔까지..

entries.en: |[Rits]# … That Kenneth is a real bastard, isn't he?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 케네스란 놈도.. 어처구니 없이 스케일 큰 남자로구만.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# Wait… You're not a member of the Corbus Guild, are you?
|[Rits]# I'm not. I came to rescue you.
I opened the door.
The man I saw, his eyes burned with determination...
Yet at the same time, I saw a hint of sadness within him.
As our eyes met for the first time, my hesitation vanished.
I knew I could trust him…
Just like Helene did.
entries.ko: 나도 믿을 수 있을 것 같았다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Helene needs you.
^[Ian]# Are you a member of Elgis?
|[Rits]# No, I just happen to be someone who wants to do the right thing.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아니, 엘지스가 해야할 일이 옳다고 생각하게 된 사람이지.

entries.en: ^[Ian]# … I see.
|[Rits]# The ruins of Soltia have become a battlefield.
|[Rits]# Both Soltian and Askran forces are fighting over the power held within.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 솔티아군도, 아스크라군도 유적의 힘을 손에 넣기 위해 몰려들었어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Do you think we can stop all of them?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 너라면, 엘지스라면 그것을 막을 수 있겠나?

entries.en: ^[Ian]# This meaningless war will only benefit Kenneth.
^[Ian]# Regardless of whether or not we can stop it, we have to try.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 막을 수 있든 없든, 움직이지 않으면 안 돼.

entries.en: |[Rits]# So what do we do? Any ideas?
^[Ian]# Yes… a few.
entries.ko: ^[이안]# 이곳에 있는 자료들과 엘지스의 활동으로 할 수 있는게 있다.

Insert Entry Pass.
{Entry Pass} used.
Cancel
|[Rits]# Entry Pass?!
|[Rits]# Damn it, they have a security system in place. Why do they even need one?!
|[Rits]# Where do I get an {Entry Pass#? I'll check with the {Blacksmith#.
{The Factory in Rowen}  Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {Automated Security System}
|[Kei]# What the?! Is that Robe's idea of a "security measure"?!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 뭐야 저건, 저것도 무인 경계 시설인가!?

entries.en: |[Rits]# What the hell is this?!
}The security system has been activated. All external access is now restricted.
}Do you wish to open the underground passage?
}D you wish to open the underground passage?
&[Sentry]# As long as the power is not cut off, the factory is secured.
entries.ko: &[경비]# 공장의 보안은 정전 상태만 되지 않으면 항상 유지되지.

entries.en: &[Sentry]# …Are you a participant of the gathering? The gathering room is not here, it's at the top passage. To get access, turn off the switch of the central passage.
entries.ko: &[경비]# ... 집회 참가자인가, 집회실은 여기가 아니라 제일 위쪽 통로야. 중앙 통로의 스위치를 해제하고 가면 돼.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Damn! That was a nasty surprise!
|[Kei]# … Heh! I guess I should have expected something like that.
entries.ko: |[케이]# 하하하... 뭔가 큰 실례를 범한 듯한...

entries.en: ^[Sien]# Kei? Is that you?
|[Kei]# ...Sien. Sien! I've finally found you!
^[Sien]# What are you doing here? You were supposed to return to Neo Soltia.
|[Kei]# I'll only go home after I've done my duty, you silly girl!
entries.ko: |[케이]# 돌아간다 해도, 모든 일을 끝내고 나서 함께 돌아갈 거야, 바보야!

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# Ahem…
|[Kei]# Woah! I'm sorry, I didn't notice you there!
&[Elgis Leader]# You must the young man Helene told me about.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# 자네가 일레느가 말했던 시엔양의 일행이로군.

entries.en: |[Kei]# Yes, I am Sien's Guardian Knight!
^[Sien]# … I see you are still as stubborn as before.
&[Elgis Leader]# Of course. I'm sure we'll have time to get to know each other better after this meeting.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# 뭐 인사는 천천히 하지. 그건 그렇고.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# Moving on, our efforts to meet with Tener, the current leader of Neo Soltia, were greeted with success.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# 하던 얘기를 마저 하자면, 네오 솔티아의 수장 테너와의 회담은 무사히 끝마쳤다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# The floating kingdom of Soltia is indeed, falling to earth. What's worse is that the magic of the Holy Core has somehow hidden the entire kingdom from our sight.
entries.ko: &[리더]# 천공의 대륙 솔티아는 홀리 코어의 힘으로 그 모습을 숨긴 채 대지로 추락하고 있어.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# Because of this, we have no idea as to exactly how, when and where it will impact the ground.
entries.ko: &[리더]# 하지만 정확히 언제, 어디로 추락하는지는 그들도 알 수 없다고 한다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# The entire kingdom has been rendered invisible? Is that even possible?
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 대륙의 모습을 숨기다니, 그런게 정말로 가능한 얘긴가?

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# It certainly is. The Holy Core holds absolute dominion over the power of light and darkness.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 홀리 코어는 아시다시피 빛과 어둠을 관장합니다. 충분히 가능성이 있는 이야기지요.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# But we have Sien here with us. Couldn't she prevent this?
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 무엇보다, 시엔양이 이곳에 있는 것만으로도 믿을 수 있지 않습니까?

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# Tener has been a longtime ally of Elgis. We can trust his words on this matter. I'd like all of you to extend that trust to other Soltians.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# 테너는 오랫동안 접촉해온 믿을 수 있는 남자다. 우린 기본적으로 솔티안을 믿는 자세에서 출발해야 해.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# We must never betray that trust, or all we have worked for will amount to nothing.
entries.ko: &[리더]# 그 믿음이 배신당한다면, 우린 잘못된 일을 하고 있는 거겠지.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# In any case, Soltia's descent has begun earlier than we anticipated. We must do everything in our power to assist Sien in her quest.
entries.ko: &[리더]# 어찌 됐든 솔티아는 예상보다 훨씬 빨리 추락을 시작했고, 우리는 시엔양을 도와 솔티아의 추락을 막아야 한다.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# For if the Sky Kingdom were to impact the ground, the damage and subsequent backlash would result in all-out war against Neo Soltia.
entries.ko: &[리더]# 솔티아가 떨어져 버리면 국민들의 여론은 더더욱 네오 솔티아와의 전면전으로 쏠릴 거야.

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# What are your thoughts, Miss Sien? Do you have any information that could help us?
entries.ko: &[리더]# 어떤가, 시엔양. 원하던 정보는 충분히 얻었나?

entries.en: ^[Sien]# Not nearly enough, I am afraid. It seems that I will need to visit the Refiner's Ruins personally after all.
&[Elgis Leader]# Hmmm… I suppose you should… It's the only choice we have.
&[Sentry]# We're under attack! The enemy forces outnumber us, and they are heavily armed! All their troops bear the tattoo of a red wolf!
entries.ko: &[경비]# 침입자입니다! 중무장한 인원 다수이며, 붉은 늑대 문신으로 보아...

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# The {Corbus Guild#?! How did they find us?
&[Elgis Leader]# …Could they have followed you here?!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# ... 설마 이 친구를 따라온 건가?!

entries.en: |[Kei]# Huh?! Me?!
&[Elgis Leader]# Quickly! Lead the two of them out through the back door!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 리더]# 어서 저 아이들을 뒷문으로 보내, 서둘러!

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# The Corbus Guild has dominated Askra's underworld for as long as I can remember.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# {코르버스#는 예전부터 아스크라의 암흑가를 지배하던 길드야.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# The fact that they've shown up here can only mean bad news.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 분명히.. 좋은 의도로 이곳에 온 건 아니겠지.

entries.en: |[Kei]# You're all in danger... because of me?!
&[Elgis Member]# Don't worry, we'll be alright. They won't be able to accuse us of anything as long as you two don't get caught.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 아니, 저들도 우릴 어쩌지는 못할 거다. 너희만 안 들킨다면.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# The best thing you can do to help us right now, is to leave, quickly!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 어서 빠져나가. 그게 우릴 위한 거야.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member]# You must help us avert the coming disaster!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버]# 넌.. 솔티아의 추락을 막는 것만 생각해다오.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# The Corbus Guild HQ is in the {southern part of the Rowen Plains#. Please rescue Ian!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버1]# 코르버스의 아지트는 {로우엔 평원 남부#에 있어. 이안의 구출을 부탁하네!

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# Ian must not come to any harm!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 이안 역시, 시대가 낳은 희생자일 뿐이야..

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# It's finally time for us to fight!
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버3]# 이제 우리도 싸워야 할 때가 왔어.

entries.en: {The Crest of Elgis} Obtained!
|[Rits]# Am I too late?!
&[Elgis Leader]# Do you think you can get away with this?
entries.ko: &[엘지스리더]# 이런 짓을 너희들이 해도 된다고 생각하느냐!

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Ah, I think we already have…
&[Elgis Leader]# Are you even aware of what exactly is going on?
&[Elgis Leader]# The Sky Kingdom of Soltia is descending upon us! We have no idea when and where it will fall!
entries.ko: &[엘지스리더]# 언제 갑자기 하늘에서 솔티아 대륙이 떨어질지 몰라...

entries.en: &[Elgis Leader]# A great disaster approaches!
entries.ko: &[엘지스리더]# 역사에 다시없을 재앙이 다가오고 있을지도 모른단 말이다!

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Haha! That's a good one! Did you hear that, boys? Soltia is falling down!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 그것 참 흥미있는 얘긴데. 솔티아 대륙이 떨어진다라..

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# If anything, that's even better! We can pin even more blame on the Soltians!
&[Elgis Leader]# This is no laughing matter! Something has to be done!
&[Elgis Leader]# Many lives will be lost, resulting in an even greater war. Don't you get it?!
entries.ko: &[엘지스리더]# 수많은 사람이 죽게되고, 더 큰 전쟁이 벌어질거라는 걸 모르겠나!

entries.en: |[Rits]# Soltia… is coming down?
^[Melpheto]# Enough with your foolish nonsense!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 말도 안 되는 소리해봐야 소용 없어.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# I will not tolerate any more of your ridiculous lies!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 전시에 쓸데없는 짓거리로 사기를 저하시키는 것 만으로도...

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# For the crime of treason, I sentence you to death!
^[Melpheto]# Rits? I told you to wait for my return, didn't I?
|[Rits]# We're all Askrans here, aren't we? Isn't this taking things a little too far?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어째서 아스크란끼리.. 이렇게까지 해야 하는 겁니까!

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# ... Do you even know who these people are?
|[Rits]# I know they oppose the war, but…
^[Melpheto]# And for that, these traitors deserve nothing less than death!
^[Melpheto]# Wake up, Rits. We're in the middle of a war here.
^[Melpheto]# The Soltians, they want more than just the Nemesis Forest!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 솔티안들은 이제 네메시스 숲으로 만족하지 못하고 있어.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# They just attacked us a while ago! Or have you already forgotten?!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 그들이 먼저 공격해오기 시작했단 말일세. 보지 않았나?

entries.en: |[Rits]# You have no intention of ending this war, do you?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 전쟁을 끝내고 싶은 마음이.. 없는 건 아닙니까?

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# Ha! How will you make a living as a mercenary after the war is over?
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 용병이 전쟁 끝나면 뭘 먹고 살라고 그러나?

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# I thought you'd changed over the years, Rits, but I suppose I was wrong…
^[Melpheto]# You're still a naïve former knight who believes in all those useless ideals!
entries.ko: ^[멜페토]# 여전히 쓸데없는 정의감이 남아있는 햇병아리 기사로군, 리츠.

entries.en: ^[Melpheto]# We're done here. Let's go!
&[Soldier 1]# That was a little too easy, wasn't it?
&[Soldier 2]# Heh, it's not like these guys have ever gotten into a real fight before.
entries.ko: &[병사2]# 뭐 손에 피안묻히고 살던 잘난 양반들이니까.

entries.en: &[Soldier 1]# Haha! They have no idea just what kind of world we are living in!
entries.ko: &[병사1]# 흐흐, 지금이 어떤 시댄지 모르는 자들이었지.

entries.en: &[Soldier 3]# What do we do with the corpses? Do we just leave them here?
|[Rits]# (Who are these guys? They don't look like regular soldiers...)
^[Melpheto]# What now?!
|[Rits]# What he said… about Soltia coming down…
^[Melpheto]# Haha! Honestly, I can't believe how foolish you must be to believe that crap!
^[Melpheto]# Go join Duke then! I hope you've learnt to get along with him, hah!
|[Rits]# … No way am I going to join the regular Askran army after seeing all this!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 아무래도 아스크라 정규군에 들어가는 건 그른 것 같군.

entries.en: |[Rits]# What they said before they died… That's whats really bugging me.
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 일단.. 마음에 걸리는 걸 확인해봐야 겠어.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Soltia is coming down? They had no reason to lie about something like that…
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 솔티아의 추락.. 죽기전에 내뱉은 허풍이라고 넘길수 없는 문제다.

entries.en: |[Rits]# Helene! She must know something about this!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 엘지스가 알고 있었다면.. 일레느도 알고 있을거야.

entries.en: {A Forbidden Gathering} Quest Complete!
}New Quest! {The True Nature of the Disaster}
Will this be… enough?
The remaining members of Elgis have begun to gather their scattered comrades.
entries.ko: 엘지스의 남은 멤버들은;각자의 방법으로;흩어진 동료들을 모았다.

entries.en: There are too few of us for an open confrontation, but I'm sure we can think of something…
entries.ko: 전투인력은 적지만, 분명히 이들 나름의; 방식이 있겠지.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 1]# … There are about 40 of us now.
&[Elgis Member 2]# It's too small of a number to go up against the Corbus Guild directly.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 코르버스 길드와 맞서기는 턱없이 부족해. 전투력도 당연히 떨어지고...

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# Perhaps we could rescue our leader? That should be a top priority!
|[Rits]# … Leader? I thought the entire leadership of Elgis was killed?
entries.ko: |[리츠]# ... 리더? 지휘부는 그때의 집회에서 모두 살해당한게 아닌가?

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# The founder of Elgis was not at that meeting…
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버3]# 엘지스의 창립자는.. 거의 우리의 집회 때 나타나지 않았어.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# Because he feels he is unworthy.
|[Rits]# Who is he?
&[Elgis Member 2]# Since you are now one of us, you have a right to know.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 당신을 완전한 동료라 인정하고, 말해줄게.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# Our true leader is {Ian, the Warrior Of the Frozen Sea#.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 우리의 진정한 리더는 {빙해의 검사, 이안#이야.

entries.en: |[Rits]# How could someone like him put together an organization like Elgis?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 어째서 그 따위 놈이 엘지스를 만들 생각을 한거지?

entries.en: |[Rits]# Isn't he responsible for the destruction of entire nations and armies?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 수많은 국가를, 수많은 기사들을 쓰러트린 주제에 평화라고?!

entries.en: |[Rits]# And what's more, isn't he the one leading the charge against the Soltians behind a mask?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 게다가 가면을 쓴 채, 솔티안들과의 싸움에 앞장서지 않았던가?!

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# That's precisely why he wears a mask.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버3]# 그래서 그는 가면을 쓸 수 밖에 없었던걸세.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# He was the hero who ended the war, yes, but he also destroyed the Legalis Church.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버3]# 전쟁을 끝낸 영웅이기도 하지만, 레갈리스교를 붕괴시킨 자이기도 하며..

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 3]# There are many people in Askra who hate him for that.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버3]# 아스크라에는 그를 존경하는 이들만큼, 증오하는 이들이 있으니까...

entries.en: |[Rits]# So he hides behind a mask?
&[Elgis Member 2]# Thanks to the balance of power between Ian and the Red Witch, the war never escalates beyond control.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 그가 붉은 마녀와 힘의 균형을 맞춰주었기에, 전쟁이 더이상 확대되지 않은거야.

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# That is how we have been able to maintain contact with Neo Soltia without causing any trouble.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 그리고 우린.. 전면전의 위협 없이 네오 솔티아와 평화를 위한 접촉을 계속할 수 있었지.

entries.en: |[Rits]# ... This is all very hard for me to swallow.
&[Elgis Member 2]# You're from Melhar, right? Just like Helene.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 당신 일레느와 같은 멜하르 출신이라 그랬지..?

entries.en: &[Elgis Member 2]# Helene forgave Ian for what he did.
&[Elgis Member 2]# He took it upon himself to end a long, brutal war. You can't find fault with that.
entries.ko: &[엘지스 멤버2]# 적어도 그는, 끝이 보이지 않던 대륙전쟁을 끝내기 위해 검을 들었던 거라고...

entries.en: |[Rits]# You're asking me to forgive the Warrior of the Frozen Sea?!
entries.ko: |[리츠]# 후.. 나에게 빙해의 검사마저 용서하라는 거냐, 일레느...

entries.en: |[Rits]# I've hated him for the past 10 years of my life!
&[Elgis Member 3]# … We need him, Rits.
